blocks.en: The measurements behind every claim ReLEAF makes: the bioreactor instruments, the software calibration of the OD600 signal chain, the light plate, three protectant assays from secreted protein to enzyme activity, and plant assays on agar and in hydroponics, each with its principle, its protocol and what it returned.
blocks.text: The measurements behind every claim ReLEAF makes: the bioreactor instruments, the software calibration of the OD600 signal chain, the light plate, three protectant assays from secreted protein to enzyme activity, and plant assays on agar and in hydroponics, each with its principle, its protocol and what it returned.
blocks.zh: ReLEAF 每一項主張背後的量測：生物反應器的儀器、OD600 訊號鏈的軟體校正、光照板、從分泌蛋白質到酵素活性的三項保護劑檢測，以及在瓊脂與水耕上進行的植物檢測，每一項都附上原理、流程，以及得到了什麼。

blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.text: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Measuring ReLEAF means making each result traceable: from the physical principle and calibration to the controls, raw data, and protocol another team could repeat.
blocks.text: Measuring ReLEAF means making each result traceable: from the physical principle and calibration to the controls, raw data, and protocol another team could repeat.
blocks.zh: 量測 ReLEAF，就是讓每一項結果都可追溯：從物理原理與校正，到對照組、原始數據，以及另一支團隊能夠重複的流程。

blocks.en: We developed and documented measurement methods across the entire system so our data could capture failures, improvements, and successes. The photometer reads OD600 directly in the bioreactor loop and converts its short flow-cell path to the conventional 1 cm basis, while software calibration tests the full signal-processing chain against a 1 µm silica standard. Light output is measured and matched across LEDs before optogenetic testing, plant assays use controlled stress and treatment conditions to measure growth and chlorophyll, and protectant assays track protein production, concentration, and activity.
blocks.text: We developed and documented measurement methods across the entire system so our data could capture failures, improvements, and successes. The photometer reads OD600 directly in the bioreactor loop and converts its short flow-cell path to the conventional 1 cm basis, while software calibration tests the full signal-processing chain against a 1 µm silica standard. Light output is measured and matched across LEDs before optogenetic testing, plant assays use controlled stress and treatment conditions to measure growth and chlorophyll, and protectant assays track protein production, concentration, and activity.
blocks.zh: 我們在整個系統上開發並記錄量測方法，讓數據能呈現失敗、改進與成功。光度計直接在生物反應器迴路中讀取 OD600，並把流通池的短光程換算到慣用的 1 cm 基準；軟體校正則以 1 µm 二氧化矽標準品檢驗整條訊號處理鏈。在光遺傳測試之前，各顆 LED 的光輸出都先經過量測與配對；植物檢測在受控的逆境與處理條件下量測生長與葉綠素；保護劑檢測則追蹤蛋白質的生產、濃度與活性。

blocks.en: Overview
blocks.text: Overview
blocks.zh: 概覽

blocks.en: Can our engineered Bacillus subtilis detect plant stress and respond by producing the right plant protectant at the right time? How well does the protectant aid plant growth?
blocks.text: Can our engineered Bacillus subtilis detect plant stress and respond by producing the right plant protectant at the right time? How well does the protectant aid plant growth?
blocks.zh: 我們改造的枯草桿菌（Bacillus subtilis）能否偵測植物逆境，並在正確的時機產出正確的植物保護劑？這些保護劑又把植物生長幫助到什麼程度？

blocks.en: We break that question into five measurable stages in the order of how the system operates: the bioreactor runs the culture, the software validates the sensor data, light control sets production, protectant assays confirm what was produced and whether it worked, and plant assays measure the response.
blocks.text: We break that question into five measurable stages in the order of how the system operates: the bioreactor runs the culture, the software validates the sensor data, light control sets production, protectant assays confirm what was produced and whether it worked, and plant assays measure the response.
blocks.zh: 我們依系統實際運作的順序，把這個問題拆成五個可量測的階段：生物反應器運轉培養液，軟體驗證感測器數據，光控制設定生產，保護劑檢測確認做出了什麼、以及它是否有效，植物檢測則量測植物的反應。

blocks.en: Continuous in-line monitoring in the bioreactor lets us follow culture growth while also tracking changes across the membrane system, helping distinguish normal operating conditions from signs of pressure buildup, flow changes, or loss of cell retention.
blocks.text: Continuous in-line monitoring in the bioreactor lets us follow culture growth while also tracking changes across the membrane system, helping distinguish normal operating conditions from signs of pressure buildup, flow changes, or loss of cell retention.
blocks.zh: 生物反應器中的連續線上監測讓我們能追蹤培養液的生長，同時掌握膜系統兩側的變化，藉此把正常運轉狀態與壓力累積、流量改變或細胞截留失效的徵兆區分開來。

blocks.en: To measure culture density continuously without manually withdrawing samples, we built an in-line flow-cell photometer that reads OD600 directly from the bioreactor loop.
blocks.text: To measure culture density continuously without manually withdrawing samples, we built an in-line flow-cell photometer that reads OD600 directly from the bioreactor loop.
blocks.zh: 為了在不手動取樣的情況下連續量測培養密度，我們做了一具線上流通池光度計，直接從生物反應器迴路讀取 OD600。

blocks.en: In most laboratory workflows, OD600 is measured by removing a sample and reading it on a benchtop spectrophotometer. For long reactor runs, repeated sampling interrupts the system and introduces additional handling steps, which is especially important for ReLEAF because the system is intended to operate outside a conventional laboratory setting.
blocks.text: In most laboratory workflows, OD600 is measured by removing a sample and reading it on a benchtop spectrophotometer. For long reactor runs, repeated sampling interrupts the system and introduces additional handling steps, which is especially important for ReLEAF because the system is intended to operate outside a conventional laboratory setting.
blocks.zh: 在大多數實驗室流程中，OD600 是取出樣品後在桌上型分光光度計上讀取。對於長時間的反應器運轉，反覆取樣會中斷系統，也增加額外的操作步驟；這一點對 ReLEAF 尤其重要，因為這套系統本來就是要在常規實驗室之外運作。

blocks.en: Our photometer measures the culture as it flows through a 2 mm cuvette using an amber LED near 600 nm. A 90:10 beam splitter directs part of the light to a reference sensor before the main beam passes through the culture. Comparing the sample and reference signals allows changes in LED output to be separated from changes in culture density. Burst sampling and a MAD-based filter are then used to reduce interference from bubbles and transient fluctuations.
blocks.text: Our photometer measures the culture as it flows through a 2 mm cuvette using an amber LED near 600 nm. A 90:10 beam splitter directs part of the light to a reference sensor before the main beam passes through the culture. Comparing the sample and reference signals allows changes in LED output to be separated from changes in culture density. Burst sampling and a MAD-based filter are then used to reduce interference from bubbles and transient fluctuations.
blocks.zh: 我們的光度計以接近 600 nm 的琥珀色 LED，量測流經 2 mm 比色槽的培養液。一片 90:10 分光鏡在主光束通過培養液之前，先把一部分光導向參考感測器。比較樣品訊號與參考訊號，就能把 LED 光輸出的變化與培養密度的變化分開。接著再以叢發取樣與基於 MAD 的濾波，降低氣泡與瞬時波動造成的干擾。

blocks.en: Two photometers
blocks.text: Two photometers
blocks.zh: 兩具光度計

blocks.en: We built two versions of the in-line photometer. The Pro uses an amber LED, collimating lens, 90:10 beam splitter, and two lux sensors in a tilted printed body, allowing the reference and sample paths to be measured separately while bubbles move out of the cuvette. The Slim replaces the beam splitter and free-space optics with a fiber collimator feeding the same 2 mm flow cuvette, creating a smaller design that can clip directly onto the loop.
blocks.text: We built two versions of the in-line photometer. The Pro uses an amber LED, collimating lens, 90:10 beam splitter, and two lux sensors in a tilted printed body, allowing the reference and sample paths to be measured separately while bubbles move out of the cuvette. The Slim replaces the beam splitter and free-space optics with a fiber collimator feeding the same 2 mm flow cuvette, creating a smaller design that can clip directly onto the loop.
blocks.zh: 我們做了兩個版本的線上光度計。Pro 版在一個傾斜的列印本體內裝入琥珀色 LED、準直透鏡、90:10 分光鏡與兩顆照度感測器，讓參考光路與樣品光路能分開量測，氣泡也有機會離開比色槽。Slim 版則以光纖準直器取代分光鏡與自由空間光學，饋入同一個 2 mm 流通比色槽，做出體積更小、可直接夾在迴路上的設計。

blocks.en: The Pro costs US$371.78 to build and the Slim US$235.29, and that difference is one of the reasons the second build exists.
blocks.text: The Pro costs US$371.78 to build and the Slim US$235.29, and that difference is one of the reasons the second build exists.
blocks.zh: Pro 的製作成本是 US$371.78，Slim 是 US$235.29，而這個價差正是第二個版本存在的理由之一。

blocks.en: Comparison of the two in-line photometer designs at the same scale. The beam-splitter design (left) uses a tilted stand, while the fiber-based design (right) integrates the fiber collimator and flow cuvette into a compact housing.
blocks.text: Comparison of the two in-line photometer designs at the same scale. The beam-splitter design (left) uses a tilted stand, while the fiber-based design (right) integrates the fiber collimator and flow cuvette into a compact housing.
blocks.zh: 兩種線上光度計設計以相同比例並列比較。分光鏡設計（左）使用傾斜的支架，光纖設計（右）則把光纖準直器與流通比色槽整合在一個緊湊的外殼裡。

blocks.en: The two builds show different measurement strengths. The Pro is about 5.3× more sensitive, making it better at resolving small changes at low density. The Slim is less sensitive but stays more linear across the full silica range, with R² = 0.992 compared with 0.974 for the Pro. Within the 0–1 OD range, both perform similarly (0.9947 vs. 0.9874). The Pro is the sensitive build and the Slim the linear one, and the Slim is also the cheaper.
blocks.text: The two builds show different measurement strengths. The Pro is about 5.3× more sensitive, making it better at resolving small changes at low density. The Slim is less sensitive but stays more linear across the full silica range, with R² = 0.992 compared with 0.974 for the Pro. Within the 0–1 OD range, both perform similarly (0.9947 vs. 0.9874). The Pro is the sensitive build and the Slim the linear one, and the Slim is also the cheaper.
blocks.zh: 兩個版本展現不同的量測長處。Pro 的靈敏度約為 5.3 倍，在低密度下更能分辨細微的變化。Slim 靈敏度較低，但在整個二氧化矽範圍內線性更好，R² = 0.992，Pro 則為 0.974。在 0–1 OD 範圍內兩者表現相近（0.9947 對 0.9874）。Pro 是靈敏的那一版，Slim 是線性的那一版，而 Slim 也比較便宜。

blocks.en: What another team can take from it
blocks.text: What another team can take from it
blocks.zh: 其他團隊能從中取用什麼

blocks.en: Our central contribution is an in-line OD600 measurement with a reproducible relationship to the benchtop scale. Across validation runs, the Pro agreed with the BioDrop to a median paired difference of 3.8%, while the Slim maintained a strong linear response over a wider range.
blocks.text: Our central contribution is an in-line OD600 measurement with a reproducible relationship to the benchtop scale. Across validation runs, the Pro agreed with the BioDrop to a median paired difference of 3.8%, while the Slim maintained a strong linear response over a wider range.
blocks.zh: 我們的核心貢獻，是一套與桌上型尺度之間有可重現關係的線上 OD600 量測。在各次驗證運轉中，Pro 與 BioDrop 的配對差異中位數為 3.8%，Slim 則在更寬的範圍內維持良好的線性反應。

blocks.en: Four things make that number usable by someone else. The flow cuvette sits in the loop, so OD600 is tracked without withdrawing a sample or interrupting the run. A second sensor watches the LED, which separates a change in light output from a change in culture density. Burst sampling and MAD filtering take out most of the bubble error, and the rejection rate says when a reading should not be trusted. And measurement near 600 nm keeps clear of the green and red that drive CcaSR, so watching the culture does not induce it.
blocks.text: Four things make that number usable by someone else. The flow cuvette sits in the loop, so OD600 is tracked without withdrawing a sample or interrupting the run. A second sensor watches the LED, which separates a change in light output from a change in culture density. Burst sampling and MAD filtering take out most of the bubble error, and the rejection rate says when a reading should not be trusted. And measurement near 600 nm keeps clear of the green and red that drive CcaSR, so watching the culture does not induce it.
blocks.zh: 有四件事讓這個數字能被別人使用。流通比色槽就裝在迴路上，因此追蹤 OD600 不必取樣，也不必中斷運轉。第二顆感測器盯著 LED，把光輸出的變化與培養密度的變化分開。叢發取樣與 MAD 濾波去掉大部分的氣泡誤差，而剔除率則說明一筆讀值何時不該採信。還有，量測波長接近 600 nm，避開了驅動 CcaSR 的綠光與紅光，所以觀察培養液不會把它誘導起來。

blocks.en: From lux to optical density
blocks.text: From lux to optical density
blocks.zh: 從照度到光密度

blocks.en: Both photometers record raw illuminance and convert it to OD600 in software. Each measurement uses 20 readings per sensor: four dark readings with the LED off and sixteen lit readings. The dark median is subtracted to remove ambient light and sensor offset, the first two lit readings are discarded for settling, and the remaining values are filtered using median ± 3·MAD.
blocks.text: Both photometers record raw illuminance and convert it to OD600 in software. Each measurement uses 20 readings per sensor: four dark readings with the LED off and sixteen lit readings. The dark median is subtracted to remove ambient light and sensor offset, the first two lit readings are discarded for settling, and the remaining values are filtered using median ± 3·MAD.
blocks.zh: 兩具光度計都記錄原始照度，再以軟體換算成 OD600。每次量測對每顆感測器取 20 筆讀值：LED 關閉時的 4 筆暗讀值，以及 16 筆亮讀值。扣掉暗讀值的中位數以去除環境光與感測器偏移，前兩筆亮讀值因為沉降而捨棄，其餘數值再以中位數 ± 3·MAD 濾波。

blocks.en: For the Pro, the calculation uses the sample signal S, the reference signal R, and their blank values S₀ and R₀:
blocks.text: For the Pro, the calculation uses the sample signal S, the reference signal R, and their blank values S₀ and R₀:
blocks.zh: Pro 的計算使用樣品訊號 S、參考訊號 R，以及它們的空白值 S₀ 與 R₀：

blocks.en: OD = log<sub>10</sub>[ (S₀/R₀) / (S/R) ] × 5
blocks.text: OD = log10[ (S₀/R₀) / (S/R) ] × 5

blocks.en: The factor of 5 converts the 2 mm flow-cell path to the conventional 1 cm OD600 basis. Because the raw sensor readings are logged before calculation, every reported value can be recomputed after the run.
blocks.text: The factor of 5 converts the 2 mm flow-cell path to the conventional 1 cm OD600 basis. Because the raw sensor readings are logged before calculation, every reported value can be recomputed after the run.
blocks.zh: 乘上 5 這個係數，是把 2 mm 流通池光程換算到慣用的 1 cm OD600 基準。由於原始感測器讀值在計算之前就已記錄下來，每一個報告值都能在運轉結束後重新計算。

blocks.text: How the two optical designs are interpreted
blocks.zh: 兩種光學設計如何解讀

blocks.en: The Pro uses a separate reference channel to remove changes in LED output and fixed differences between the two optical paths. Let P be the LED output, T the sample transmittance, and k the fixed optical difference between the sample and reference paths:
blocks.text: The Pro uses a separate reference channel to remove changes in LED output and fixed differences between the two optical paths. Let P be the LED output, T the sample transmittance, and k the fixed optical difference between the sample and reference paths:
blocks.zh: Pro 以獨立的參考通道去除 LED 光輸出的變化，以及兩條光路之間的固定差異。令 P 為 LED 光輸出、T 為樣品穿透率、k 為樣品光路與參考光路之間的固定光學差異：

blocks.en: S / R = k × T
blocks.text: S / R = k × T

blocks.en: Blank referencing then removes k:
blocks.text: Blank referencing then removes k:
blocks.zh: 再以空白校正把 k 去掉：

blocks.en: (S/R) / (S₀/R₀) = T / T<sub>blank</sub>
blocks.text: (S/R) / (S₀/R₀) = T / Tblank

blocks.en: This allows the Pro to report OD600 directly from the optical measurement without fitting an instrument-specific conversion curve against a benchtop spectrophotometer.
blocks.text: This allows the Pro to report OD600 directly from the optical measurement without fitting an instrument-specific conversion curve against a benchtop spectrophotometer.
blocks.zh: 這讓 Pro 能直接從光學量測報出 OD600，不必再對著桌上型分光光度計擬合一條儀器專屬的換算曲線。

blocks.en: The Slim uses a different optical geometry and therefore does not reproduce the same absolute scale. Instead, it shows a strong linear relationship to particle concentration and to the Pro, with lower sensitivity but greater linearity across the full silica range. The Slim is therefore the build to use when range and a simple optical path matter more than agreeing with the benchtop OD600 scale.
blocks.text: The Slim uses a different optical geometry and therefore does not reproduce the same absolute scale. Instead, it shows a strong linear relationship to particle concentration and to the Pro, with lower sensitivity but greater linearity across the full silica range. The Slim is therefore the build to use when range and a simple optical path matter more than agreeing with the benchtop OD600 scale.
blocks.zh: Slim 採用不同的光學幾何，因此無法重現同一套絕對尺度。它所呈現的是與顆粒濃度、以及與 Pro 之間的良好線性關係：靈敏度較低，但在整個二氧化矽範圍內線性更佳。因此當量測範圍與簡單的光路比「與桌上型 OD600 尺度相符」更重要時，就該用 Slim。

blocks.en: Built-in measurement checks
blocks.text: Built-in measurement checks
blocks.zh: 內建的量測檢查

blocks.en: For the Pro, the reference channel also tracks source stability:
blocks.text: For the Pro, the reference channel also tracks source stability:
blocks.zh: 在 Pro 上，參考通道同時也追蹤光源的穩定性：

blocks.en: R / R₀ = P / P₀
blocks.text: R / R₀ = P / P₀

blocks.en: Values outside 0.85–1.15 trigger a drift flag. Both designs use burst sampling and filtering to reduce transient noise, and raw sensor values are stored so the calculation can be inspected or replayed later.
blocks.text: Values outside 0.85–1.15 trigger a drift flag. Both designs use burst sampling and filtering to reduce transient noise, and raw sensor values are stored so the calculation can be inspected or replayed later.
blocks.zh: 數值落在 0.85–1.15 之外就會觸發漂移旗標。兩種設計都使用叢發取樣與濾波以降低瞬時雜訊，而原始感測器數值會保存下來，使計算日後可以檢視或重播。

blocks.en: The blank is the one input that has to be right, since it passes k and T<sub>blank</sub> into every later point. It is refused if either sensor is saturated, if too few readings survive the filter, or if either channel reads zero; with no blank stored, the software returns no OD instead of an uncorrected number. On a single optical path the reference terms are unavailable and the software falls back to OD = log<sub>10</sub>(S₀/S) × 5, where the source intensity does not cancel and any change in it reads directly as a change in OD. Both forms are logged for every measurement.
blocks.text: The blank is the one input that has to be right, since it passes k and Tblank into every later point. It is refused if either sensor is saturated, if too few readings survive the filter, or if either channel reads zero; with no blank stored, the software returns no OD instead of an uncorrected number. On a single optical path the reference terms are unavailable and the software falls back to OD = log10(S₀/S) × 5, where the source intensity does not cancel and any change in it reads directly as a change in OD. Both forms are logged for every measurement.
blocks.zh: 空白值是唯一非得正確的輸入，因為它會把 k 與 T<sub>blank</sub> 帶進之後的每一個點。若任一顆感測器飽和、通過濾波的讀值太少，或任一通道讀到零，空白值就會被拒收；沒有存下空白值時，軟體不會給出未校正的數字，而是不回報 OD。在單一光路上無法取得參考項，軟體會退回 OD = log<sub>10</sub>(S₀/S) × 5，此時光源強度不會被消掉，光源的任何變化都會直接讀成 OD 的變化。兩種形式在每次量測都會記錄下來。

blocks.en: Both builds are therefore worth having, and for different reasons: the Pro for agreement and sensitivity, the Slim for linearity over a wide range.
blocks.text: Both builds are therefore worth having, and for different reasons: the Pro for agreement and sensitivity, the Slim for linearity over a wide range.
blocks.zh: 兩個版本因此都值得保留，理由各不相同：Pro 為了一致性與靈敏度，Slim 為了寬範圍下的線性。

blocks.en: A fifth quality-control step, an acceptance gate that withholds unreliable readings, was added after the 8–October 10 reactor run. Its design, performance, and effect on OD600 are covered in the next section on software calibration.
blocks.text: A fifth quality-control step, an acceptance gate that withholds unreliable readings, was added after the 8–October 10 reactor run. Its design, performance, and effect on OD600 are covered in the next section on software calibration.
blocks.zh: 第五道品管步驟——一道把不可信讀值攔下來的接受閘門——是在 10 月 8–10 日的反應器運轉之後才加入的。它的設計、表現，以及對 OD600 的影響，收在下一節的軟體校正。

blocks.en: Acquisition and filtering 16 readings, a median fence, one logged point every 10 minutes
blocks.text: Acquisition and filtering 16 readings, a median fence, one logged point every 10 minutes
blocks.zh: 取樣與濾波 16 筆讀值、一道中位數圍籬，每 10 分鐘記錄一個點

blocks.en: Each logged OD600 point is built from a short burst of sensor readings rather than a single measurement.
blocks.text: Each logged OD600 point is built from a short burst of sensor readings rather than a single measurement.
blocks.zh: 每一個記錄下來的 OD600 點，都是由一小叢感測器讀值構成，而不是單一次量測。

blocks.en: Discard the first 2 warm-up readings from each sensor.
blocks.text: Discard the first 2 warm-up readings from each sensor.
blocks.zh: 捨棄每顆感測器最前面 2 筆暖機讀值。

blocks.en: Record a burst of 16 readings per sensor.
blocks.text: Record a burst of 16 readings per sensor.
blocks.zh: 每顆感測器記錄一叢 16 筆讀值。

blocks.en: Calculate the median of the burst.
blocks.text: Calculate the median of the burst.
blocks.zh: 計算該叢讀值的中位數。

blocks.en: Calculate the median absolute deviation (MAD) from that median.
blocks.text: Calculate the median absolute deviation (MAD) from that median.
blocks.zh: 計算相對該中位數的中位數絕對偏差（MAD）。

blocks.en: Reject readings outside median ± 3·MAD.
blocks.text: Reject readings outside median ± 3·MAD.
blocks.zh: 剔除落在中位數 ± 3·MAD 之外的讀值。

blocks.en: If more than 50% of the burst is rejected, repeat the measurement and flag the point for excessive bubbling.
blocks.text: If more than 50% of the burst is rejected, repeat the measurement and flag the point for excessive bubbling.
blocks.zh: 若該叢讀值有超過 50% 被剔除，重做這次量測，並把該點標記為氣泡過多。

blocks.en: Log the accepted result every 10 minutes.
blocks.text: Log the accepted result every 10 minutes.
blocks.zh: 每 10 分鐘記錄一次被接受的結果。

blocks.en: We use the median and MAD because bubbles create one-sided, short-lived drops in transmitted light. A mean and standard deviation can be pulled toward those outliers, while the median-based filter is less affected by them. The dashboard also reports the rejection rate so the user can see when bubbling is affecting measurement quality.
blocks.text: We use the median and MAD because bubbles create one-sided, short-lived drops in transmitted light. A mean and standard deviation can be pulled toward those outliers, while the median-based filter is less affected by them. The dashboard also reports the rejection rate so the user can see when bubbling is affecting measurement quality.
blocks.zh: 我們之所以用中位數與 MAD，是因為氣泡造成的是單側、短暫的穿透光下降。平均值與標準差會被這些離群值拉過去，而基於中位數的濾波受它們影響較小。儀表板也會回報剔除率，讓使用者看得出氣泡何時正在影響量測品質。

blocks.en: Two standards, two validation runs
blocks.text: Two standards, two validation runs
blocks.zh: 兩種標準品、兩次驗證運轉

blocks.en: We validated the photometers against two independent particle standards, eight weeks apart, using different particles and different experimental setups. Together, the two runs test both agreement with a benchtop reference and reproducibility across optical configurations.
blocks.text: We validated the photometers against two independent particle standards, eight weeks apart, using different particles and different experimental setups. Together, the two runs test both agreement with a benchtop reference and reproducibility across optical configurations.
blocks.zh: 我們以兩種各自獨立的顆粒標準品驗證光度計，相隔八週，使用不同的顆粒與不同的實驗配置。兩次運轉合起來，既檢驗與桌上型參考儀器的一致性，也檢驗跨光學配置的可重現性。

blocks.en: August 23: Titanium dioxide suspension was added incrementally to the stirred reservoir, with optical density measured using the in-line photometer and a benchtop BioDrop at each concentration.
blocks.text: August 23: Titanium dioxide suspension was added incrementally to the stirred reservoir, with optical density measured using the in-line photometer and a benchtop BioDrop at each concentration.
blocks.zh: 8 月 23 日：把二氧化鈦懸浮液逐次加入攪拌中的儲液槽，並在每個濃度下以線上光度計與桌上型 BioDrop 量測光密度。

blocks.en: October 10: The beam-splitter and fiber-based photometers were connected in series within the same recirculating loop to compare their readings under equivalent sample conditions.
blocks.text: October 10: The beam-splitter and fiber-based photometers were connected in series within the same recirculating loop to compare their readings under equivalent sample conditions.
blocks.zh: 10 月 10 日：分光鏡式與光纖式光度計在同一個循環迴路中串接，以在相同的樣品條件下比較兩者的讀值。

blocks.en: August 23 — titanium dioxide validation: Pro photometer
blocks.text: August 23 — titanium dioxide validation: Pro photometer
blocks.zh: 8 月 23 日——二氧化鈦驗證：Pro 光度計

blocks.en: Titanium dioxide was added by mass to the circulating loop and measured at each step using both the Pro photometer and a benchtop BioDrop. The Pro's raw output agreed with the BioDrop to a 3.8% median paired difference and tracked the independently defined mass standard with R² = 0.9999, compared with 0.9998 for the BioDrop.
blocks.text: Titanium dioxide was added by mass to the circulating loop and measured at each step using both the Pro photometer and a benchtop BioDrop. The Pro's raw output agreed with the BioDrop to a 3.8% median paired difference and tracked the independently defined mass standard with R² = 0.9999, compared with 0.9998 for the BioDrop.
blocks.zh: 二氧化鈦按質量加入循環迴路，每一步都同時以 Pro 光度計與桌上型 BioDrop 量測。Pro 的原始輸出與 BioDrop 的配對差異中位數為 3.8%，並以 R² = 0.9999 追隨獨立定義的質量標準，BioDrop 則為 0.9998。

blocks.en: The experiment was repeated twice, and both runs independently showed the same agreement with the reference. Two BioDrop points were excluded using predefined criteria, one handling error and one monotonicity violation, without changing the Pro measurements.
blocks.text: The experiment was repeated twice, and both runs independently showed the same agreement with the reference. Two BioDrop points were excluded using predefined criteria, one handling error and one monotonicity violation, without changing the Pro measurements.
blocks.zh: 這個實驗重複了兩次，兩次運轉都各自顯示與參考儀器相同的一致性。依事先訂好的判準排除了兩個 BioDrop 數據點，一個是操作失誤，一個違反單調性，而 Pro 的量測並未因此改變。

blocks.en: Because the Pro already tracked the mass-defined concentration closely, we used the BioDrop as a validation reference and not as the source of a fitted calibration curve.
blocks.text: Because the Pro already tracked the mass-defined concentration closely, we used the BioDrop as a validation reference and not as the source of a fitted calibration curve.
blocks.zh: 由於 Pro 本來就已緊密追隨由質量定義的濃度，我們把 BioDrop 當作驗證參考，而不是當作擬合校正曲線的來源。

blocks.en: October 10 — silicon dioxide comparison: Pro against Slim
blocks.text: October 10 — silicon dioxide comparison: Pro against Slim
blocks.zh: 10 月 10 日——二氧化矽比較：Pro 對 Slim

blocks.en: The second validation used 1 µm SiO₂ microspheres, close to the size scale of Bacillus subtilis. The Pro and Slim were placed in series on the same circulating loop, so both instruments measured the same suspension at the same time. Concentration was defined by the amount of SiO₂ added rather than by either instrument.
blocks.text: The second validation used 1 µm SiO₂ microspheres, close to the size scale of Bacillus subtilis. The Pro and Slim were placed in series on the same circulating loop, so both instruments measured the same suspension at the same time. Concentration was defined by the amount of SiO₂ added rather than by either instrument.
blocks.zh: 第二次驗證使用 1 µm SiO₂ 微球，尺度接近 Bacillus subtilis。Pro 與 Slim 串接在同一個循環迴路上，因此兩具儀器同時量測同一份懸浮液。濃度由加入的 SiO₂ 量定義，而不是由任一具儀器定義。

blocks.zh: 上表與下圖中，x 是加入的 SiO₂ 毫克數，y 是儀器報出的 OD600。各有九個點，原點是存下的空白值，其餘自 2.5 到 20 mg、每 2.5 mg 一階；區間是針對斜率，採自由度 7 的 Student-t。

blocks.en: The same three fits drawn. Inside the BioDrop's own range the Pro climbs on the reference's slope and sits a constant 0.12 OD below it; the Slim climbs a fifth as steeply and just as straight.
blocks.text: The same three fits drawn. Inside the BioDrop's own range the Pro climbs on the reference's slope and sits a constant 0.12 OD below it; the Slim climbs a fifth as steeply and just as straight.
blocks.zh: 同樣三條擬合線的圖示。在 BioDrop 自身的範圍內，Pro 以與參考儀器相同的斜率上升，並固定低於它 0.12 OD；Slim 的斜率只有五分之一，但同樣筆直。

blocks.en: For the Pro, the slope against the BioDrop was 1.001, reproducing the scale agreement seen in the TiO₂ experiment on a second particle standard. The remaining difference was a nearly constant offset of about −0.12 OD, indicating an additive blank-related shift and not a change in sensitivity. No offset correction was applied to the data.
blocks.text: For the Pro, the slope against the BioDrop was 1.001, reproducing the scale agreement seen in the TiO₂ experiment on a second particle standard. The remaining difference was a nearly constant offset of about −0.12 OD, indicating an additive blank-related shift and not a change in sensitivity. No offset correction was applied to the data.
blocks.zh: 就 Pro 而言，對 BioDrop 的斜率為 1.001，在第二種顆粒標準品上重現了 TiO₂ 實驗中看到的尺度一致性。剩下的差異是一個近乎固定的偏移，約 −0.12 OD，顯示這是與空白值有關的加成性位移，而不是靈敏度改變。數據未施加任何偏移校正。

blocks.en: The Slim showed a lower response slope, about 5.3× less sensitive than the Pro, but remained strongly linear across the silica series (R² = 0.9947). Against the Pro, its response was also linear (R² = 0.993), showing that the Slim trades sensitivity for greater linearity and a wider expected measurement range.
blocks.text: The Slim showed a lower response slope, about 5.3× less sensitive than the Pro, but remained strongly linear across the silica series (R² = 0.9947). Against the Pro, its response was also linear (R² = 0.993), showing that the Slim trades sensitivity for greater linearity and a wider expected measurement range.
blocks.zh: Slim 的反應斜率較低，靈敏度約比 Pro 低 5.3 倍，但在整個二氧化矽系列中仍保持高度線性（R² = 0.9947）。對 Pro 而言，它的反應同樣是線性的（R² = 0.993），顯示 Slim 以靈敏度換取更好的線性與更寬的預期量測範圍。

blocks.en: Between them the two runs cover what a validation has to cover: two independent standards, repeats, a benchtop comparison and a comparison of the builds on one loop. The raw SiO₂ data also form the basis of the next Software Calibration section, where the filtering, working range, and bubble-rejection algorithms are tested directly.
blocks.text: Between them the two runs cover what a validation has to cover: two independent standards, repeats, a benchtop comparison and a comparison of the builds on one loop. The raw SiO₂ data also form the basis of the next Software Calibration section, where the filtering, working range, and bubble-rejection algorithms are tested directly.
blocks.zh: 兩次運轉合起來，涵蓋了一次驗證該涵蓋的事：兩種各自獨立的標準品、重複試驗、與桌上型儀器的比較，以及兩個版本在同一迴路上的比較。SiO₂ 的原始數據也構成下一節軟體校正的基礎，濾波、工作範圍與氣泡剔除演算法都在那裡直接受到檢驗。

blocks.en: Further numbers are on the photometer page and under R1 on Digital Twin.
blocks.text: Further numbers are on the photometer page and under R1 on Digital Twin.
blocks.zh: 更多數字見光度計頁面，以及數位孿生的 R1。

blocks.en: Flow and pressure monitoring
blocks.text: Flow and pressure monitoring
blocks.zh: 流量與壓力監測

blocks.en: Because ReLEAF is designed for operation outside a conventional laboratory, the bioreactor needs continuous measurements that show both culture conditions and system performance.
blocks.text: Because ReLEAF is designed for operation outside a conventional laboratory, the bioreactor needs continuous measurements that show both culture conditions and system performance.
blocks.zh: 由於 ReLEAF 是為常規實驗室之外的運轉而設計，生物反應器需要能同時顯示培養狀況與系統表現的連續量測。

blocks.en: Flow and pressure provide two complementary measurements of how the hollow-fiber system is operating.
blocks.text: Flow and pressure provide two complementary measurements of how the hollow-fiber system is operating.
blocks.zh: 流量與壓力提供兩種互補的量測，說明中空纖維系統運轉得如何。

blocks.en: Together, flow and pressure can indicate changes in reactor operation. A sudden drop in flow at the same pump setting may suggest a leak or bypass, while increasing pressure at a similar flow can indicate rising resistance or membrane fouling (Field et al., 1995).
blocks.text: Together, flow and pressure can indicate changes in reactor operation. A sudden drop in flow at the same pump setting may suggest a leak or bypass, while increasing pressure at a similar flow can indicate rising resistance or membrane fouling (Field et al., 1995).
blocks.zh: 流量與壓力合起來可以指出反應器運轉上的變化。在相同幫浦設定下流量忽然下降，可能意味著洩漏或旁通；在相近流量下壓力上升，則可能代表阻力增加或薄膜積垢（Field et al., 1995）。

blocks.en: Pressure provides the driving force for permeation across the membrane, while flow determines crossflow through the fibers and the shear experienced by the cells (Wittig et al., 2025). Measuring both therefore helps define the reactor's operating range.
blocks.text: Pressure provides the driving force for permeation across the membrane, while flow determines crossflow through the fibers and the shear experienced by the cells (Wittig et al., 2025). Measuring both therefore helps define the reactor's operating range.
blocks.zh: 壓力提供跨膜滲透的驅動力，流量則決定纖維內的切向流以及細胞所受的剪應力（Wittig et al., 2025）。因此同時量測兩者有助於界定反應器的運轉範圍。

blocks.en: Flow also sets the shear the cells meet inside a fiber (Yuen, 2025). At our operating settings it is about 4000 to 6000 s⁻¹, which we read as comfortably inside what Bacillus subtilis tolerates. That reading is not settled here, and the one published figure we have found points the other way: B. subtilis grew in a Couette flow bioreactor at up to 1482 s⁻¹, but the cells shrank to about half their size and intracellular reactive oxygen species rose 9.3-fold (Sahoo et al., 2003). That was a different vessel, so the number transfers only loosely, but until culture viability has been read after circulation at our own dials, the margin is an expectation and not a measurement.
blocks.text: Flow also sets the shear the cells meet inside a fiber (Yuen, 2025). At our operating settings it is about 4000 to 6000 s⁻¹, which we read as comfortably inside what Bacillus subtilis tolerates. That reading is not settled here, and the one published figure we have found points the other way: B. subtilis grew in a Couette flow bioreactor at up to 1482 s⁻¹, but the cells shrank to about half their size and intracellular reactive oxygen species rose 9.3-fold (Sahoo et al., 2003). That was a different vessel, so the number transfers only loosely, but until culture viability has been read after circulation at our own dials, the margin is an expectation and not a measurement.
blocks.zh: 流量也決定細胞在纖維內遇到的剪切（Yuen, 2025）。在我們的運轉設定下，它約為 4000 到 6000 s⁻¹，我們把這讀成仍舒適地落在 Bacillus subtilis 的耐受範圍內。這個判讀在此並未定論，而我們找到的唯一一篇已發表數字指向相反的方向：B. subtilis 在 Couette 流生物反應器中可於高達 1482 s⁻¹ 下生長，但細胞縮小到約原本的一半，細胞內活性氧則上升 9.3 倍（Sahoo et al., 2003）。那是另一種反應槽，所以這個數字只能寬鬆地移用；但在以我們自己的刻度設定循環之後讀過培養存活率之前，這個餘裕只是預期，而不是量測。

blocks.en: How the flow was measured
blocks.text: How the flow was measured
blocks.zh: 流量如何量測

blocks.en: We measured flow in three stages, moving from manual collection to an electronic flow meter and validating the two methods against each other.
blocks.text: We measured flow in three stages, moving from manual collection to an electronic flow meter and validating the two methods against each other.
blocks.zh: 我們分三個階段量測流量，從人工收集進到電子流量計，並讓兩種方法相互驗證。

blocks.en: First, by hand with no membrane fitted: set the pump dial, catch the outflow in a measuring cylinder over a fixed interval. The pump covers dials 0 to 100 and we tested every tenth, three trials per setting except 70 to 100.
blocks.text: First, by hand with no membrane fitted: set the pump dial, catch the outflow in a measuring cylinder over a fixed interval. The pump covers dials 0 to 100 and we tested every tenth, three trials per setting except 70 to 100.
blocks.zh: 第一階段，不裝薄膜、以人工進行：設定幫浦刻度，在固定時間內用量筒接出流。幫浦刻度從 0 到 100，我們每十格測一次，每個設定三次試驗，70 到 100 除外。

blocks.en: On August 14 we fitted the membrane and read flow and pressure together, still catching the outflow by hand, every second dial from 10 to 24 where we expect to operate: three rounds of three trials.
blocks.text: On August 14 we fitted the membrane and read flow and pressure together, still catching the outflow by hand, every second dial from 10 to 24 where we expect to operate: three rounds of three trials.
blocks.zh: 8 月 14 日我們裝上薄膜，同時讀取流量與壓力，仍以人工接出流，在我們預期運轉的 10 到 24 之間每隔兩格測一次：三輪，每輪三次試驗。

blocks.en: On August 16 we replaced the hand method with the flow meter, because the hand readings depended too much on who took them. Two configurations ran at the same dials, 10 to 24: a background loop with plain tubing in place of the module and every valve, fitting and cuvette still fitted, and the same loop with the module installed.
blocks.text: On August 16 we replaced the hand method with the flow meter, because the hand readings depended too much on who took them. Two configurations ran at the same dials, 10 to 24: a background loop with plain tubing in place of the module and every valve, fitting and cuvette still fitted, and the same loop with the module installed.
blocks.zh: 8 月 16 日我們以流量計取代人工方法，因為人工讀值太依賴於由誰來讀。兩種配置在相同的 10 到 24 刻度下運轉：一是背景迴路，以普通管路取代模組，所有閥、接頭與比色槽都仍裝著；二是同一迴路，但裝上模組。

blocks.en: The meter is a ZJ-TM02, a Hall-effect type: a magnet in an internal rotor spins with the flow and a fixed sensor emits a pulse each time it passes, so pulse frequency is proportional to flow. Ours gives 2580 pulses per liter, about 43 Hz per L/min. The microcontroller counts rising edges and ignores any pulse arriving within 0.5 ms of the previous one, which rejects switching noise, and reports the pulse count, the time between the first and last pulse and a running total every second. The software converts to mL/min as pulses / 2580 × 1000 per minute.
blocks.text: The meter is a ZJ-TM02, a Hall-effect type: a magnet in an internal rotor spins with the flow and a fixed sensor emits a pulse each time it passes, so pulse frequency is proportional to flow. Ours gives 2580 pulses per liter, about 43 Hz per L/min. The microcontroller counts rising edges and ignores any pulse arriving within 0.5 ms of the previous one, which rejects switching noise, and reports the pulse count, the time between the first and last pulse and a running total every second. The software converts to mL/min as pulses / 2580 × 1000 per minute.
blocks.zh: 流量計是 ZJ-TM02，霍爾效應式：內部轉子上的磁鐵隨水流旋轉，固定的感測器每次磁鐵經過就發出一個脈衝，因此脈衝頻率與流量成正比。我們這一具是每公升 2580 個脈衝，約相當於每 L/min 43 Hz。微控制器計數上升緣，並忽略距前一個脈衝 0.5 ms 內抵達的任何脈衝以剔除開關雜訊，每秒回報脈衝數、第一個與最後一個脈衝之間的時間，以及累計總量。軟體依「脈衝數 / 2580 × 1000 每分鐘」換算成 mL/min。

blocks.en: We validated the electronic flow meter against simultaneous manual collection, with the two methods agreeing at R² = 0.995.
blocks.text: We validated the electronic flow meter against simultaneous manual collection, with the two methods agreeing at R² = 0.995.
blocks.zh: 我們以同時進行的人工收集驗證電子流量計，兩種方法以 R² = 0.995 相符。

blocks.en: How pressure was measured
blocks.text: How pressure was measured
blocks.zh: 壓力如何量測

blocks.en: The current system measures pressure at three points so true transmembrane pressure can be calculated during operation.
blocks.text: The current system measures pressure at three points so true transmembrane pressure can be calculated during operation.
blocks.zh: 目前的系統在三個位置量測壓力，使運轉中可以算出真正的跨膜壓。

blocks.en: Pressure is read by three transmitters, Jingfeng BP8G-AGB, on the feed (lumen in), the retentate (lumen out) and the permeate (shell side). Each runs from 12 V and outputs a voltage proportional to the pressure on its sensing element, 0 V at 0 bar to 5 V at 10 bar. The board's analog pins tolerate only 3.3 V, so each signal first passes a 15 kΩ / 22 kΩ divider, which scales 5 V down to about 2.97 V.
blocks.text: Pressure is read by three transmitters, Jingfeng BP8G-AGB, on the feed (lumen in), the retentate (lumen out) and the permeate (shell side). Each runs from 12 V and outputs a voltage proportional to the pressure on its sensing element, 0 V at 0 bar to 5 V at 10 bar. The board's analog pins tolerate only 3.3 V, so each signal first passes a 15 kΩ / 22 kΩ divider, which scales 5 V down to about 2.97 V.
blocks.zh: 壓力由三具變送器讀取，型號為 Jingfeng BP8G-AGB，分別裝在進料端（管內進）、濃縮端（管內出）與透過端（殼側）。每具以 12 V 供電，輸出與其感測元件上壓力成正比的電壓，0 bar 時為 0 V，10 bar 時為 5 V。控制板的類比腳位只能承受 3.3 V，因此每個訊號先經過 15 kΩ / 22 kΩ 分壓，把 5 V 降到約 2.97 V。

blocks.en: The microcontroller reads the three channels 100 times a second, each sample the sum of 16 readings to average out noise, and sends them to the computer in batches every 200 ms. The software converts each count to a pin voltage, undoes the divider and rescales 0 to 5 V onto 0 to 10 bar. The three pressures from the same instant are then combined as TMP = (P<sub>feed</sub> + P<sub>retentate</sub>) / 2 − P<sub>permeate</sub> (Millipore Corporation, 2003), and the value reported is the median over a 30 second window.
blocks.text: The microcontroller reads the three channels 100 times a second, each sample the sum of 16 readings to average out noise, and sends them to the computer in batches every 200 ms. The software converts each count to a pin voltage, undoes the divider and rescales 0 to 5 V onto 0 to 10 bar. The three pressures from the same instant are then combined as TMP = (Pfeed + Pretentate) / 2 − Ppermeate (Millipore Corporation, 2003), and the value reported is the median over a 30 second window.
blocks.zh: 微控制器每秒讀取三個通道 100 次，每個取樣是 16 筆讀值之和以平均掉雜訊，並每 200 ms 成批送到電腦。軟體把每個計數換算成腳位電壓，還原分壓，再把 0 到 5 V 重新換算到 0 到 10 bar。同一瞬間的三個壓力接著合併為 TMP = (P<sub>feed</sub> + P<sub>retentate</sub>) / 2 − P<sub>permeate</sub>（Millipore Corporation, 2003），而回報的數值是 30 秒視窗內的中位數。

blocks.en: The current system calculates TMP from feed, retentate, and permeate pressure. However, the August calibration runs below were recorded before the permeate channel was logged, so those data show lumen pressure drop rather than true TMP.
blocks.text: The current system calculates TMP from feed, retentate, and permeate pressure. However, the August calibration runs below were recorded before the permeate channel was logged, so those data show lumen pressure drop rather than true TMP.

blocks.en: The fit on this series is 0.050 bar per 100 mL/min with R² = 0.68. For laminar flow the pressure drop rises in proportion to flow (Hagen–Poiseuille; Bird et al., 2007), so that slope is the resistance of the flow path. Once a clean-module baseline is fixed, a reading more than about 1.3× the baseline at the same flow is the blockage warning and a reading clearly below it points to a leak or a bypass. This series is too scattered to be that baseline.

blocks.en: Conclusion
blocks.text: Conclusion
blocks.zh: 結論

blocks.en: Flow and pressure can be measured reliably enough to act on. The flow meter matches manual measurement with R² = 0.995, and flow rises by about 22 mL/min per pump dial up to dial 50. The 4000 to 6000 s⁻¹ shear band we work to corresponds to 260 to 390 mL/min, or roughly dials 16 to 22, which is where the reactor is run.
blocks.text: Flow and pressure can be measured reliably enough to act on. The flow meter matches manual measurement with R² = 0.995, and flow rises by about 22 mL/min per pump dial up to dial 50. The 4000 to 6000 s⁻¹ shear band we work to corresponds to 260 to 390 mL/min, or roughly dials 16 to 22, which is where the reactor is run.
blocks.zh: 流量與壓力的量測已經足夠可靠到可以據以行動。流量計與人工量測以 R² = 0.995 相符，而流量在刻度 50 之前每格約上升 22 mL/min。我們所依循的 4000 到 6000 s⁻¹ 剪切帶對應 260 到 390 mL/min，約為刻度 16 到 22，也就是反應器實際運轉的位置。

blocks.en: That is enough to set the two alarms the farmer actually needs. A leak shows as a sudden drop at a fixed dial, well below the flow normally seen there, which is about 355 mL/min at dial 20. A blockage shows as pressure rising while flow does not move: with the module installed the drop runs about 0.19 to 0.37 bar across 260 to 390 mL/min, so we propose flagging anything above roughly 1.3 times that, about 0.24 to 0.48 bar, at the same flow. Both are thresholds proposed from these calibration runs; neither has yet fired on a real fault.
blocks.text: That is enough to set the two alarms the farmer actually needs. A leak shows as a sudden drop at a fixed dial, well below the flow normally seen there, which is about 355 mL/min at dial 20. A blockage shows as pressure rising while flow does not move: with the module installed the drop runs about 0.19 to 0.37 bar across 260 to 390 mL/min, so we propose flagging anything above roughly 1.3 times that, about 0.24 to 0.48 bar, at the same flow. Both are thresholds proposed from these calibration runs; neither has yet fired on a real fault.
blocks.zh: 這已足以設定農友真正需要的兩個警報。洩漏表現為在固定刻度下流量突然下降，明顯低於該處平常所見的流量，也就是刻度 20 時約 355 mL/min。阻塞表現為壓力上升而流量不動：裝上模組後，壓差在 260 到 390 mL/min 之間約為 0.19 到 0.37 bar，因此我們提議在同一流量下，凡高於其約 1.3 倍（約 0.24 到 0.48 bar）者就發出旗標。這兩個門檻都是從這些校正運轉提出的；兩者都還沒有在真實故障上觸發過。

blocks.en: What the two readings still owe is a TMP. Every pressure figure in this chapter is the lumen drop, and the August 14 series stayed positive across 0.01 to 0.26 bar, which is consistent with filtrate being pushed out of the lumen but does not demonstrate it, because the permeate reading is not in those files. The permeate channel is now logged and the formula is in the software, so the next run on this module can close the one gap this chapter leaves open.

The permeate channel is now logged and the formula is in the software, so the next run on this module can close the one gap this chapter leaves open.
blocks.zh: 這兩項讀值仍欠一個 TMP。本章每一個壓力數字都是管內壓差，而 8 月 14 日的系列全程維持在 0.01 到 0.26 bar 的正值，這與濾液被推出管內一致，但並未證明這一點，因為那些檔案裡沒有透過端的讀值。透過端通道現在已會記錄，公式也已寫進軟體，因此這個模組的下一次運轉就能補上本章留下的這一個缺口。

blocks.en: Hollow fiber membrane breach detector
blocks.text: Hollow fiber membrane breach detector
blocks.zh: 中空纖維膜破損偵測器

blocks.en: The hollow fiber is where the culture and harvest stream touch, and a 0.2 µm pore is what keeps Bacillus subtilis on the lumen side. If breached, the cells would be able to come through, so a detector is installed on the shell side to watch for signs that may indicate unwelcomed particles.
blocks.text: The hollow fiber is where the culture and harvest stream touch, and a 0.2 µm pore is what keeps Bacillus subtilis on the lumen side. If breached, the cells would be able to come through, so a detector is installed on the shell side to watch for signs that may indicate unwelcomed particles.
blocks.zh: 中空纖維是培養液與收穫流接觸的地方，而 0.2 µm 的孔徑正是把 Bacillus subtilis 留在管內側的東西。一旦破損，細胞就可能穿過來，所以殼側裝了一具偵測器，用來盯住可能代表有不該出現的顆粒的跡象。

blocks.en: Fitted, but no breach test is on record. It currently rests on an offline proxy that was run once. During version 1, 2 mL was drawn from the shell side and spread on LB agar, and no colonies were recovered, so no culturable B. subtilis reached the shell side in that run. It is a single plating, and the replicate count, incubation time and incubation temperature were not recorded.
blocks.text: Fitted, but no breach test is on record. It currently rests on an offline proxy that was run once. During version 1, 2 mL was drawn from the shell side and spread on LB agar, and no colonies were recovered, so no culturable B. subtilis reached the shell side in that run. It is a single plating, and the replicate count, incubation time and incubation temperature were not recorded.
blocks.zh: 已裝上，但沒有破損測試的紀錄。目前它只靠一個離線的替代指標，而那只做過一次。在版本 1 期間，從殼側取出 2 mL 塗在 LB 瓊脂上，沒有長出任何菌落，因此那次運轉中沒有可培養的 B. subtilis 到達殼側。這只是一次塗盤，而重複數、培養時間與培養溫度都沒有記錄下來。

blocks.en: Which plate is which side. The culture runs inside the fibers and must stay there; the permeate collects around them and is what leaves with the harvest. (a) is the lumen-side medium and grows what it should. (b) is the shell-side medium after a 24 hour run, and is clear.

blocks.zh: 哪一盤是哪一側。培養液在纖維內部流動，而且必須留在那裡；透過液聚集在纖維周圍，是隨收穫一起離開的部分。（a）是管內側的培養基，長出了它該長的東西。（b）是 24 小時運轉後的殼側培養基，是清澈的。

blocks.en: No detectable B. subtilis colonies were observed in the shell-side sample under the tested conditions. That is preliminary evidence, for this one run, that the hollow fiber held the cells back.
blocks.text: No detectable B. subtilis colonies were observed in the shell-side sample under the tested conditions. That is preliminary evidence, for this one run, that the hollow fiber held the cells back.
blocks.zh: 在所測試的條件下，殼側樣品中未觀察到可偵測的 B. subtilis 菌落。就這一次運轉而言，這是中空纖維把細胞攔住的初步證據。

blocks.en: What this plate can support is a containment claim for one run; it cannot stand in for the detector, because a plate takes a day to answer and an instrument has to answer while the reactor is running. The build is on Hardware → Bioreactor and the containment argument it belongs to is on Safety.

blocks.zh: 這張培養盤能支持的是這一次運轉的圍阻主張；它無法代替偵測器，因為一張盤要一天才給出答案，而儀器必須在反應器運轉的同時給出答案。這具裝置的建置見硬體 → 生物反應器，它所屬的圍阻論證見生物安全。

blocks.en: Software algorithm calibration
blocks.text: Software algorithm calibration
blocks.zh: 軟體演算法校正

blocks.en: An OD600 value only becomes a reliable measurement if we understand how the raw light signal is converted into that number. We therefore opened the photometer firmware, traced each step in the calculation, and tested the resulting biases against a non-growing particle standard.
blocks.text: An OD600 value only becomes a reliable measurement if we understand how the raw light signal is converted into that number. We therefore opened the photometer firmware, traced each step in the calculation, and tested the resulting biases against a non-growing particle standard.
blocks.zh: 一個 OD600 數值只有在我們了解原始光訊號如何被換算成那個數字之後，才算是可靠的量測。因此我們打開光度計韌體，追蹤計算中的每一個步驟，並以不生長的顆粒標準品檢驗由此產生的偏差。

blocks.en: Unlike the other sections, which validate physical measurements against controls or standards, this section validates the software that processes the sensor data. Using the raw bursts from the SiO<sub>2</sub> run, we replayed the signal through different reduction methods, tested how quantisation and bubbles affected the reported OD600, and defined acceptance rules for when a reading should be trusted or withheld. The full raw data and replay scripts are published so another team can repeat the analysis on their own photometer.
blocks.text: Unlike the other sections, which validate physical measurements against controls or standards, this section validates the software that processes the sensor data. Using the raw bursts from the SiO2 run, we replayed the signal through different reduction methods, tested how quantisation and bubbles affected the reported OD600, and defined acceptance rules for when a reading should be trusted or withheld. The full raw data and replay scripts are published so another team can repeat the analysis on their own photometer.
blocks.zh: 其他各節是以對照組或標準品驗證物理量測，本節驗證的則是處理感測器數據的軟體。我們以 SiO<sub>2</sub> 運轉的原始叢發讀值，把訊號用不同的化約方法重播一遍，檢驗量化與氣泡如何影響所報出的 OD600，並訂出一筆讀值何時該被採信、何時該被扣住的接受規則。完整的原始數據與重播腳本都已公開，讓其他團隊能在自己的光度計上重做這份分析。

blocks.en: Our 434-hour photometer run contained repeated step changes in OD600. Re-examining the raw data showed that these steps came from the reference channel, not from changes in the culture.
blocks.text: Our 434-hour photometer run contained repeated step changes in OD600. Re-examining the raw data showed that these steps came from the reference channel, not from changes in the culture.
blocks.zh: 我們那次 434 小時的光度計運轉中，OD600 出現反覆的階梯變化。重新檢視原始數據後發現，這些階梯來自參考通道，而不是培養液的變化。

blocks.en: Between July 21 and August 8 the photometer logged 2671 valid readings. The reference channel remained near 32 sensor counts for most of the run. Because the detector resolves whole counts, low-count signals lose precision quickly: at 32 counts and a path-length factor of 5, a change of just one sensor count shifts the reported OD600 by 0.067.
blocks.text: Between July 21 and August 8 the photometer logged 2671 valid readings. The reference channel remained near 32 sensor counts for most of the run. Because the detector resolves whole counts, low-count signals lose precision quickly: at 32 counts and a path-length factor of 5, a change of just one sensor count shifts the reported OD600 by 0.067.
blocks.zh: 7 月 21 日到 8 月 8 日之間，光度計記錄了 2671 筆有效讀值。整段運轉的大部分時間裡，參考通道都停在 32 個感測器計數附近。由於偵測器只能分辨整數計數，低計數訊號的精度會迅速流失：在 32 個計數、光程係數為 5 的情況下，僅僅一個感測器計數的變化，就會讓報出的 OD600 位移 0.067。

blocks.en: Where the reference channel sat across the 434-hour run. Of 2671 readings, 91.5% fall on an exact integer count, which is what a burst that returns one count value looks like, not what an average over sixteen samples looks like.
blocks.text: Where the reference channel sat across the 434-hour run. Of 2671 readings, 91.5% fall on an exact integer count, which is what a burst that returns one count value looks like, not what an average over sixteen samples looks like.
blocks.zh: 整段 434 小時運轉中參考通道所在的位置。2671 筆讀值中有 91.5% 恰好落在整數計數上，這是一叢讀值只回傳一個計數值的樣子，而不是十六個樣本平均之後的樣子。

blocks.en: The photometer's microcontroller firmware takes sixteen sensor readings for each measurement and averages the readings that pass the outlier filter. In principle, this averaging should preserve values between whole sensor counts. Instead, 91.5% of the logged reference readings fell exactly on an integer, showing that sub-count information was being lost before the value reached the log.
blocks.text: The photometer's microcontroller firmware takes sixteen sensor readings for each measurement and averages the readings that pass the outlier filter. In principle, this averaging should preserve values between whole sensor counts. Instead, 91.5% of the logged reference readings fell exactly on an integer, showing that sub-count information was being lost before the value reached the log.
blocks.zh: 光度計的微控制器韌體每次量測取十六筆感測器讀值，並對通過離群值濾波的讀值取平均。原則上，這樣的平均應該保留整數感測器計數之間的數值。實際上，記錄下來的參考讀值有 91.5% 恰好落在整數上，顯示次計數層級的資訊在數值進入紀錄之前就已經流失。

blocks.en: That loss appeared directly in the OD600 trace: between hours 40 and 230, the reference channel changed count 29 times, and 26 of those changes coincided with an OD600 jump greater than 0.04. This showed that the step changes came from the signal-processing pipeline rather than from the culture.
blocks.text: That loss appeared directly in the OD600 trace: between hours 40 and 230, the reference channel changed count 29 times, and 26 of those changes coincided with an OD600 jump greater than 0.04. This showed that the step changes came from the signal-processing pipeline rather than from the culture.
blocks.zh: 這個流失直接出現在 OD600 軌跡上：在第 40 到 230 小時之間，參考通道變換計數 29 次，其中 26 次與大於 0.04 的 OD600 跳升同時發生。這顯示那些階梯變化來自訊號處理流程，而不是培養液。

blocks.en: Hours 77 to 101 of the same run. The reported density steps up inside every stretch where the reference channel has left 32 counts and settles again when it returns.
blocks.text: Hours 77 to 101 of the same run. The reported density steps up inside every stretch where the reference channel has left 32 counts and settles again when it returns.
blocks.zh: 同一次運轉的第 77 到 101 小時。只要參考通道離開 32 個計數，報出的密度就在那段期間往上跳一階，等它回來才又穩定下來。

blocks.en: Reading the firmware explained the first figure. The outlier gate keeps samples within three median absolute deviations of the median. When more than half of sixteen samples share the same integer, the median absolute deviation is zero, so the fence has zero width and every sample that differs from the median is discarded as a bubble. The filter collapses into taking the most common count. Our firmware offers two further estimators in its interface,

blocks.en: The hypothesis
blocks.text: The hypothesis
blocks.zh: 假說

blocks.en: Every step between the light and the number introduces a bias whose direction and size can be written down before anything is measured. We derived six of them: resolution lost at the sensor (ΔOD ≈ 0.434 k/N), the gap between averaging and taking the logarithm (0.217 kσ<sub>r</sub><sup>2</sup>), one-sided occlusion by bubbles, the degenerate outlier gate above, a stray-light ceiling at −k log<sub>10</sub>(s), and the delay a smoother adds. The sharpest prediction fell out of the third: if bubbles only block light, then an estimator that trusts the brighter half of each burst should scatter far less than a symmetric one. That prediction is what the calibration run was built to overturn or confirm.
blocks.text: Every step between the light and the number introduces a bias whose direction and size can be written down before anything is measured. We derived six of them: resolution lost at the sensor (ΔOD ≈ 0.434 k/N), the gap between averaging and taking the logarithm (0.217 kσr2), one-sided occlusion by bubbles, the degenerate outlier gate above, a stray-light ceiling at −k log10(s), and the delay a smoother adds. The sharpest prediction fell out of the third: if bubbles only block light, then an estimator that trusts the brighter half of each burst should scatter far less than a symmetric one. That prediction is what the calibration run was built to overturn or confirm.
blocks.zh: 從光到數字之間的每一個步驟都引入一個偏差，而它的方向與大小在量測之前就能寫下來。我們推導了其中六個：感測器處流失的解析度（ΔOD ≈ 0.434 k/N）、先平均再取對數之間的差距（0.217 kσ<sub>r</sub><sup>2</sup>）、氣泡造成的單側遮蔽、上述退化的離群值閘門、位於 −k log<sub>10</sub>(s) 的散射光上限，以及平滑器所加入的延遲。最鋒利的預測來自第三項：如果氣泡只會遮光，那麼只採信每一叢讀值中較亮那一半的估計式，散佈應該遠小於對稱的估計式。這次校正運轉就是為了推翻或證實這個預測而設計的。

blocks.en: The calibration run on October 10. Both photometer builds sit in series in one loop, each dose of silica goes in by hand, and every raw sensor sample is written to disk as it is taken.
blocks.text: The calibration run on October 10. Both photometer builds sit in series in one loop, each dose of silica goes in by hand, and every raw sensor sample is written to disk as it is taken.
blocks.zh: 10 月 10 日的校正運轉。兩個版本的光度計串接在同一個迴路上，每一劑二氧化矽都以人工加入，而每一筆原始感測器樣本在取得的同時就寫到磁碟。

blocks.en: One data set, eleven algorithms
blocks.text: One data set, eleven algorithms
blocks.zh: 一份數據，十一種演算法

blocks.en: To compare algorithms fairly, we recorded each raw sensor burst once and replayed every algorithm on the exact same input. This removes burst-to-burst variation, so any difference in output comes from the algorithm itself.
blocks.text: To compare algorithms fairly, we recorded each raw sensor burst once and replayed every algorithm on the exact same input. This removes burst-to-burst variation, so any difference in output comes from the algorithm itself.
blocks.zh: 為了公平比較演算法，我們把每一叢原始感測器讀值記錄一次，然後讓每一種演算法在完全相同的輸入上重播。這樣就排除了叢與叢之間的變異，因此輸出上的任何差異都來自演算法本身。

blocks.en: Switching algorithms between runs would give each one a different sensor burst, making the comparison confounded by burst-to-burst variation. We therefore modified the photometer firmware to log every individual sensor sample, record the active algorithm profile, and save the outputs needed for offline replay.
blocks.text: Switching algorithms between runs would give each one a different sensor burst, making the comparison confounded by burst-to-burst variation. We therefore modified the photometer firmware to log every individual sensor sample, record the active algorithm profile, and save the outputs needed for offline replay.
blocks.zh: 在不同運轉之間切換演算法，會讓每一種演算法拿到不同的感測器讀值叢，使比較被叢間變異混淆。因此我們改寫光度計韌體，讓它記錄每一筆個別的感測器樣本、記下當時啟用的演算法設定檔，並存下離線重播所需的輸出。

blocks.en: Eleven algorithms, including seven controls
blocks.text: Eleven algorithms, including seven controls

blocks.en: Four algorithms were already available in the firmware. Seven additional controls were added to test specific sources of bias, including quantisation, bubbles, source flicker, and the effect of the MAD floor. This lets us compare not only which estimator performs best, but why.
blocks.text: Four algorithms were already available in the firmware. Seven additional controls were added to test specific sources of bias, including quantisation, bubbles, source flicker, and the effect of the MAD floor. This lets us compare not only which estimator performs best, but why.
blocks.zh: 韌體裡原本就有四種演算法。我們另外加了七個對照，用來檢驗特定的偏差來源，包括量化、氣泡、光源閃動，以及 MAD 下限的影響。這讓我們不只能比較哪一種估計式表現最好，還能比較為什麼。

We evaluated bias, repeatability, limit of detection, limit of quantification, and hysteresis, then selected the simplest algorithm that met the predefined thresholds.

blocks.en: To separate instrument error from biological variation, we calibrated the photometers using a non-growing particle standard. On October 10, both photometers ran for 4.5 hours on a controlled SiO<sub>2</sub> concentration ladder while every raw sensor sample was logged.

blocks.en: . The reason is visible in the raw bursts: a bubble does not only block light. On V1, at OD 3.2, a bubble replaces a slice of scattering liquid with air and up to 2.8 times more light arrives; on V2, whose fiber collects over a wide angle, a bubble refracts light out of that cone and the reading darkens. The two units disagree in direction, so any estimator that assumes a direction is betting on the geometry it happens to be sitting in. No estimator put more than 35% of bubble readings within ±0.05 of the true level.

The two units disagree in direction, so any estimator that assumes a direction is betting on the geometry it happens to be sitting in. No estimator put more than 35% of bubble readings within ±0.05 of the true level.
blocks.zh: 的兩倍。原因在原始叢發資料裡看得出來：氣泡不只是遮光。在 V1 上，OD 3.2 時氣泡把一截散射液體換成空氣，抵達的光最多多出 2.8 倍；在 V2 上，光纖在很寬的角度上收光，氣泡把光折射出那個錐體，讀值因此變暗。兩具機器在方向上互相矛盾，因此任何假定了方向的估計式，都是在賭自己恰好身處的那個幾何。沒有任何估計式能讓超過 35% 的氣泡讀值落在真實水準的 ±0.05 以內。

blocks.en: Worse, the firmware's own bubble flag catches the wrong failure. When the fourteen samples in a burst disagree, the flag fires on 94% of them on V1 and 79% on V2. That makes the failure detectable, if not correctable. When the flow cell fills completely with air the fourteen samples agree perfectly and are all wrong together: V1 read 0.74 to 0.91 against a true 3.18, and the flag caught none of it. Nothing inside such a burst looks abnormal. Only a comparison with the previous reading reveals it.

blocks.zh: 更糟的是，韌體自己的氣泡旗標抓到的是錯的那種故障。當一叢讀值裡的十四個樣本彼此不一致時，旗標在 V1 上對其中 94% 觸發，在 V2 上對 79% 觸發。這讓故障即使無法校正，至少可以被偵測到。但當流通池完全充滿空氣時，十四個樣本完全一致，而且一起全錯：V1 讀到 0.74 到 0.91，真值卻是 3.18，旗標一次也沒抓到。這樣一叢讀值裡沒有任何東西看起來不正常。只有拿它跟前一筆讀值比較，才會顯露出來。

blocks.en: During the run, an external disturbance reduced both Slim channels to about 60% of their previous brightness. With reference normalization, the reported OD drifted by only −0.0005 OD/min, compared with 0.025 OD/min using the sample channel alone. That is the Slim's reference channel correcting a source-intensity change, caught in the act. The Pro reference channel did not show the same behavior, indicating that its two optical paths were not responding equally to the disturbance.

blocks.en: That last part is what the silica run predicted. At 37 hours the sample beam fell to a tenth of the reference and the reported value stepped to about 9.9 and stayed there. The gate caught it, marked the stretch as low signal, and the twin does not use it. Without the gate, four hours of a dead optical path would have entered the record as a culture at OD 9.9.

blocks.en: Silica calibrates the instrument, not the organism. A 1 µm bead is a sphere of refractive index 1.46 and density 2.3 g/cm³; a vegetative B. subtilis cell is a rod, often in chains, nearer 1.33 to 1.41 and 1.1 g/cm³. The ladder therefore converts a reading into equivalent particle counts and not into cell mass, and a dilution series of washed cells is still owed before the two can be related. The gates have a stated limit of their own: when an air slug lasts longer than 90 seconds, three agreeing readings make the wrong level acceptable. That is why line 3 above raises an alarm instead of silently correcting: a growing culture does not move 0.05 OD in 30 seconds, so any accepted step that large deserves a human look. On October 10 the real cause was an inlet tube that had fallen out of the beaker, and one alarm would have had someone put it back inside the first minute.

The ladder therefore converts a reading into equivalent particle counts and not into cell mass, and a dilution series of washed cells is still owed before the two can be related. The gates have a stated limit of their own: when an air slug lasts longer than 90 seconds, three agreeing readings make the wrong level acceptable. That is why line 3 above raises an alarm instead of silently correcting: a growing culture does not move 0.05 OD in 30 seconds, so any accepted step that large deserves a human look. On October 10 the real cause was an inlet tube that had fallen out of the beaker, and one alarm would have had someone put it back inside the first minute.
blocks.zh: 二氧化矽校正的是儀器，不是生物。一顆 1 µm 微球是折射率 1.46、密度 2.3 g/cm³ 的球體；一顆營養生長期的 B. subtilis 細胞是桿狀，常成鏈，折射率更接近 1.33 到 1.41，密度 1.1 g/cm³。因此這道階梯是把讀值換算成等效顆粒數，而不是細胞質量；要把兩者連起來，還欠一組洗過細胞的稀釋系列。這些閘門自身也有明言的限制：當氣柱持續超過 90 秒，三筆一致的讀值就會讓錯誤的水準被接受。這就是上面第 3 條要發出警報、而不是默默修正的原因：生長中的培養液不會在 30 秒內移動 0.05 OD，所以任何被接受的這麼大的階梯都值得人去看一眼。10 月 10 日真正的原因是一根進液管從燒杯裡掉了出來，而一次警報就能讓人在第一分鐘內把它放回去。

blocks.en: Optogenetic control

blocks.en: Can the light plate deliver a controlled signal for optogenetic activation? ReLEAF depends on light as the external control signal connecting environmental prediction to biological production. We therefore tested the light plate to determine whether it could provide reproducible illumination across the culture area.
blocks.text: Can the light plate deliver a controlled signal for optogenetic activation? ReLEAF depends on light as the external control signal connecting environmental prediction to biological production. We therefore tested the light plate to determine whether it could provide reproducible illumination across the culture area.
blocks.zh: 光照板能否送出受控的訊號以進行光遺傳活化？ReLEAF 依賴光作為外部控制訊號，把環境預測連到生物生產。因此我們測試光照板，判斷它能否在整個培養區域提供可重現的照明。

blocks.en: A predicted environmental condition is turned into a light input that tunes production of ACCD in Bacillus subtilis through the CcaSR red and green light-sensing system (Castillo-Hair et al., 2019). For that to work, light has to act as a reliable dial. We need to know whether low, medium and high intensities give clearly separated levels of ACCD expression, and whether the light itself affects cell growth. The Light Plate Apparatus is an open-hardware, 24-well platform with independently programmable LEDs in every well (Gerhardt et al., 2016), so several intensities of red and green can run side by side in one experiment on one culture. Following the established CcaSR protocol for B. subtilis (Haller et al., 2025), we track the response over time with OD600 and Western blot. The settings that give a reproducible, graded response become the intensity levels ReLEAF uses to control ACCD production, and because every conclusion depends on the plate, the plate is what we characterized first.
blocks.text: A predicted environmental condition is turned into a light input that tunes production of ACCD in Bacillus subtilis through the CcaSR red and green light-sensing system (Castillo-Hair et al., 2019). For that to work, light has to act as a reliable dial. We need to know whether low, medium and high intensities give clearly separated levels of ACCD expression, and whether the light itself affects cell growth. The Light Plate Apparatus is an open-hardware, 24-well platform with independently programmable LEDs in every well (Gerhardt et al., 2016), so several intensities of red and green can run side by side in one experiment on one culture. Following the established CcaSR protocol for B. subtilis (Haller et al., 2025), we track the response over time with OD600 and Western blot. The settings that give a reproducible, graded response become the intensity levels ReLEAF uses to control ACCD production, and because every conclusion depends on the plate, the plate is what we characterized first.
blocks.zh: 一個預測出來的環境條件會被轉成光輸入，透過 CcaSR 紅光與綠光感光系統調節 Bacillus subtilis 中 ACCD 的生產（Castillo-Hair et al., 2019）。要讓這件事成立，光必須像一個可靠的旋鈕。我們需要知道低、中、高強度是否給出清楚分開的 ACCD 表現量，以及光本身是否影響細胞生長。Light Plate Apparatus 是一個開源硬體的 24 孔平台，每個孔都有可獨立編程的 LED（Gerhardt et al., 2016），因此在同一次實驗、同一份培養液上可以並列跑好幾種紅光與綠光強度。依照已建立的 B. subtilis CcaSR 流程（Haller et al., 2025），我們以 OD600 與西方墨點法追蹤反應隨時間的變化。能給出可重現、分級反應的設定，就成為 ReLEAF 用來控制 ACCD 生產的強度等級；而由於每一項結論都取決於這塊板子，我們最先做的就是把這塊板子的特性量出來。

blocks.en: What the measurement contributes
blocks.text: What the measurement contributes
blocks.zh: 這項量測貢獻了什麼

blocks.en: The Light Plate Apparatus is a general platform for characterizing light-inducible gene expression, not a CcaSR instrument. A team can survey light-responsive genetic modules beyond CcaSR and fit LEDs matched to each module's activating wavelength, which turns the same plate into a characterization tool for a wide range of optogenetic systems. What we add is the step before that: a worked method for matching cheap single-bulb LEDs by measured output, so the wells in one column receive the same light and the columns differ from one another by a measured amount.

What we add is the step before that: a worked method for matching cheap single-bulb LEDs by measured output, so the wells in one column receive the same light and the columns differ from one another by a measured amount.
blocks.zh: Light Plate Apparatus 是用來描述光誘導基因表現特性的通用平台，而不是一具 CcaSR 專用儀器。團隊可以調查 CcaSR 以外的光反應基因模組，並換上與各模組活化波長相符的 LED，這就把同一塊板子變成適用於各類光遺傳系統的特性量測工具。我們加上去的是在那之前的一步：一套可操作的方法，依實測輸出把便宜的單顆 LED 配對起來，使同一欄的孔接收到相同的光，而各欄之間相差一個量測過的量。

blocks.en: Internal resistor variance is a common problem in cheap, single-bulb LEDs. By individually measuring the lumen output value of each LED, we were able to determine which of them have matching internal resistance. Upon finding these similarities among our purchased LEDs, we are able to form 3 groups of 4 LEDs to form columns within our LPA structure for each wavelength we use (we use 2). This will allow us to use mathematical calculations to recalibrate all of the columns of lumens to match, so that we can later create low, medium, and high intensity light to create variance for our B. subtilis protectant production testing.
blocks.text: Internal resistor variance is a common problem in cheap, single-bulb LEDs. By individually measuring the lumen output value of each LED, we were able to determine which of them have matching internal resistance. Upon finding these similarities among our purchased LEDs, we are able to form 3 groups of 4 LEDs to form columns within our LPA structure for each wavelength we use (we use 2). This will allow us to use mathematical calculations to recalibrate all of the columns of lumens to match, so that we can later create low, medium, and high intensity light to create variance for our B. subtilis protectant production testing.
blocks.zh: 內部電阻的差異是便宜的單顆 LED 常見的問題。逐顆量測每一顆 LED 的流明輸出值之後，我們就能判斷哪些 LED 的內部電阻彼此相符。在購入的 LED 中找出這些相近之處後，我們能為每一個使用的波長（我們用兩種）各組出 3 組、每組 4 顆 LED，在 LPA 結構中構成欄。這讓我們能用數學計算把各欄的流明重新校正到彼此相符，以便日後製造低、中、高強度的光，為我們的 B. subtilis 保護劑生產測試建立變化。

blocks.en: Expression therefore rises with time under green light but does not order itself by intensity, which is the opposite of what a usable dial has to do, and red at full power is not silent. The bands also run near the 63 to 75 kDa markers, while the secreted ACCD construct runs at about 37 kDa on the constitutive blot in the next section, so their identity is not settled by size alone. The scans and that argument are reproduced on Results; no expression claim rests on them here.

blocks.zh: 因此在綠光下表現量隨時間上升，卻不會依強度排序，這與一個可用的旋鈕該做的恰好相反，而全功率的紅光也不是沉默的。這些條帶的位置也接近 63 到 75 kDa 標記，而下一節組成型墨點中分泌的 ACCD 構築約在 37 kDa，因此僅憑大小並不能確定它們的身分。掃描圖與這項論證重現於結果頁；此處沒有任何表現量主張建立在它們之上。

blocks.en: Protectant assays
blocks.text: Protectant assays
blocks.zh: 保護劑檢測

blocks.en: Three measurements follow the protectant from presence to quantity to function. Western blotting asks whether the intended protein is produced and secreted at the expected size. ELISA then measures how much target protein is present, while the DNPH assay tests whether ACC deaminase retains catalytic activity. These measurements answer different questions and are therefore used together rather than interchangeably.
blocks.text: Three measurements follow the protectant from presence to quantity to function. Western blotting asks whether the intended protein is produced and secreted at the expected size. ELISA then measures how much target protein is present, while the DNPH assay tests whether ACC deaminase retains catalytic activity. These measurements answer different questions and are therefore used together rather than interchangeably.
blocks.zh: 三項量測跟著保護劑，從存在到數量再到功能。西方墨點法問的是：目標蛋白是否以預期的大小被生產並分泌出來。接著 ELISA 量測有多少目標蛋白，而 DNPH 檢測則檢驗 ACC 去胺酶是否仍保有催化活性。這些量測回答的是不同的問題，因此是搭配使用，而不是互相替代。

blocks.en: A plant assay gives the most complete answer to whether a protectant helps the crop, but it is slower and more sensitive to variation in plant growth and stress conditions. These biochemical measurements let us evaluate production directly at the protein level before moving to plant testing.
blocks.text: A plant assay gives the most complete answer to whether a protectant helps the crop, but it is slower and more sensitive to variation in plant growth and stress conditions. These biochemical measurements let us evaluate production directly at the protein level before moving to plant testing.
blocks.zh: 要回答保護劑是否幫助作物，植物檢測給出最完整的答案，但它較慢，也較容易受植物生長與逆境條件變異的影響。這些生化量測讓我們在進到植物測試之前，先直接在蛋白質層級評估生產情形。

blocks.en: They are ordered by cost. The Western blot is the cheap first screen: it says whether a band of the right size appears under a given production condition. Once the conditions are set, the ELISA is what turns that into a yield in µg/mL. Which assay settles a protectant then depends on what the molecule is.
blocks.text: They are ordered by cost. The Western blot is the cheap first screen: it says whether a band of the right size appears under a given production condition. Once the conditions are set, the ELISA is what turns that into a yield in µg/mL. Which assay settles a protectant then depends on what the molecule is.
blocks.zh: 它們是按成本排序的。西方墨點法是便宜的第一道篩選：它說明在給定的生產條件下，是否出現一條大小正確的條帶。條件定下來之後，ELISA 才是把它轉成 µg/mL 產量的工具。至於哪一項檢測能為一種保護劑定案，則取決於那個分子是什麼。

blocks.en: Enzymes. ACC deaminase has measurable catalytic activity, so after confirming its presence, the DNPH assay can test whether the enzyme is still functional.
blocks.text: Enzymes. ACC deaminase has measurable catalytic activity, so after confirming its presence, the DNPH assay can test whether the enzyme is still functional.
blocks.zh: 酵素。ACC 去胺酶具有可量測的催化活性，因此在確認它存在之後，DNPH 檢測可以檢驗這個酵素是否仍有功能。

blocks.en: Non-enzymatic proteins. LEA14 does not catalyze a reaction, so its evaluation depends on measuring how much protein is present rather than enzyme activity. ELISA is therefore used for quantification.
blocks.text: Non-enzymatic proteins. LEA14 does not catalyze a reaction, so its evaluation depends on measuring how much protein is present rather than enzyme activity. ELISA is therefore used for quantification.
blocks.zh: 非酵素蛋白質。LEA14 不催化反應，因此對它的評估取決於量測蛋白質有多少，而不是酵素活性。所以我們以 ELISA 進行定量。

blocks.en: To verify whether the engineered Bacillus subtilis could produce and secrete protein or peptide products, we performed a Western blot to detect the secreted protein via the His tag we added at the C-terminus.
blocks.text: To verify whether the engineered Bacillus subtilis could produce and secrete protein or peptide products, we performed a Western blot to detect the secreted protein via the His tag we added at the C-terminus.
blocks.zh: 為了確認改造後的 Bacillus subtilis 是否能生產並分泌蛋白質或胜肽產物，我們以西方墨點法，透過加在 C 端的 His 標籤偵測分泌出來的蛋白質。

blocks.en: Western blotting separates proteins by molecular weight using polyacrylamide gel electrophoresis, transfers them onto a PVDF membrane, and uses a specific antibody to visualize the target. Standard quantification assays return a total; they cannot tell our protein from the host's. The blot answers a narrower question that the total cannot: is a band present, and is it the size the construct predicts.
blocks.text: Western blotting separates proteins by molecular weight using polyacrylamide gel electrophoresis, transfers them onto a PVDF membrane, and uses a specific antibody to visualize the target. Standard quantification assays return a total; they cannot tell our protein from the host's. The blot answers a narrower question that the total cannot: is a band present, and is it the size the construct predicts.
blocks.zh: 西方墨點法以聚丙烯醯胺凝膠電泳依分子量分離蛋白質，再轉印到 PVDF 薄膜上，並以專一抗體把目標顯現出來。一般的定量檢測給出的是總量；它們無法把我們的蛋白質與宿主自身的蛋白質分開。墨點法回答的是總量回答不了的一個較窄的問題：是否有條帶出現，以及它是不是構築所預測的大小。

blocks.en: What the measurement contributes
blocks.text: What the measurement contributes
blocks.zh: 這項量測貢獻了什麼

blocks.en: Bioreactor supernatant is too dilute to blot as it comes, so the first thing this chapter contributes is the workflow that separates and concentrates it. With that in place, the anti-His antibody answers the two questions the blot is for: whether ACC deaminase is outside the cells at all, and whether the band sits where the construct says it should. We have written down the band positions that surprised us as well, since a fusion tag or incomplete denaturation moves the apparent weight and the next team should not have to rediscover that.
blocks.text: Bioreactor supernatant is too dilute to blot as it comes, so the first thing this chapter contributes is the workflow that separates and concentrates it. With that in place, the anti-His antibody answers the two questions the blot is for: whether ACC deaminase is outside the cells at all, and whether the band sits where the construct says it should. We have written down the band positions that surprised us as well, since a fusion tag or incomplete denaturation moves the apparent weight and the next team should not have to rediscover that.
blocks.zh: 生物反應器上清液太稀，無法直接拿來做墨點，所以本章首先貢獻的是把它分離與濃縮的工作流程。有了這一步，anti-His 抗體就能回答墨點法要回答的兩個問題：ACC 去胺酶究竟有沒有在細胞之外，以及條帶是否落在構築所說的位置。那些讓我們意外的條帶位置我們也寫了下來，因為融合標籤或變性不完全會改變表觀分子量，下一支團隊不該得再重新發現一次。

blocks.en: Sampling every two hours then turns the blot into a time course, which is how we found when production was highest before committing to the quantitative assays.
blocks.text: Sampling every two hours then turns the blot into a time course, which is how we found when production was highest before committing to the quantitative assays.

blocks.en: Assemble the holder, the 1.5 mm glass plates and the comb.

blocks.en: Using the TGX FastCast acrylamide solutions, prepare the resolver solution: resolver A 5 mL, resolver B 5 mL, 10% APS 50 µL, TEMED 5 µL.
blocks.text: Using the TGX FastCast acrylamide solutions, prepare the resolver solution: resolver A 5 mL, resolver B 5 mL, 10% APS 50 µL, TEMED 5 µL.

blocks.en: Fill with about 10 mL of resolver solution, to 1 to 1.5 cm below the bottom of the comb teeth.
blocks.text: Fill with about 10 mL of resolver solution, to 1 to 1.5 cm below the bottom of the comb teeth.
blocks.zh: 注入約 10 mL 分離膠溶液，到梳齒底部以下 1 到 1.5 cm 處。

blocks.en: Prepare the stacker solution: stacker A 1 mL, stacker B 1 mL, 10% APS 10 µL, TEMED 2 µL.
blocks.text: Prepare the stacker solution: stacker A 1 mL, stacker B 1 mL, 10% APS 10 µL, TEMED 2 µL.
blocks.zh: 配製堆積膠溶液：stacker A 1 mL、stacker B 1 mL、10% APS 10 µL、TEMED 2 µL。

blocks.en: Fill to the top with about 2 mL of stacker solution.
blocks.text: Fill to the top with about 2 mL of stacker solution.
blocks.zh: 以約 2 mL 堆積膠溶液注滿到頂。

blocks.en: Insert the comb and allow the gel to polymerize for 10 to 15 minutes.
blocks.text: Insert the comb and allow the gel to polymerize for 10 to 15 minutes.
blocks.zh: 插入梳子，讓膠聚合 10 到 15 分鐘。

blocks.en: Running and transferring 120 V through the gel, then 100 V for ninety minutes onto PVDF
blocks.text: Running and transferring 120 V through the gel, then 100 V for ninety minutes onto PVDF
blocks.zh: 跑膠與轉印 以 120 V 跑過膠，再以 100 V 轉印九十分鐘到 PVDF 上

blocks.en: SDS-PAGE resolving
