blocks.en: Remove the comb and mount the gel into the electrophoresis tank.
blocks.text: Remove the comb and mount the gel into the electrophoresis tank.
blocks.zh: 取下梳子，把膠裝進電泳槽。

blocks.en: Prepare the protein samples in 6× Laemmli protein sample buffer.
blocks.text: Prepare the protein samples in 6× Laemmli protein sample buffer.
blocks.zh: 以 6× Laemmli 蛋白質樣品緩衝液配製蛋白質樣品。

blocks.en: Heat samples at 95 °C for 5 minutes.
blocks.text: Heat samples at 95 °C for 5 minutes.
blocks.zh: 樣品在 95 °C 加熱 5 分鐘。

blocks.en: Briefly spin the samples down.
blocks.text: Briefly spin the samples down.
blocks.zh: 把樣品短暫離心下沉。

blocks.en: Fill the inner and outer chambers of the tank with 1× running buffer.
blocks.text: Fill the inner and outer chambers of the tank with 1× running buffer.
blocks.zh: 以 1× 跑膠緩衝液注滿電泳槽的內槽與外槽。

blocks.en: Load the protein ladder in the first and last lane, and the samples into the remaining wells.
blocks.text: Load the protein ladder in the first and last lane, and the samples into the remaining wells.
blocks.zh: 在第一道與最後一道上樣蛋白質標準品，其餘孔上樣品。

blocks.en: Close the lid and connect the electrodes.
blocks.text: Close the lid and connect the electrodes.
blocks.zh: 蓋上蓋子並接上電極。

blocks.en: Run at a constant 120 V for 30 minutes until the dye reaches the bottom of the stacking gel, then continue at a constant 120 V for 90 minutes until the dye is near the bottom of the gel.
blocks.text: Run at a constant 120 V for 30 minutes until the dye reaches the bottom of the stacking gel, then continue at a constant 120 V for 90 minutes until the dye is near the bottom of the gel.
blocks.zh: 以定電壓 120 V 跑 30 分鐘，直到染料到達堆積膠底部，再以定電壓 120 V 繼續跑 90 分鐘，直到染料接近膠的底部。

blocks.en: Carefully disassemble the glass plates and collect the gel.
blocks.text: Carefully disassemble the glass plates and collect the gel.
blocks.zh: 小心拆開玻璃板並取下膠。

blocks.en: Transfer
blocks.text: Transfer
blocks.zh: 轉印

blocks.en: Soak the PVDF membrane in methanol for 1 minute.
blocks.text: Soak the PVDF membrane in methanol for 1 minute.
blocks.zh: 把 PVDF 薄膜浸在甲醇中 1 分鐘。

blocks.en: Incubate the membrane in 1× transfer buffer for 3 minutes and the gel in 1× transfer buffer for 5 minutes.
blocks.text: Incubate the membrane in 1× transfer buffer for 3 minutes and the gel in 1× transfer buffer for 5 minutes.
blocks.zh: 把薄膜在 1× 轉印緩衝液中浸置 3 分鐘，膠在 1× 轉印緩衝液中浸置 5 分鐘。

blocks.en: Wet the 3M papers in 1× transfer buffer.
blocks.text: Wet the 3M papers in 1× transfer buffer.
blocks.zh: 以 1× 轉印緩衝液浸濕 3M 濾紙。

blocks.en: Assemble the sandwich in the cassette in the order sponge pad, filter paper, gel, PVDF membrane, filter paper, sponge pad. Ensure there are no air bubbles between the gel and the membrane.
blocks.text: Assemble the sandwich in the cassette in the order sponge pad, filter paper, gel, PVDF membrane, filter paper, sponge pad. Ensure there are no air bubbles between the gel and the membrane.
blocks.zh: 依海綿墊、濾紙、膠、PVDF 薄膜、濾紙、海綿墊的順序，在匣中疊好三明治。確認膠與薄膜之間沒有氣泡。

blocks.en: Place the cassette into the tank filled with cold 1× transfer buffer and an ice block.
blocks.text: Place the cassette into the tank filled with cold 1× transfer buffer and an ice block.
blocks.zh: 把匣放進裝有冰冷 1× 轉印緩衝液與冰塊的槽中。

blocks.en: Transfer at 100 V for 90 minutes, keeping the tank on ice.
blocks.text: Transfer at 100 V for 90 minutes, keeping the tank on ice.
blocks.zh: 以 100 V 轉印 90 分鐘，過程中把槽放在冰上。

blocks.text: Blotting and detection
blocks.zh: 墨點與偵測

blocks.en: Block in 5% non-fat milk in TBST for 1 hour at room temperature.
blocks.text: Block in 5% non-fat milk in TBST for 1 hour at room temperature.
blocks.zh: 以 TBST 中 5% 脫脂奶粉在室溫下封阻 1 小時。

blocks.en: Replace the blocking solution with anti-His-tag mouse monoclonal antibody at 1:1000 in 5% milk, and incubate on the orbital shaker at 4 °C overnight.
blocks.text: Replace the blocking solution with anti-His-tag mouse monoclonal antibody at 1:1000 in 5% milk, and incubate on the orbital shaker at 4 °C overnight.
blocks.zh: 把封阻液換成 5% 奶粉中 1:1000 的抗 His 標籤小鼠單株抗體，在 4 °C 的旋轉振盪器上培養過夜。

blocks.en: Remove the primary antibody and wash the membrane in TBST on the shaker three times, 10 minutes each.
blocks.text: Remove the primary antibody and wash the membrane in TBST on the shaker three times, 10 minutes each.
blocks.zh: 移除一級抗體，把薄膜在 TBST 中於振盪器上洗三次，每次 10 分鐘。

blocks.en: Incubate the PVDF membrane in the secondary antibody for 1 hour at room temperature.
blocks.text: Incubate the PVDF membrane in the secondary antibody for 1 hour at room temperature.
blocks.zh: 把 PVDF 薄膜在二級抗體中於室溫培養 1 小時。

blocks.en: Remove the secondary antibody and wash the membrane in TBST on the shaker six times, 10 minutes each.
blocks.text: Remove the secondary antibody and wash the membrane in TBST on the shaker six times, 10 minutes each.
blocks.zh: 移除二級抗體，把薄膜在 TBST 中於振盪器上洗六次，每次 10 分鐘。

blocks.en: Incubate the membrane in chemiluminescent substrate for 2 minutes.
blocks.text: Incubate the membrane in chemiluminescent substrate for 2 minutes.
blocks.zh: 把薄膜在化學發光底物中浸置 2 分鐘。

blocks.en: Image the membrane on the chemiluminescence imaging system.

blocks.en: Panel A — Expression and secretion. A single band appears in the culture supernatant at approximately 37 kDa, matching the expected size of the secreted ACC deaminase construct. The protein is expressed and it leaves the cell.

Because the fractions were loaded in the order 25, 10, 150, 250 mM, the gel shows which buffers recovered protein, but not a quantitative relationship between imidazole concentration and yield.

blocks.en: Competitive His-tag ELISA
blocks.text: Competitive His-tag ELISA
blocks.zh: 競爭型 His 標籤 ELISA

blocks.en: To compare protein production across strains, constructs, and culture conditions, we needed a measurement that could quantify the target recombinant protein, rather than total protein in the sample. Bradford-type assays cannot distinguish our protectants from native Bacillus subtilis proteins, while Western blotting is better suited to confirming presence and molecular weight than assigning an absolute concentration. We therefore used ELISA to convert antibody binding into a quantitative protein concentration.
blocks.text: To compare protein production across strains, constructs, and culture conditions, we needed a measurement that could quantify the target recombinant protein, rather than total protein in the sample. Bradford-type assays cannot distinguish our protectants from native Bacillus subtilis proteins, while Western blotting is better suited to confirming presence and molecular weight than assigning an absolute concentration. We therefore used ELISA to convert antibody binding into a quantitative protein concentration.
blocks.zh: 為了跨菌株、跨構築與跨培養條件比較蛋白質生產，我們需要一種能定量目標重組蛋白、而不是樣品中總蛋白的量測。Bradford 類檢測無法把我們的保護劑與 Bacillus subtilis 原生蛋白質分開，而西方墨點法比較適合確認存在與分子量，不適合給出絕對濃度。因此我們以 ELISA 把抗體結合轉換成定量的蛋白質濃度。

blocks.en: Why we chose a competitive ELISA
blocks.text: Why we chose a competitive ELISA
blocks.zh: 我們為什麼選競爭型 ELISA

blocks.en: Several ELISA formats could be used for protein quantification, but they require different detection strategies. A sandwich ELISA can provide high specificity, but it requires a matched capture-and-detection antibody pair for each target. Direct and indirect formats are simpler, but would still depend on target-specific detection for each of our protectants.
blocks.text: Several ELISA formats could be used for protein quantification, but they require different detection strategies. A sandwich ELISA can provide high specificity, but it requires a matched capture-and-detection antibody pair for each target. Direct and indirect formats are simpler, but would still depend on target-specific detection for each of our protectants.
blocks.zh: 可用於蛋白質定量的 ELISA 格式有好幾種，但它們需要不同的偵測策略。三明治式 ELISA 可以提供高度專一性，但每一個目標都需要一對相配的捕捉與偵測抗體。直接式與間接式比較簡單，但我們的每一種保護劑仍然各需要針對目標的偵測。

blocks.en: We chose a competitive His-tag ELISA because ACC deaminase, LEA14, and BoPep4 all contain the same polyhistidine tag (Bornhorst & Falke, 2000). One antibody and one plate format therefore cover all three proteins, with no separate antibody system per target, and many constructs and culture conditions can be compared on a single plate.
blocks.text: We chose a competitive His-tag ELISA because ACC deaminase, LEA14, and BoPep4 all contain the same polyhistidine tag (Bornhorst & Falke, 2000). One antibody and one plate format therefore cover all three proteins, with no separate antibody system per target, and many constructs and culture conditions can be compared on a single plate.
blocks.zh: 我們選了競爭型 His 標籤 ELISA，因為 ACC 去胺酶、LEA14 與 BoPep4 都帶有同樣的多組胺酸標籤（Bornhorst & Falke, 2000）。因此一種抗體、一種盤面格式就能涵蓋這三種蛋白質，不必為每一個目標另建抗體系統，而且許多構築與培養條件可以在同一塊盤上比較。

blocks.en: How the measurement works
blocks.text: How the measurement works
blocks.zh: 這項量測如何運作

blocks.en: In this format, His-tagged protein in the sample competes with a labeled His tracer for antibody binding. As target concentration increases, the signal decreases, and a standard curve converts that signal into protein concentration.
blocks.text: In this format, His-tagged protein in the sample competes with a labeled His tracer for antibody binding. As target concentration increases, the signal decreases, and a standard curve converts that signal into protein concentration.
blocks.zh: 在這個格式中，樣品裡帶 His 標籤的蛋白質會與標記過的 His 示蹤物競爭抗體結合。目標濃度愈高，訊號愈低，而標準曲線把那個訊號換算成蛋白質濃度。

blocks.en: What the measurement contributes
blocks.text: What the measurement contributes
blocks.zh: 這項量測貢獻了什麼

blocks.en: This assay adds the quantitative step that Western blotting cannot provide. It allows us to compare the amount of ACC deaminase, LEA14, and BoPep4 produced under different experimental conditions and to separate the question of how much protein is present from whether that protein is functional.
blocks.text: This assay adds the quantitative step that Western blotting cannot provide. It allows us to compare the amount of ACC deaminase, LEA14, and BoPep4 produced under different experimental conditions and to separate the question of how much protein is present from whether that protein is functional.
blocks.zh: 這項檢測補上了西方墨點法無法提供的定量步驟。它讓我們能比較在不同實驗條件下所生產的 ACC 去胺酶、LEA14 與 BoPep4 的量，並把「有多少蛋白質」與「那些蛋白質是否有功能」這兩個問題分開。

blocks.en: To evaluate the measurement itself, each plate includes a six-point standard curve, duplicate wells, blanks, non-specific-binding controls, and maximum-binding controls. These controls let us judge whether the assay is operating within its valid range before interpreting the samples.
blocks.text: To evaluate the measurement itself, each plate includes a six-point standard curve, duplicate wells, blanks, non-specific-binding controls, and maximum-binding controls. These controls let us judge whether the assay is operating within its valid range before interpreting the samples.

blocks.en: The same workflow can also be transferred to other microbial systems expressing His-tagged recombinant proteins, making it useful beyond ReLEAF as a common quantification method across multiple targets.

blocks.text: Blank-subtracted values use the mean blank of 0.132. Non-specific binding was 0.005 after blank correction, so almost nothing bound the plate without the antibody. Corrected maximum binding was 1.109, inside the 0.3 to 1.5 A.U. window the kit asks for, which is what makes every %B/B₀ below meaningful. blocks.zh: 扣除空白後的數值使用空白平均值 0.132。經空白校正後，非專一結合為 0.005，因此在沒有抗體的情況下幾乎沒有東西結合到盤上。校正後的最大結合為 1.109，落在套組所要求的 0.3 到 1.5 A.U. 視窗內，這也正是下面每一個 %B/B₀ 之所以有意義的原因。兩個 B₀ 孔讀到 1.311 與 1.181，這個每一個樣品都要除以的數值本身就有 11% 的落差，而這個落差會傳遞到這塊盤上的每一個濃度。

blocks.en: The instrument's default analysis treated the twelve standard wells as twelve separate concentrations instead of six concentrations measured in duplicate, producing an unusable fit. We therefore refit the same absorbance data using the correct six standard concentrations. A constrained four-parameter logistic model gave R² = 0.98, with the standard curve spanning 31.6–95.1% B/B₀. Sample values outside it are extrapolations, and are reported as such.
blocks.text: The instrument's default analysis treated the twelve standard wells as twelve separate concentrations instead of six concentrations measured in duplicate, producing an unusable fit. We therefore refit the same absorbance data using the correct six standard concentrations. A constrained four-parameter logistic model gave R² = 0.98, with the standard curve spanning 31.6–95.1% B/B₀. Sample values outside it are extrapolations, and are reported as such.
blocks.zh: 儀器的預設分析把十二個標準品孔當成十二個不同的濃度，而不是六個濃度各做兩重複，產生了無法使用的擬合。因此我們以正確的六個標準品濃度，對同一批吸光值數據重新擬合。受約束的四參數邏輯斯模型得到 R² = 0.98，標準曲線涵蓋 31.6–95.1% B/B₀。落在這個範圍之外的樣品數值屬於外插，我們也照此註明。

blocks.en: Standard curve for His-tagged protein. Six concentrations from 0.093 to 3 µg/mL, measured in duplicate and expressed as a percentage of maximum binding. The plotted trend is logarithmic, y = −17.984 ln(x) + 52.996, R² = 0.9967; the concentrations in the tables are read from the constrained four-parameter logistic fit.
blocks.text: Standard curve for His-tagged protein. Six concentrations from 0.093 to 3 µg/mL, measured in duplicate and expressed as a percentage of maximum binding. The plotted trend is logarithmic, y = −17.984 ln(x) + 52.996, R² = 0.9967; the concentrations in the tables are read from the constrained four-parameter logistic fit.
blocks.zh: 帶 His 標籤蛋白質的標準曲線。六個濃度從 0.093 到 3 µg/mL，各做兩重複，並以最大結合的百分比表示。圖上繪出的趨勢為對數式，y = −17.984 ln(x) + 52.996，R² = 0.9967；表中的濃度則由受約束的四參數邏輯斯擬合讀出。

blocks.en: LEA14 produced the most consistent quantitative result. Across both trials, all four LEA14 measurements fell within the validated 20–80% B/B₀ range, and paired dilutions agreed within 10%, giving concentrations of approximately 5 µg/mL. ACC deaminase fell below the lower end of the standard curve in all four measurements, so those concentrations are extrapolations and not quantities. BoPep4 remained within the curve, but larger differences between paired dilutions indicate possible matrix interference and the need for further dilution testing.

blocks.en: At 13 hours both green samples read above both red ones, 12.4 and 13.4 against 11.5 and 12.1. At 16 hours the two conditions overlap completely. The spread within a condition, 11.5 to 12.5 for red at either time, is as large as the gap between conditions, so this does not show light-regulated expression; it shows that if there is a difference, this assay at this replication cannot resolve it. That is the same conclusion the optogenetic blots reach by a different route, and the two agree: the switch has not been demonstrated to work.

blocks.zh: 在 13 小時，兩個綠光樣品都高於兩個紅光樣品，12.4 與 13.4 對 11.5 與 12.1。到 16 小時，兩種條件完全重疊。同一條件內的散佈——紅光在兩個時間點都是 11.5 到 12.5——與兩種條件之間的差距一樣大，所以這並沒有顯示光調控的表現；它顯示的是：若真有差異，這項檢測在這個重複數下無法分辨。這與光遺傳墨點經由另一條路得到的結論相同，兩者一致：這個開關尚未被證明可以運作。

blocks.en: One thing this assay cannot do, whatever its precision: anti-His ELISA counts protein carrying a His tag. It says nothing about whether that protein folds or turns substrate over. Activity is what the DNPH assay in this section is for, and the two numbers should never be substituted for one another.
blocks.text: One thing this assay cannot do, whatever its precision: anti-His ELISA counts protein carrying a His tag. It says nothing about whether that protein folds or turns substrate over. Activity is what the DNPH assay in this section is for, and the two numbers should never be substituted for one another.
blocks.zh: 不論精度如何，這項檢測有一件事做不到：anti-His ELISA 數的是帶有 His 標籤的蛋白質。它完全沒有說明那個蛋白質是否折疊、是否能把底物轉換掉。活性才是本節 DNPH 檢測要處理的事，而這兩個數字絕不該互相替代。

blocks.en: ACC deaminase activity by DNPH assay
blocks.text: ACC deaminase activity by DNPH assay
blocks.zh: 以 DNPH 檢測量測 ACC 去胺酶活性

blocks.en: Western blotting shows whether ACC deaminase is present; the DNPH assay asks whether that protein is still catalytically active. ACC deaminase cleaves ACC into α-ketobutyrate and ammonia, so we measure the α-ketobutyrate produced as a direct readout of enzyme activity.
blocks.text: Western blotting shows whether ACC deaminase is present; the DNPH assay asks whether that protein is still catalytically active. ACC deaminase cleaves ACC into α-ketobutyrate and ammonia, so we measure the α-ketobutyrate produced as a direct readout of enzyme activity.
blocks.zh: 西方墨點法顯示 ACC 去胺酶是否存在；DNPH 檢測問的是那個蛋白質是否仍有催化活性。ACC 去胺酶把 ACC 裂解成 α-酮丁酸與氨，因此我們量測所生成的 α-酮丁酸，作為酵素活性的直接讀值。

blocks.en: Under acidic conditions, DNPH reacts with the carbonyl group of α-ketobutyrate to form a hydrazone that is quantified at 540 nm (Penrose & Glick, 2003; Kozaeva et al., 2022). We chose this product-based measurement because ACC substrate does not interfere strongly with the readout, culture-medium background is lower than for ammonium detection, and the method is sensitive enough to compare enzyme activity across constructs and conditions.
blocks.text: Under acidic conditions, DNPH reacts with the carbonyl group of α-ketobutyrate to form a hydrazone that is quantified at 540 nm (Penrose & Glick, 2003; Kozaeva et al., 2022). We chose this product-based measurement because ACC substrate does not interfere strongly with the readout, culture-medium background is lower than for ammonium detection, and the method is sensitive enough to compare enzyme activity across constructs and conditions.
blocks.zh: 在酸性條件下，DNPH 與 α-酮丁酸的羰基反應生成腙，可在 540 nm 下定量（Penrose & Glick, 2003; Kozaeva et al., 2022）。我們選擇這種以產物為基礎的量測，因為 ACC 底物不會強烈干擾讀值，培養基背景也比偵測銨離子時更低，而且這個方法的靈敏度足以跨構築與跨條件比較酵素活性。

blocks.en: Paired with expression measurements, it distinguishes protein that is merely present from protein that remains functional after secretion.
blocks.text: Paired with expression measurements, it distinguishes protein that is merely present from protein that remains functional after secretion.
blocks.zh: 與表現量的量測搭配，它能把「只是存在」的蛋白質與「分泌之後仍有功能」的蛋白質區分開。

blocks.en: What the measurement contributes
blocks.text: What the measurement contributes
blocks.zh: 這項量測貢獻了什麼

blocks.en: We scaled the conventional protocol of Penrose and Glick (2003) down twenty-fold while holding the reaction proportions, which moves the assay onto a 96-well microplate and makes screening a strain library practical. With it we compared ACC deaminase activity across constructs, tested what pyridoxal 5'-phosphate supplementation does to that activity, and checked that recombinant ACCD secreted by our engineered Bacillus subtilis still functions outside the cell. We also set up the standard curve and the arithmetic that converts an absorbance into an α-ketobutyrate concentration, a total product yield and an activity, so the comparison between strains rests on a stated calculation.
blocks.text: We scaled the conventional protocol of Penrose and Glick (2003) down twenty-fold while holding the reaction proportions, which moves the assay onto a 96-well microplate and makes screening a strain library practical. With it we compared ACC deaminase activity across constructs, tested what pyridoxal 5'-phosphate supplementation does to that activity, and checked that recombinant ACCD secreted by our engineered Bacillus subtilis still functions outside the cell. We also set up the standard curve and the arithmetic that converts an absorbance into an α-ketobutyrate concentration, a total product yield and an activity, so the comparison between strains rests on a stated calculation.
blocks.zh: 我們在維持反應比例的前提下，把 Penrose 與 Glick（2003）的常規流程縮小了二十倍，使檢測移到 96 孔微盤上，讓篩選一整個菌株庫變得可行。我們用它比較了不同構築的 ACC 去胺酶活性，測試了補充吡哆醛 5'-磷酸對該活性的作用，並確認我們改造的 Bacillus subtilis 所分泌的重組 ACCD 在細胞之外仍有功能。我們也建立了標準曲線，以及把吸光值換算成 α-酮丁酸濃度、總產物量與活性的算式，使菌株之間的比較建立在一套寫明的計算上。

blocks.en: Reagents and solutions DNPH in 2 N HCl, the PLP buffer, and the α-ketobutyrate standard
blocks.text: Reagents and solutions DNPH in 2 N HCl, the PLP buffer, and the α-ketobutyrate standard
blocks.zh: 試劑與溶液 2 N HCl 中的 DNPH、PLP 緩衝液，以及 α-酮丁酸標準品

blocks.en: DNPH solution, 0.2% w/v in 2 N HCl. Dissolve 0.20 g of 2,4-dinitrophenylhydrazine powder in 100 mL of 2 N HCl. Protect from light with aluminum foil and store at 4 °C. Handle the 2 N HCl with acid-resistant gloves and safety goggles, and work in a fume hood.
blocks.text: DNPH solution, 0.2% w/v in 2 N HCl. Dissolve 0.20 g of 2,4-dinitrophenylhydrazine powder in 100 mL of 2 N HCl. Protect from light with aluminum foil and store at 4 °C. Handle the 2 N HCl with acid-resistant gloves and safety goggles, and work in a fume hood.
blocks.zh: DNPH 溶液，於 2 N HCl 中 0.2% w/v。把 0.20 g 2,4-二硝基苯肼粉末溶於 100 mL 的 2 N HCl。以鋁箔避光，於 4 °C 保存。操作 2 N HCl 時要戴耐酸手套與安全護目鏡，並在抽氣櫃中進行。

blocks.en: Hydrochloric acid, 0.56 N. Dilute concentrated HCl (12 N) with ultrapure water. Used to quench the reaction and to stabilize the acid-catalyzed step.
blocks.text: Hydrochloric acid, 0.56 N. Dilute concentrated HCl (12 N) with ultrapure water. Used to quench the reaction and to stabilize the acid-catalyzed step.
blocks.zh: 鹽酸，0.56 N。以超純水稀釋濃鹽酸（12 N）。用於終止反應並穩定酸催化步驟。

blocks.en: Sodium hydroxide, 2 N. Dissolve 8.0 g of NaOH pellets in deionized water to a total volume of 100 mL. The reaction is exothermic, so prepare it in an ice bath.
blocks.text: Sodium hydroxide, 2 N. Dissolve 8.0 g of NaOH pellets in deionized water to a total volume of 100 mL. The reaction is exothermic, so prepare it in an ice bath.
blocks.zh: 氫氧化鈉，2 N。把 8.0 g NaOH 顆粒溶於去離子水，總體積 100 mL。此反應放熱，因此要在冰浴中配製。

blocks.en: ACC substrate, 0.5 M. Dissolve 50.55 mg ACC per 1.0 mL deionized water, store at −20 °C, and pre-equilibrate at 30 °C for at least 3 minutes before use.
blocks.text: ACC substrate, 0.5 M. Dissolve 50.55 mg ACC per 1.0 mL deionized water, store at −20 °C, and pre-equilibrate at 30 °C for at least 3 minutes before use.
blocks.zh: ACC 底物，0.5 M。每 1.0 mL 去離子水溶解 50.55 mg ACC，於 −20 °C 保存，使用前先在 30 °C 平衡至少 3 分鐘。

blocks.en: 20× reaction buffer. 1 M phosphate buffer pH 8.5 containing 250 µM PLP. Store at 4 °C away from light and use within two weeks.
blocks.text: 20× reaction buffer. 1 M phosphate buffer pH 8.5 containing 250 µM PLP. Store at 4 °C away from light and use within two weeks.
blocks.zh: 20× 反應緩衝液。1 M 磷酸緩衝液 pH 8.5，含 250 µM PLP。於 4 °C 避光保存，兩週內使用。

blocks.en: α-ketobutyrate primary standard, 10 mM. Dissolve 12.4 mg sodium 2-oxobutyrate (MW 124.7) per 10 mL water. Prepare on ice, fresh each day.
blocks.text: α-ketobutyrate primary standard, 10 mM. Dissolve 12.4 mg sodium 2-oxobutyrate (MW 124.7) per 10 mL water. Prepare on ice, fresh each day.
blocks.zh: α-酮丁酸一級標準品，10 mM。每 10 mL 水溶解 12.4 mg 2-氧丁酸鈉（分子量 124.7）。在冰上配製，每日新鮮配製。

blocks.en: Procedure overnight at 30 °C, quench, color, read at 540 nm
blocks.text: Procedure overnight at 30 °C, quench, color, read at 540 nm
blocks.zh: 流程 30 °C 過夜、終止、顯色，於 540 nm 讀值

blocks.en: Mix 100 µL of filtered culture supernatant with 12 µL of 20× reaction buffer and 10 µL of 0.5 M ACC substrate, giving a 122 µL reaction with a final ACC concentration of 41 mM. Incubate at 30 °C overnight.
blocks.text: Mix 100 µL of filtered culture supernatant with 12 µL of 20× reaction buffer and 10 µL of 0.5 M ACC substrate, giving a 122 µL reaction with a final ACC concentration of 41 mM. Incubate at 30 °C overnight.

blocks.en: Transfer 10 µL of the reaction mixture into 50 µL of 0.56 N HCl in a 1.5 mL microtube and vortex immediately to precipitate the protein.
blocks.text: Transfer 10 µL of the reaction mixture into 50 µL of 0.56 N HCl in a 1.5 mL microtube and vortex immediately to precipitate the protein.

blocks.en: Centrifuge at 12 000 ×g for 5 minutes at room temperature, then transfer 50 µL of the clear supernatant into a clean microtube.
blocks.text: Centrifuge at 12 000 ×g for 5 minutes at room temperature, then transfer 50 µL of the clear supernatant into a clean microtube.
blocks.zh: 在室溫下以 12 000 ×g 離心 5 分鐘，再把 50 µL 澄清上清液移到乾淨的微量管。

blocks.zh: 由於 DNPH 檢測需要加入上清液，我們擔心上清液會影響算出來的結果。然而實驗數據顯示，加入與未加入上清液的兩條校正曲線仍然平行，只呈現一個固定的吸光值偏移，表示這是培養基背景，而不是檢測靈敏度改變。因此在後續實驗中，我們只校正空白，不改動校正曲線的斜率。

blocks.en: The optogenetic work in the light plate section asks whether green light turns ACC deaminase on, and answers it with blots: expression rises with time under green but does not order itself by intensity, and red at full power is not silent. A blot can only say a protein is there. This assay can say whether what is there is working, so we ran the same question through it three times, on cultures held in the dark and then illuminated. All three are single plates of a few wells, and the error bars are technical replicates within a plate.
blocks.text: The optogenetic work in the light plate section asks whether green light turns ACC deaminase on, and answers it with blots: expression rises with time under green but does not order itself by intensity, and red at full power is not silent. A blot can only say a protein is there. This assay can say whether what is there is working, so we ran the same question through it three times, on cultures held in the dark and then illuminated. All three are single plates of a few wells, and the error bars are technical replicates within a plate.
blocks.zh: 光照板那一節的光遺傳工作問的是綠光是否把 ACC 去胺酶打開，而它以墨點作答：在綠光下表現量隨時間上升，卻不依強度排序，而全功率的紅光也不是沉默的。墨點只能說一個蛋白質在那裡。這項檢測能說那裡的東西是否在作用，所以我們用它把同一個問題跑了三次，對象是先置於暗中、再給光的培養液。三次都只是幾個孔的單一盤，而誤差棒是同一塊盤內的技術重複。

blocks.en: Fig 4. Light-Induced ACCD Activity. The DNPH assay showed ACCD activity under green light following a 16 h dark culture. Supernatants were collected at 3 and 6 h after the onset of illumination. The data showed that activity decreased dramatically over the following 3 h. G refers to green light.

blocks.en: Fig 5. Maturation and Light Exposure Comparison. The DNPH assay showed ACCD activity after 13 and 16 h of culture under green or red light. Supernatants were collected at each time point. The highest activity was observed at 13 h under green light, indicating responsiveness to green light. However, it decreased dramatically over the following 3 h. G and R refer to green and red light, respectively.

Supernatants were collected at each time point. The highest activity was observed at 13 h under green light, indicating responsiveness to green light. blocks.zh: 圖 5. 成熟時間與光照比較。DNPH 檢測顯示在綠光或紅光下培養 13 與 16 h 之後的 ACCD 活性。每個時間點都採集上清液。最高活性出現在綠光下 13 h，顯示對綠光有反應。不過它在隨後的 3 h 內大幅下降。G 與 R 分別指綠光與紅光。

blocks.en: Green light does something, and it does not last. Three hours after the lamp comes on, the illuminated culture is at about 19.7 µg/mL of α-ketobutyrate; three hours later it is at about 5. Whatever the switch releases is spent, degraded or outrun by the culture within the first few hours, which is a different failure from never switching at all and matters for a reactor that is meant to dose on demand.
blocks.text: Green light does something, and it does not last. Three hours after the lamp comes on, the illuminated culture is at about 19.7 µg/mL of α-ketobutyrate; three hours later it is at about 5. Whatever the switch releases is spent, degraded or outrun by the culture within the first few hours, which is a different failure from never switching at all and matters for a reactor that is meant to dose on demand.
blocks.zh: 綠光確實做了某件事，而且它不持久。燈亮之後三小時，照光的培養液約為 19.7 µg/mL 的 α-酮丁酸；再過三小時，約為 5。這個開關所釋放的東西，不論是什麼，在最初幾小時內就被耗盡、降解，或被培養液的生長追過；這與「從來沒有切換」是不同的失敗，而對一具本該隨需投藥的反應器來說，這件事很重要。

blocks.en: How long the culture has grown changes which color wins. At 13 hours, green returns 0.1249 mM against red's 0.0089 mM, a fourteenfold separation and the cleanest light response this assay has produced. At 16 hours the order inverts: red reads 0.0923 mM and green 0.0130 mM. Three hours of extra culture is enough to turn a fourteenfold green preference into a red one, so how long the cells have grown sets what the assay reads as much as the color does. Neither point is repeated, and the 13 hour green error bar runs from about 5 to 16 on the activity scale, so the separation is wide but the value is not.

At 16 hours the order inverts: red reads 0.0923 mM and green 0.0130 mM. Three hours of extra culture is enough to turn a fourteenfold green preference into a red one, so how long the cells have grown sets what the assay reads as much as the color does. Neither point is repeated, and the 13 hour green error bar runs from about 5 to 16 on the activity scale, so the separation is wide but the value is not.
blocks.zh: 培養了多久，會改變哪一種顏色勝出。在 13 小時，綠光得到 0.1249 mM，紅光為 0.0089 mM，相差十四倍，是這項檢測產生過最乾淨的光反應。到 16 小時，次序反轉：紅光讀到 0.0923 mM，綠光 0.0130 mM。多培養三小時就足以把十四倍的綠光優勢翻轉成紅光優勢，所以細胞生長了多久，與顏色一樣決定了檢測讀到什麼。這兩個時間點都沒有重複，而 13 小時綠光的誤差棒在活性尺度上從約 5 延伸到 16，因此分離很大，數值卻不穩。

blocks.en: A 12 hour dark pre-culture, then green or red light, sampled at 3, 6 and 8 hours. Baseline is the reading taken before the lamp came on.
blocks.text: A 12 hour dark pre-culture, then green or red light, sampled at 3, 6 and 8 hours. Baseline is the reading taken before the lamp came on.
blocks.zh: 12 小時暗培養之後給綠光或紅光，於 3、6 與 8 小時採樣。基線是燈亮之前所取的讀值。

blocks.en: With a shorter pre-culture, both colors climb together. Twelve hours in the dark and then light gives the one monotonic series in this set: every illuminated group is above the pre-illumination baseline of about 2.8 µg/mL, and both arms rise at 3, 6 and 8 hours to end near 18 and 16. Green sits above red at each matched time in the figure, but the gap is inside the error bars at 3 and 8 hours, and the draft's own numeric write-up of this plate puts red above green at those two points. We have not quoted a fold difference per color here because the two records disagree on which way round it runs; what the plate supports is that illumination raises activity several-fold over a dark baseline, and that it keeps rising through 8 hours.

blocks.zh: 前培養較短時，兩種顏色一起上升。在暗中十二小時再給光，得到這一組中唯一單調的系列：每一個照光組都高於照光前約 2.8 µg/mL 的基線，而兩條分支在 3、6 與 8 小時都上升，最後接近 18 與 16。圖中綠光在每一個相配的時間點都高於紅光，但在 3 與 8 小時這個差距落在誤差棒之內，而草稿自己對這塊盤的數值描述則把紅光放在綠光之上。我們在這裡沒有引用各顏色的倍數差異，因為兩份紀錄對它的方向並不一致；這塊盤所支持的是：照光把活性提高到暗中基線的數倍，而且到 8 小時仍在上升。

blocks.en: Taken together these three runs say more than the blots do and less than the circuit needs. Activity above a dark baseline is real and repeats across plates. A clean, ordered, color-specific response is not: it appears at 13 hours, inverts at 16, and washes out against red in the pre-cultured series. The honest statement is that the switch moves ACC deaminase activity and that we have not yet established the conditions under which it moves it predictably. The experiment that would settle it is the obvious one and is not in the record: the same culture, one maturation time, both colors, repeated.

blocks.zh: 三次運轉合起來，說得比墨點多，卻比這個迴路所需要的少。高於暗中基線的活性是真實的，而且在不同盤之間重現。乾淨、有次序、對顏色專一的反應則不是：它在 13 小時出現，在 16 小時反轉，而在前培養的那一系列中又被紅光沖散。誠實的說法是：這個開關會改變 ACC 去胺酶的活性，而我們還沒有確立在哪些條件下它會可預測地改變它。能夠為此定案的實驗是顯而易見的那一個，而它不在紀錄裡：同一份培養液、一個成熟時間、兩種顏色，並重複進行。

blocks.en: This method is also what read the reactor permeate on 7 and 8 October, where it gave the only activity figure the project has for material coming out of the bioreactor, 7.25 mU/mL. Those readings are reported under the runs on Digital Twin and carried into the validation table on Development; like the plates here, each is a single sample.

blocks.en: Four measurements share two growing platforms. The agar assay sets the stress and the dose on a flat surface; the hydroponic assay puts the same protectants in front of a root system standing in liquid. The chlorophyll extraction reads how much photosynthetic machinery survived either one, and the physical measurements give the root length and the fresh weight that every chlorophyll number is normalized against.

blocks.en: To know whether a protectant rescues a stressed plant, and whether the timing of the dose matters, we needed a platform where the stress dose, the protectant and the timing could each be changed one at a time. Arabidopsis thaliana seedlings on ½ Murashige and Skoog agar (Murashige & Skoog, 1962) are that platform.
blocks.text: To know whether a protectant rescues a stressed plant, and whether the timing of the dose matters, we needed a platform where the stress dose, the protectant and the timing could each be changed one at a time. Arabidopsis thaliana seedlings on ½ Murashige and Skoog agar (Murashige & Skoog, 1962) are that platform.
blocks.zh: 要知道一種保護劑是否能救回受逆境的植物，以及投藥的時機是否重要，我們需要一個能讓逆境劑量、保護劑與時機各自單獨改變的平台。在 ½ Murashige and Skoog 瓊脂（Murashige & Skoog, 1962）上生長的阿拉伯芥（Arabidopsis thaliana）幼苗就是這個平台。

blocks.en: Salinity stress damages plants in readable ways. Exposure of Arabidopsis to NaCl alters stress-response gene expression (Cheng et al., 2013; Rolly et al., 2020) and, at the whole-seedling level, stunts root growth, bleaches leaves through loss of chlorophyll (chlorosis), and turns leaves purple through anthocyanin accumulation. Stress ethylene contributes to these effects as it inhibits root elongation (Růžička et al., 2007) and impairs photosynthesis (Ceusters & Van De Poel, 2018), which is the reason why the bacterial enzyme ACC deaminase (ACCD), which breaks down the ethylene precursor ACC, is one of our protectants (Glick, 2014). With the damage showing up in root length differences, biomass and leaf pigment, a protectant that works should be able to lengthen roots, raise biomass, and preserve chlorophyll compared with a stressed and untreated plate.
blocks.text: Salinity stress damages plants in readable ways. Exposure of Arabidopsis to NaCl alters stress-response gene expression (Cheng et al., 2013; Rolly et al., 2020) and, at the whole-seedling level, stunts root growth, bleaches leaves through loss of chlorophyll (chlorosis), and turns leaves purple through anthocyanin accumulation. Stress ethylene contributes to these effects as it inhibits root elongation (Růžička et al., 2007) and impairs photosynthesis (Ceusters & Van De Poel, 2018), which is the reason why the bacterial enzyme ACC deaminase (ACCD), which breaks down the ethylene precursor ACC, is one of our protectants (Glick, 2014). With the damage showing up in root length differences, biomass and leaf pigment, a protectant that works should be able to lengthen roots, raise biomass, and preserve chlorophyll compared with a stressed and untreated plate.
blocks.zh: 鹽逆境對植物的傷害是可以讀出來的。Arabidopsis 暴露於 NaCl 會改變逆境反應基因的表現（Cheng et al., 2013; Rolly et al., 2020），而在整株幼苗的層級上，則會抑制根的生長、因葉綠素流失而使葉片白化（黃化），並因花青素累積而使葉片轉紫。逆境乙烯也促成這些效應，因為它抑制根的伸長（Růžička et al., 2007）並損害光合作用（Ceusters & Van De Poel, 2018）；這也是為什麼能分解乙烯前驅物 ACC 的細菌酵素 ACC 去胺酶（ACCD）是我們的保護劑之一（Glick, 2014）。由於傷害表現在根長差異、生物量與葉片色素上，一種有效的保護劑應該能相較於受逆境而未處理的培養盤，使根變長、生物量提高，並保住葉綠素。

blocks.en: Agar buys three things soil cannot. Every seedling gets identical nutrients and an exact stress dose, where soil varies in moisture, pH and minerals from pot to pot. Physiological changes show within days, so many conditions can be screened quickly. And it fixes the salinity window, the protectant dose and the protocol before any of them are carried into soil.
blocks.text: Agar buys three things soil cannot. Every seedling gets identical nutrients and an exact stress dose, where soil varies in moisture, pH and minerals from pot to pot. Physiological changes show within days, so many conditions can be screened quickly. And it fixes the salinity window, the protectant dose and the protocol before any of them are carried into soil.
blocks.zh: 瓊脂買到了三件土壤給不了的事。每一株幼苗都得到完全相同的養分與精確的逆境劑量，而土壤的濕度、pH 與礦物在盆與盆之間都不一樣。生理變化在幾天內就顯現，因此可以快速篩選許多條件。而且它能在任何條件被帶進土壤之前，先把鹽度視窗、保護劑劑量與流程定下來。

We used them for the CH bio peptide and ACCD experiments in Phases 2 and 3, where treatment timing of salinity was a variable (pre-treatment, co-treatment, post-treatment). blocks.en: The experiments ran in three phases, ordered so that each one checked the platform before the next relied on it. Phase 1 used trehalose, a disaccharide reported to protect Arabidopsis under salinity stress (Kim et al., 2025), to find a NaCl level that gives a readable signal and to confirm the platform can show a rescue. Phase 2 used the CH Bio peptide, a commercial product from CH Biotech, as the reference protectant and to test application timing. Phase 3 used ACC deaminase, LEA14, and BoPep4 secreted by our engineered Bacillus subtilis. A heat-stress version of the assay, based on published thermopriming protocols (Lee et al., 2023; Auverlot et al., 2025), was designed for the same protectants.

Phase 2 used the CH Bio peptide, a commercial product from CH Biotech, as the reference protectant and to test application timing. Phase 3 used ACC deaminase, LEA14, and BoPep4 secreted by our engineered Bacillus subtilis. A heat-stress version of the assay, based on published thermopriming protocols (Lee et al., 2023; Auverlot et al., 2025), was designed for the same protectants.
blocks.zh: 實驗分三個階段進行，順序安排成每一階段都先檢查平台，下一階段才依賴它。第 1 階段使用海藻糖——一種據報在鹽逆境下能保護 Arabidopsis 的雙醣（Kim et al., 2025）——以找出能給出可讀訊號的 NaCl 濃度，並確認這個平台能呈現救援效果。第 2 階段使用 CH Bio 胜肽，這是來自 CH Biotech 的市售產品，作為參考保護劑，並用來測試施用時機。第 3 階段使用由我們改造的 Bacillus subtilis 所分泌的 ACC 去胺酶、LEA14 與 BoPep4。此外還依已發表的熱預適應流程（Lee et al., 2023; Auverlot et al., 2025），為同一批保護劑設計了熱逆境版本的檢測。

blocks.text: What the platform is useful for

blocks.en: Seedlings on agar are one of the most widely used formats in plant biology and the platform described here applies beyond our project in several ways.
blocks.text: Seedlings on agar are one of the most widely used formats in plant biology and the platform described here applies beyond our project in several ways.
blocks.zh: 瓊脂上的幼苗是植物生物學中最常用的形式之一，而這裡所描述的平台在我們的專題之外，還有好幾種用途。

blocks.en: Screening for salt-tolerance of plants. Arabidopsis grown on agar supplemented with NaCl is a standard way to test how genes, mutants, or treatments change salt tolerance (Cheng et al., 2013; Rolly et al., 2020). Our dose-response data tested salinity concentrations of 75, 100, 150 and 250 mM NaCl, read against the control group on the same plate. At 75 mM, fresh weight and total chlorophyll stayed near control levels. At 100 mM growth was clearly reduced and the rescue effect was still visible, which is what makes it the working concentration. At 150 mM growth was stunted to about the same degree as at 100 mM but with little rescue, total chlorophyll fell sharply, and anthocyanin accumulated enough to purple the leaves. At 250 mM close to every sample showed chlorosis and severe bleaching and none recovered. The boundaries are approximate percentages of control and not fixed thresholds, because each trial differed. The discovery allows future researchers to skip the pretests and begin in the 75 to 100 mM window where growth is reduced but rescue is still visible.

Arabidopsis grown on agar supplemented with NaCl is a standard way to test how genes, mutants, or treatments change salt tolerance (Cheng et al., 2013; Rolly et al., 2020). Our dose-response data tested salinity concentrations of 75, 100, 150 and 250 mM NaCl, read against the control group on the same plate. At 75 mM, fresh weight and total chlorophyll stayed near control levels. At 100 mM growth was clearly reduced and the rescue effect was still visible, which is what makes it the working concentration. At 150 mM growth was stunted to about the same degree as at 100 mM but with little rescue, total chlorophyll fell sharply, and anthocyanin accumulated enough to purple the leaves. At 250 mM close to every sample showed chlorosis and severe bleaching and none recovered. The boundaries are approximate percentages of control and not fixed thresholds, because each trial differed. The discovery allows future researchers to skip the pretests and begin in the 75 to 100 mM window where growth is reduced but rescue is still visible.
blocks.zh: 篩選植物的耐鹽性。生長在添加 NaCl 的瓊脂上的 Arabidopsis 是檢驗基因、突變體或處理如何改變耐鹽性的標準方法（Cheng et al., 2013; Rolly et al., 2020）。我們的劑量反應數據測試了 75、100、150 與 250 mM NaCl 的鹽度，並以同一塊盤上的對照組為基準判讀。在 75 mM 下，鮮重與總葉綠素都接近對照水準。在 100 mM 下生長明顯減少，而救援效果仍然看得見，這正是它成為工作濃度的原因。在 150 mM 下生長受抑的程度與 100 mM 大致相同，但幾乎沒有救援，總葉綠素急遽下降，花青素累積到足以使葉片轉紫。在 250 mM 下幾乎每一個樣品都出現黃化與嚴重白化，沒有一個恢復。這些界線是相對對照的近似百分比，而不是固定的門檻，因為每一次試驗都不一樣。這項發現讓後續研究者可以跳過預試，直接從 75 到 100 mM 這個生長受抑但救援仍看得見的視窗開始。

blocks.en: Testing plant growth-promoting bacteria and biostimulants. Microbes that lower plant ethylene with ACC deaminase are used to promote plant growth under stress (Glick, 2014). Plate assays are a common way to test bacterial effects on Arabidopsis stress tolerance (Lee et al., 2023). Our design compares bacterial products at defined timings and with equal liquid controls. The standardized protocols allow a reusable screen for any protectant testing, so other teams and researchers can test their own molecule or microbe with the same readouts, plates, and analysis.
blocks.text: Testing plant growth-promoting bacteria and biostimulants. Microbes that lower plant ethylene with ACC deaminase are used to promote plant growth under stress (Glick, 2014). Plate assays are a common way to test bacterial effects on Arabidopsis stress tolerance (Lee et al., 2023). Our design compares bacterial products at defined timings and with equal liquid controls. The standardized protocols allow a reusable screen for any protectant testing, so other teams and researchers can test their own molecule or microbe with the same readouts, plates, and analysis.
blocks.zh: 測試植物生長促進菌與生物刺激素。以 ACC 去胺酶降低植物乙烯的微生物被用來促進逆境下的植物生長（Glick, 2014）。培養盤檢測是檢驗細菌對 Arabidopsis 逆境耐受性影響的常見方法（Lee et al., 2023）。我們的設計在明確的時機下、以等量的液體對照比較細菌產物。標準化的流程提供一套可重複使用的篩選，可用於任何保護劑測試，因此其他團隊與研究者能以相同的讀值、培養盤與分析，測試自己的分子或微生物。

blocks.en: Testing exogenous protective compounds. Sugars such as trehalose have been tested on Arabidopsis thaliana under salinity stress (Kim et al., 2025). Our trehalose sets show how to find the usable dose range of a candidate compound. Too high of concentrations might inhibit and harm plants as well because it triggers the toxic accumulation of an intermediate signaling metabolite, trehalose-6-phosphate (T6P), which disrupts normal carbon allocation and energy signaling, causing growth arrest such as stunted roots and undeveloped leaves (Schluepmann et al., 2004).
blocks.text: Testing exogenous protective compounds. Sugars such as trehalose have been tested on Arabidopsis thaliana under salinity stress (Kim et al., 2025). Our trehalose sets show how to find the usable dose range of a candidate compound. Too high of concentrations might inhibit and harm plants as well because it triggers the toxic accumulation of an intermediate signaling metabolite, trehalose-6-phosphate (T6P), which disrupts normal carbon allocation and energy signaling, causing growth arrest such as stunted roots and undeveloped leaves (Schluepmann et al., 2004).
blocks.zh: 測試外源保護性化合物。像海藻糖這類的醣，已在鹽逆境下的 Arabidopsis thaliana 上測試過（Kim et al., 2025）。我們的海藻糖組顯示如何找出候選化合物的可用劑量範圍。濃度過高也可能抑制並傷害植物，因為它會引發一種中間訊號代謝物海藻糖-6-磷酸（T6P）的毒性累積，破壞正常的碳分配與能量訊號，造成生長停滯，例如根矮化與葉片發育不全（Schluepmann et al., 2004）。

blocks.en: Heat-stress assays. The same plates and readouts can be used with thermopriming protocols (Lee et al., 2023; Auverlot et al., 2025).
blocks.text: Heat-stress assays. The same plates and readouts can be used with thermopriming protocols (Lee et al., 2023; Auverlot et al., 2025).
blocks.zh: 熱逆境檢測。同樣的培養盤與讀值可以搭配熱預適應流程使用（Lee et al., 2023; Auverlot et al., 2025）。

blocks.en: Timing studies for delivery driven by sensors. The protectant is applied before, with, or after stress; therefore, the platform can test whether early delivery matters. This directly connects to the question behind AIoT-based stress prediction and sensing in the field.
blocks.text: Timing studies for delivery driven by sensors. The protectant is applied before, with, or after stress; therefore, the platform can test whether early delivery matters. This directly connects to the question behind AIoT-based stress prediction and sensing in the field.
blocks.zh: 由感測器驅動之投放的時機研究。保護劑在逆境之前、同時或之後施用；因此這個平台可以檢驗提早投放是否有差別。這直接連到田間以 AIoT 為基礎的逆境預測與感測背後的問題。

blocks.en: Teaching and iGEM labs. The equipment is inexpensive (plates, a camera in a light box, a balance, and free ImageJ software) and every step is described below in the procedural steps.
blocks.text: Teaching and iGEM labs. The equipment is inexpensive (plates, a camera in a light box, a balance, and free ImageJ software) and every step is described below in the procedural steps.
blocks.zh: 教學與 iGEM 實驗室。器材便宜（培養盤、燈箱中的一台相機、一台天平，以及免費的 ImageJ 軟體），而每一個步驟都在下面的流程步驟中寫明。

blocks.en: Honest record of failure modes. Especially for contamination issues or failure to see effectiveness in protectant doses, so other teams can avoid repeating them as to also provide improvements and suggestions to protocols for higher quality readouts.
blocks.text: Honest record of failure modes. Especially for contamination issues or failure to see effectiveness in protectant doses, so other teams can avoid repeating them as to also provide improvements and suggestions to protocols for higher quality readouts.
blocks.zh: 對失敗模式的誠實紀錄。尤其是污染問題，或在各種保護劑劑量下看不到效果的情形，讓其他團隊可以避免重蹈覆轍，同時也為流程提供改進與建議，以取得品質更好的讀值。

blocks.en: Use the pH probe and measure the pH of the solution (target pH is 5.7 to 5.8). If the pH is too low, add 0.1 M KOH slowly to increase the pH. If the pH is too high, add 0.1 M HCl slowly to decrease the pH.
blocks.text: Use the pH probe and measure the pH of the solution (target pH is 5.7 to 5.8). If the pH is too low, add 0.1 M KOH slowly to increase the pH. If the pH is too high, add 0.1 M HCl slowly to decrease the pH.

blocks.text: During the autoclave, label all of the petri dishes with a marker in the biosafety cabinet. Include agar percentage and date the agar was made.

blocks.en: Transfer half of the flasks to a laminar flow hood. Store the other half of the flasks in the hot bath at 60 °C while pouring so that the agar solution does not solidify immediately.
blocks.text: Transfer half of the flasks to a laminar flow hood. Store the other half of the flasks in the hot bath at 60 °C while pouring so that the agar solution does not solidify immediately.

blocks.en: Make sure the surface is dry by wiping the flasks with a paper towel before spraying 70% EtOH on them.

blocks.zh: 把每一份培養基混合液倒入各自的培養皿（水平圓盤約 30 mL，垂直方盤約 50 mL）。

blocks.en: Transfer the other half of the flasks into the laminar flow hood and pour each of the medium mixtures into the petri dishes.
blocks.text: Transfer the other half of the flasks into the laminar flow hood and pour each of the medium mixtures into the petri dishes.
blocks.zh: 把另一半燒瓶移進層流櫃，並把每一份培養基混合液倒入培養皿。

blocks.en: Let the petri dishes solidify at room temperature (around 25 °C) for around 10 minutes under the laminar flow hood with the plastic lid on.
blocks.text: Let the petri dishes solidify at room temperature (around 25 °C) for around 10 minutes under the laminar flow hood with the plastic lid on.
blocks.zh: 讓培養皿在層流櫃中、蓋上塑膠蓋，於室溫（約 25 °C）凝固約 10 分鐘。

blocks.en: Seed sterilization and germination
blocks.text: Seed sterilization and germination
blocks.zh: 種子滅菌與發芽

blocks.en: Surface-sterilize seeds, then rinse with sterile water.
blocks.text: Surface-sterilize seeds, then rinse with sterile water.
blocks.zh: 對種子進行表面滅菌，再以無菌水沖洗。

blocks.en: Sow seeds on plain ½ MS agar plates, with no NaCl and no protectant: 40 seeds per plate on the horizontal round plates and 33 seedlings per plate on the vertical square plates, following the seed templates.
blocks.text: Sow seeds on plain ½ MS agar plates, with no NaCl and no protectant: 40 seeds per plate on the horizontal round plates and 33 seedlings per plate on the vertical square plates, following the seed templates.
blocks.zh: 把種子播在不含 NaCl、不含保護劑的純 ½ MS 瓊脂盤上：依種子模板，水平圓盤每盤 40 顆種子，垂直方盤每盤 33 株幼苗。

blocks.en: Use breathable tape to seal each of the agar plates.
blocks.text: Use breathable tape to seal each of the agar plates.
blocks.zh: 以透氣膠帶把每一個瓊脂盤封好。

blocks.en: Wrap the agar plates with aluminum foil.
blocks.text: Wrap the agar plates with aluminum foil.
blocks.zh: 以鋁箔包住瓊脂盤。

blocks.en: Stratify in the dark at 4 °C. Stratification synchronizes germination so seedlings are uniform and have consistent growth conditions.
blocks.text: Stratify in the dark at 4 °C. Stratification synchronizes germination so seedlings are uniform and have consistent growth conditions.
blocks.zh: 在 4 °C 的暗中進行層積處理。層積處理使發芽同步，讓幼苗均一並具有一致的生長條件。

blocks.en: Move plates to the growth chamber. Grow for 4 days (horizontal round plates) or 7 days (vertical square plates) before protectant dosing and salinity concentration stress trials.
blocks.text: Move plates to the growth chamber. Grow for 4 days (horizontal round plates) or 7 days (vertical square plates) before protectant dosing and salinity concentration stress trials.
blocks.zh: 把培養盤移到生長箱。在保護劑投藥與鹽度逆境試驗之前，先培育 4 天（水平圓盤）或 7 天（垂直方盤）。

blocks.en: The sterilizing agent, its concentration and contact time, the number of rinses, and the growth chamber's temperature, light intensity and photoperiod are not recorded.
blocks.text: The sterilizing agent, its concentration and contact time, the number of rinses, and the growth chamber's temperature, light intensity and photoperiod are not recorded.
blocks.zh: 滅菌劑、其濃度與接觸時間、沖洗次數，以及生長箱的溫度、光強度與光週期都沒有記錄。

blocks.en: Figure 1. Reference seed templates for stratification. (a) Horizontal round plates 3D printed seed template.
blocks.text: Figure 1. Reference seed templates for stratification. (a) Horizontal round plates 3D printed seed template.
blocks.zh: 圖 1. 層積處理用的參考種子模板。(a) 水平圓盤的 3D 列印種子模板。

blocks.en: Recording every day
blocks.text: Recording every day
blocks.zh: 每日紀錄

blocks.en: Vertical square plates. Observe for 10 days. Set up the black background platform and turn on the lights. Take the agar plates one by one out of the growth chamber and place them on the black background platform, bottom lid facing up. Take pictures, clearly recording the labels, with no reflections, avoiding water vapor covering the view of the plants. Place the agar plates back, tilted slightly to the back on the rack, in the growth chamber.
blocks.text: Vertical square plates. Observe for 10 days. Set up the black background platform and turn on the lights. Take the agar plates one by one out of the growth chamber and place them on the black background platform, bottom lid facing up. Take pictures, clearly recording the labels, with no reflections, avoiding water vapor covering the view of the plants. Place the agar plates back, tilted slightly to the back on the rack, in the growth chamber.
blocks.zh: 垂直方形培養盤。觀察 10 天。架好黑色背景平台並打開燈。把瓊脂盤一個一個從生長箱取出，放在黑色背景平台上，底蓋朝上。拍照，清楚記錄標籤，不要有反光，並避免水氣遮住植株的視野。把瓊脂盤放回生長箱，在架上略向後傾斜。

blocks.en: Horizontal round plates. Observe for 10 days. Take the agar plates one by one out of the growth chamber. Spray 70% EtOH on the agar plates and place them in the laminar flow hood. Unwrap the breathable tape. Place the agar plates on a black background platform, open lid, leaves facing up; on the last day, take out the lid and take the picture directly from the top view and measure fresh weight and chlorophyll data afterwards. Wrap a phone in plastic wrap and spray 70% EtOH before placing the phone inside the laminar flow hood. Take pictures, clearly recording the labels. Wrap breathable tape around the agar plates and place them back in the growth chamber.
blocks.text: Horizontal round plates. Observe for 10 days. Take the agar plates one by one out of the growth chamber. Spray 70% EtOH on the agar plates and place them in the laminar flow hood. Unwrap the breathable tape. Place the agar plates on a black background platform, open lid, leaves facing up; on the last day, take out the lid and take the picture directly from the top view and measure fresh weight and chlorophyll data afterwards. Wrap a phone in plastic wrap and spray 70% EtOH before placing the phone inside the laminar flow hood. Take pictures, clearly recording the labels. Wrap breathable tape around the agar plates and place them back in the growth chamber.
blocks.zh: 水平圓形培養盤。觀察 10 天。把瓊脂盤一個一個從生長箱取出。在瓊脂盤上噴 70% EtOH，再放進層流櫃。拆開透氣膠帶。把瓊脂盤放在黑色背景平台上，打開蓋子，葉片朝上；最後一天把蓋子取下，直接從上方視角拍照，之後再量測鮮重與葉綠素數據。把手機以保鮮膜包好並噴 70% EtOH，再把手機放進層流櫃。拍照，清楚記錄標籤。以透氣膠帶把瓊脂盤纏好，再放回生長箱。

blocks.en: Stress assays the vertical and horizontal plate assays, step by step
blocks.text: Stress assays the vertical and horizontal plate assays, step by step
blocks.zh: 逆境檢測 垂直與水平培養盤檢測，逐步說明

blocks.en: Vertical plate assay (Phase 1, trehalose)
blocks.text: Vertical plate assay (Phase 1, trehalose)
blocks.zh: 垂直培養盤檢測（第 1 階段，海藻糖）

blocks.en: Take the stack of agar plates wrapped in aluminum foil out of the refrigerator.
blocks.text: Take the stack of agar plates wrapped in aluminum foil out of the refrigerator.
blocks.zh: 把以鋁箔包好的一疊瓊脂盤從冰箱取出。

blocks.en: Spray alcohol on the agar plates before placing them inside the laminar flow hood.
blocks.text: Spray alcohol on the agar plates before placing them inside the laminar flow hood.
blocks.zh: 把瓊脂盤放進層流櫃之前先噴酒精。

blocks.en: Use a marker to draw a straight baseline along a ruler 5.5 cm from the top of the plate on the back of each salinity plate.
blocks.text: Use a marker to draw a straight baseline along a ruler 5.5 cm from the top of the plate on the back of each salinity plate.
blocks.zh: 以麥克筆沿尺，在每一個鹽度培養盤的背面、距盤頂 5.5 cm 處畫一條直的基線。

blocks.en: With an alcohol marker, mark 9 dots along the baseline in equal distances. The square agar plate is 12 cm horizontally with 10 spaces between the borders of the plate and between each seedling, so 12/10 = 1.2 cm as distance between each seedling.
blocks.text: With an alcohol marker, mark 9 dots along the baseline in equal distances. The square agar plate is 12 cm horizontally with 10 spaces between the borders of the plate and between each seedling, so 12/10 = 1.2 cm as distance between each seedling.
blocks.zh: 以酒精筆沿基線等距標出 9 個點。方形瓊脂盤水平方向為 12 cm，盤緣與各幼苗之間共有 10 個間隔，因此 12/10 = 1.2 cm 為幼苗之間的距離。

blocks.en: Place the square plates vertically at a slight angle.
blocks.text: Place the square plates vertically at a slight angle.
blocks.zh: 把方形培養盤以略微傾斜的角度垂直放置。

blocks.en: Choose 9 germinated seeds after vernalization that have similar root lengths or germination status and align the endpoints of their roots to the line drawn on the plate.
blocks.text: Choose 9 germinated seeds after vernalization that have similar root lengths or germination status and align the endpoints of their roots to the line drawn on the plate.
blocks.zh: 從春化處理後已發芽的種子中，挑出 9 顆根長或發芽狀態相近者，並把其根端對齊盤上畫的那條線。

blocks.en: Seal the plates with breathable tape and label the incubation date with a marker before placing the vertical plates on the stacks in the growth chamber, slightly tilted towards the back.
blocks.text: Seal the plates with breathable tape and label the incubation date with a marker before placing the vertical plates on the stacks in the growth chamber, slightly tilted towards the back.
blocks.zh: 以透氣膠帶封好培養盤，以麥克筆標上培養日期，再把垂直培養盤放到生長箱中的架上，略向後傾斜。

blocks.en: Photograph the plates daily in the light box. A set runs for 6 to 14 days, depending on how fast the stress reads.
blocks.text: Photograph the plates daily in the light box. A set runs for 6 to 14 days, depending on how fast the stress reads.
blocks.zh: 每天在燈箱中為培養盤拍照。一組為期 6 到 14 天，視逆境顯現的速度而定。

blocks.en: At the end of the set, measure root length in ImageJ, weigh fresh weight and extract chlorophyll.
blocks.text: At the end of the set, measure root length in ImageJ, weigh fresh weight and extract chlorophyll.
blocks.zh: 一組結束時，以 ImageJ 量測根長、秤鮮重並萃取葉綠素。

blocks.en: Each plate has one condition, so the NaCl and trehalose concentrations are poured into the medium rather than applied to the surface.
blocks.text: Each plate has one condition, so the NaCl and trehalose concentrations are poured into the medium rather than applied to the surface.
blocks.zh: 每一個培養盤只有一個條件，因此 NaCl 與海藻糖的濃度是倒進培養基裡，而不是施用在表面。

blocks.en: Horizontal plate assay (Phases 2 and 3), heat stress
blocks.text: Horizontal plate assay (Phases 2 and 3), heat stress
blocks.zh: 水平培養盤檢測（第 2 與第 3 階段），熱逆境

blocks.en: Transferring the seedlings
blocks.text: Transferring the seedlings
blocks.zh: 移植幼苗

blocks.en: Take the stack of agar plates wrapped in aluminum foil out of the refrigerator.
blocks.text: Take the stack of agar plates wrapped in aluminum foil out of the refrigerator.
blocks.zh: 把以鋁箔包好的一疊瓊脂盤從冰箱取出。

blocks.en: Spray alcohol on the agar plates before placing them inside the laminar flow hood.
blocks.text: Spray alcohol on the agar plates before placing them inside the laminar flow hood.
blocks.zh: 把瓊脂盤放進層流櫃之前先噴酒精。

blocks.en: Draw a straight line along a ruler 5.5 cm from the top of the plate, using the seed template.
blocks.text: Draw a straight line along a ruler 5.5 cm from the top of the plate, using the seed template.
blocks.zh: 使用種子模板，沿尺在距盤頂 5.5 cm 處畫一條直線。

blocks.en: Place the plates at a slight angle.
blocks.text: Place the plates at a slight angle.
blocks.zh: 把培養盤以略微傾斜的角度放置。

blocks.en: Choose 12 germinated seeds of similar root length or germination status and align the endpoints of their roots to the drawn line.
blocks.text: Choose 12 germinated seeds of similar root length or germination status and align the endpoints of their roots to the drawn line.
blocks.zh: 挑出 12 顆根長或發芽狀態相近的已發芽種子，並把其根端對齊所畫的那條線。

blocks.en: Set up four groups: control, pre-treatment one day before, co-treatment on day 0, and post-treatment one day after.
blocks.text: Set up four groups: control, pre-treatment one day before, co-treatment on day 0, and post-treatment one day after.
blocks.zh: 設定四組：對照、逆境前一天的前處理、第 0 天的同時處理，以及逆境後一天的後處理。

blocks.en: Seal the plates with breathable tape, label the transfer date, and place them on the rack in the growth chamber, tilted slightly towards the back.
blocks.text: Seal the plates with breathable tape, label the transfer date, and place them on the rack in the growth chamber, tilted slightly towards the back.
blocks.zh: 以透氣膠帶封好培養盤，標上移植日期，再放到生長箱中的架上，略向後傾斜。

blocks.en: Applying the treatments
blocks.text: Applying the treatments
blocks.zh: 施用處理

blocks.en: Pre-treatment, one day before. Open the biosafety cabinet. Dilute the CH peptide 1/500, that is 19.96 mL of sterile ddH₂O to 40 µL of peptide, in a 50 mL centrifuge tube and fit a sprayer. Take out the plate labeled pre-treatment, hold it vertically, and spray the peptide over the plants from leaves to roots at a distance of 15 cm, about two sprays, making sure every plant is covered. Seal with breathable tape and return it to the growth chamber.
blocks.text: Pre-treatment, one day before. Open the biosafety cabinet. Dilute the CH peptide 1/500, that is 19.96 mL of sterile ddH₂O to 40 µL of peptide, in a 50 mL centrifuge tube and fit a sprayer. Take out the plate labeled pre-treatment, hold it vertically, and spray the peptide over the plants from leaves to roots at a distance of 15 cm, about two sprays, making sure every plant is covered. Seal with breathable tape and return it to the growth chamber.
blocks.zh: 前處理，逆境前一天。打開生物安全櫃。把 CH 胜肽以 1/500 稀釋，即 19.96 mL 無菌 ddH₂O 配 40 µL 胜肽，裝在 50 mL 離心管中並接上噴頭。取出標示為前處理的培養盤，垂直握住，自 15 cm 的距離把胜肽從葉片噴到根部，約噴兩下，確認每一株植物都被覆蓋。以透氣膠帶封好，放回生長箱。

blocks.en: Co-treatment, day 0. Take out the plate labeled co-treatment, hold it vertically, and spray evenly at 15 cm, about two sprays. Seal with breathable tape.
blocks.text: Co-treatment, day 0. Take out the plate labeled co-treatment, hold it vertically, and spray evenly at 15 cm, about two sprays. Seal with breathable tape.
blocks.zh: 同時處理，第 0 天。取出標示為同時處理的培養盤，垂直握住，自 15 cm 均勻噴灑，約噴兩下。以透氣膠帶封好。

blocks.en: Place all four groups on a rack, plates standing at a slight angle, and put the rack into the incubator at 37 °C under white light for thermopriming.
blocks.text: Place all four groups on a rack, plates standing at a slight angle, and put the rack into the incubator at 37 °C under white light for thermopriming.
blocks.zh: 把四組全部放在架上，培養盤以略微傾斜的角度立著，再把架子放進 37 °C、白光照明的培養箱中進行熱預適應。

blocks.en: Observe the seedlings for a further 5 days in the incubator.
blocks.text: Observe the seedlings for a further 5 days in the incubator.
blocks.zh: 在培養箱中再觀察幼苗 5 天。

blocks.en: Post-treatment, one day after thermopriming. Take the post-treatment plate out of the incubator, hold it vertically, spray evenly at 15 cm, seal with breathable tape and return it to the incubator.
blocks.text: Post-treatment, one day after thermopriming. Take the post-treatment plate out of the incubator, hold it vertically, spray evenly at 15 cm, seal with breathable tape and return it to the incubator.
blocks.zh: 後處理，熱預適應後一天。把後處理培養盤從培養箱取出，垂直握住，自 15 cm 均勻噴灑，以透氣膠帶封好，再放回培養箱。

blocks.en: Horizontal plate assay (Phases 2 and 3), salinity
blocks.text: Horizontal plate assay (Phases 2 and 3), salinity
blocks.zh: 水平培養盤檢測（第 2 與第 3 階段），鹽度

blocks.en: Label each plate with its timing group, pre-treatment, co-treatment, post-treatment or control, and its NaCl level, 0, 75 or 100 mM. That gives twelve conditions. For the ACC deaminase runs the control is TB medium rather than water.
blocks.text: Label each plate with its timing group, pre-treatment, co-treatment, post-treatment or control, and its NaCl level, 0, 75 or 100 mM. That gives twelve conditions. For the ACC deaminase runs the control is TB medium rather than water.
blocks.zh: 在每一個培養盤上標示其時機組別——前處理、同時處理、後處理或對照——以及其 NaCl 濃度，0、75 或 100 mM。這樣共有十二個條件。在 ACC 去胺酶的運轉中，對照是 TB 培養基而不是水。

blocks.en: CH bio peptide, Phase 2. Dilute the peptide 1/500 in sterile water. Pipette 3 mL onto the agar surface to submerge it, then draw 2 mL back off, leaving 1 mL. The extra volume is what overcomes the surface tension of the agar, which otherwise leaves the liquid sitting unevenly. Add 1 mL of sterile water to every group not receiving the protectant, so the liquid volume is the same in all of them.
blocks.text: CH bio peptide, Phase 2. Dilute the peptide 1/500 in sterile water. Pipette 3 mL onto the agar surface to submerge it, then draw 2 mL back off, leaving 1 mL. The extra volume is what overcomes the surface tension of the agar, which otherwise leaves the liquid sitting unevenly. Add 1 mL of sterile water to every group not receiving the protectant, so the liquid volume is the same in all of them.
blocks.zh: CH bio 胜肽，第 2 階段。把胜肽以無菌水 1/500 稀釋。用吸管把 3 mL 加到瓊脂表面使其浸潤，再抽回 2 mL，留下 1 mL。多出來的體積是用來克服瓊脂的表面張力，否則液體會不均勻地停在表面。對每一個未接受保護劑的組別加入 1 mL 無菌水，使所有組別的液體體積相同。

blocks.en: ACC deaminase, Phase 3. Filter the preparation through a 0.22 µm filter inside the biosafety cabinet. Hold a sterile spray nozzle 10 cm above the plate and give three sprays, one top left, one top right and one at the bottom. Control plates are sprayed with TB medium.
blocks.text: ACC deaminase, Phase 3. Filter the preparation through a 0.22 µm filter inside the biosafety cabinet. Hold a sterile spray nozzle 10 cm above the plate and give three sprays, one top left, one top right and one at the bottom. Control plates are sprayed with TB medium.
blocks.zh: ACC 去胺酶，第 3 階段。在生物安全櫃內以 0.22 µm 濾膜過濾製備液。把無菌噴嘴握在培養盤上方 10 cm 處噴三下，一下在左上、一下在右上、一下在下方。對照培養盤噴的是 TB 培養基。

blocks.en: Apply the protectant on day −1 for pre-treatment, day 0 for co-treatment or day +1 for post-treatment. NaCl goes onto every corresponding plate on day 0, at the same time as the co-treatment.
blocks.text: Apply the protectant on day −1 for pre-treatment, day 0 for co-treatment or day +1 for post-treatment. NaCl goes onto every corresponding plate on day 0, at the same time as the co-treatment.
blocks.zh: 前處理在第 −1 天、同時處理在第 0 天、後處理在第 +1 天施用保護劑。NaCl 在第 0 天加到每一個對應的培養盤上，與同時處理同一時間。

blocks.en: Photograph the plates in the biosafety cabinet and observe for 5 days.
blocks.text: Photograph the plates in the biosafety cabinet and observe for 5 days.
blocks.zh: 在生物安全櫃中為培養盤拍照，並觀察 5 天。

blocks.en: On the last day, harvest the seedlings for fresh weight and chlorophyll extraction.
blocks.text: On the last day, harvest the seedlings for fresh weight and chlorophyll extraction.
blocks.zh: 最後一天採收幼苗，以進行鮮重量測與葉綠素萃取。

blocks.en: Controls and quality control seven groups, and what each one rules out
blocks.text: Controls and quality control seven groups, and what each one rules out
blocks.zh: 對照與品管 七個組別，以及每一個排除了什麼

blocks.en: Table 5. Controls used in the agar stress tests.
blocks.text: Table 5. Controls used in the agar stress tests.
blocks.zh: 表 5. 瓊脂逆境試驗所用的對照。

blocks.en: Control
blocks.text: Control
blocks.zh: 對照

blocks.en: What it tests
blocks.text: What it tests
blocks.zh: 它檢驗什麼

blocks.en: No NaCl, no protectant
blocks.text: No NaCl, no protectant
blocks.zh: 無 NaCl、無保護劑

blocks.en: Healthy baseline, no changes. All relative values are set against this group
blocks.text: Healthy baseline, no changes. All relative values are set against this group
blocks.zh: 健康基線，未施加任何改變。所有相對數值都以這一組為基準

blocks.en: NaCl, no protectant
blocks.text: NaCl, no protectant
blocks.zh: 有 NaCl、無保護劑

blocks.en: How much damage the stress causes. This is the group the protectant has to beat
blocks.text: How much damage the stress causes. This is the group the protectant has to beat
blocks.zh: 逆境造成多少傷害。這是保護劑必須勝過的那一組

blocks.en: No NaCl, plus protectant
blocks.text: No NaCl, plus protectant
blocks.zh: 無 NaCl、加保護劑

blocks.en: Whether the protectant itself harms unstressed plants; for example, higher concentration dosage of protectants may have negative inhibitory instead of rescue effectiveness
blocks.text: Whether the protectant itself harms unstressed plants; for example, higher concentration dosage of protectants may have negative inhibitory instead of rescue effectiveness
blocks.zh: 保護劑本身是否傷害未受逆境的植物；例如保護劑劑量濃度較高時，可能帶來負面的抑制作用，而不是救援效果

blocks.en: Sterile water or TB medium instead of protectant
blocks.text: Sterile water or TB medium instead of protectant
blocks.zh: 以無菌水或 TB 培養基取代保護劑

blocks.en: Equal liquid volume so the difference in liquid volume is not a hidden variable (submersion equality)
blocks.text: Equal liquid volume so the difference in liquid volume is not a hidden variable (submersion equality)
blocks.zh: 等量的液體，使液體體積的差異不會成為隱藏變數（浸潤條件一致）

blocks.en: Commercial CH peptide and trehalose
blocks.text: Commercial CH peptide and trehalose
blocks.zh: 市售 CH 胜肽與海藻糖

blocks.en: Reference protectants with a known effect, to compare against the ACCD, LEA14 and BoPep4 released by our engineered Bacillus subtilis
blocks.text: Reference protectants with a known effect, to compare against the ACCD, LEA14 and BoPep4 released by our engineered Bacillus subtilis
blocks.zh: 效果已知的參考保護劑，用以與我們改造的 Bacillus subtilis 所釋出的 ACCD、LEA14 與 BoPep4 相比

blocks.en: Western blot of the sprayed Bacillus subtilis preparation
blocks.text: Western blot of the sprayed Bacillus subtilis preparation
blocks.zh: 所噴灑之 Bacillus subtilis 製備液的西方墨點法

blocks.en: Whether the protein we claim to apply is present
blocks.text: Whether the protein we claim to apply is present
blocks.zh: 我們宣稱施用的蛋白質是否真的存在

blocks.en: Across eight experimental sets the agar platform answered the three questions it was built for. The stress dose has a usable window: rescue is readable between 75 and 100 mM NaCl, 150 mM stunts growth to roughly the same degree as 100 mM but leaves little room for a protectant to show an effect, and 250 mM bleached close to every seedling past recovery. Protectant dose matters in both directions, with 1 mM trehalose toxic and 0.5 mM too weak before the range was narrowed. And timing is readable: in the heat series above, ACC deaminase applied a day before the stress gave the longest roots of the four timing arms, which is the observation the whole delivery argument depends on.

blocks.en: Salt is what moves this readout, and trehalose does not rescue it. The unstressed groups sit between 69 and 77 mm whatever the trehalose dose; at 150 mM NaCl every group collapses to between 2 and 5 mm, and at 250 mM the 10 mM trehalose group did not germinate at all. Root length therefore reports the stress reliably and the protectant not at all at these doses, which is why the trehalose case is argued from chlorophyll instead. The exception is 1 mM trehalose unstressed, whose mean is pulled down by two seedlings at 41 and 37 mm against six above 70: a mean of 69.5 there is a bimodal plate, not a dose effect.

The unstressed groups sit between 69 and 77 mm whatever the trehalose dose; at 150 mM NaCl every group collapses to between 2 and 5 mm, and at 250 mM the 10 mM trehalose group did not germinate at all. Root length therefore reports the stress reliably and the protectant not at all at these doses, which is why the trehalose case is argued from chlorophyll instead. The exception is 1 mM trehalose unstressed, whose mean is pulled down by two seedlings at 41 and 37 mm against six above 70: a mean of 69.5 there is a bimodal plate, not a dose effect.
blocks.zh: 移動這個讀值的是鹽，而海藻糖沒有救回它。未受逆境的各組不論海藻糖劑量都落在 69 到 77 mm 之間；在 150 mM NaCl 下每一組都塌到 2 到 5 mm，而在 250 mM 下，10 mM 海藻糖那一組完全沒有發芽。因此根長可靠地反映了逆境，在這些劑量下卻完全反映不出保護劑，這也是為什麼海藻糖的論證改以葉綠素來談。例外是未受逆境的 1 mM 海藻糖組，它的平均值被兩株 41 與 37 mm 的幼苗拉下來，而另外六株都高於 70 mm：那裡 69.5 的平均值代表一個雙峰分布的培養盤，而不是劑量效應。

blocks.en: We transplanted Arabidopsis into a hydroponic box to evaluate the efficacy of protectants on plants. We use hydroponics to test the effectiveness because we can control the environmental factors precisely. The agar in the lid and the medium in the box between them feed the plant completely, and humidity and temperature are held in a constant range, so the outer conditions cannot move a result.
blocks.text: We transplanted Arabidopsis into a hydroponic box to evaluate the efficacy of protectants on plants. We use hydroponics to test the effectiveness because we can control the environmental factors precisely. The agar in the lid and the medium in the box between them feed the plant completely, and humidity and temperature are held in a constant range, so the outer conditions cannot move a result.
blocks.zh: 我們把 Arabidopsis 移植到水耕箱中，以評估保護劑對植物的效果。我們以水耕來測試效果，因為可以精確控制環境因子。蓋子裡的瓊脂與箱中的培養液兩者合起來能完整供養植物，而濕度與溫度也維持在固定範圍，因此外部條件無法改變結果。

blocks.en: Agar settles the dose and the timing on a flat surface; hydroponics is where the same protectants meet a root system standing in liquid, which is the condition a field application has to work in. The two platforms share their readouts, so a number taken here can be set beside a number taken on a plate. What hydroponics does not give is root length: the roots grow into the well and cannot be photographed against a scale, so the readouts are fresh weight, chlorophyll and the daily photographs.

blocks.zh: 瓊脂在平面上定下劑量與時機；水耕則是同樣的保護劑遇到立在液體中的根系之處，而那正是田間施用必須成立的條件。兩個平台共用讀值，因此在這裡取得的數字可以與在培養盤上取得的數字並列。水耕給不了的是根長：根長進孔裡，無法對著比例尺拍照，因此讀值是鮮重、葉綠素與每日照片。

blocks.en: Hydroponics fixes nutrient availability, water purity and stress intensity, which is why a team doing protectant work might want it. We built two vessels and record the materials, the assembly, the nutrient medium and the environmental conditions for both, so either can be rebuilt. Four boxes failed before the fifth, a 1000 µL tip box with a 3D printed board and a black cover to keep light off the medium; that one we offer as a prototype to modify, with the caution that it is less stable than the rack.

We built two vessels and record the materials, the assembly, the nutrient medium and the environmental conditions for both, so either can be rebuilt. Four boxes failed before the fifth, a 1000 µL tip box with a 3D printed board and a black cover to keep light off the medium; that one we offer as a prototype to modify, with the caution that it is less stable than the rack.
blocks.zh: 水耕把養分供應、水的純度與逆境強度都固定下來，這也是做保護劑工作的團隊可能會想用它的原因。我們做了兩種容器，並記錄兩者的材料、組裝、營養液與環境條件，使任一種都能被重建。在第五版之前有四個箱子失敗了；第五版是一個 1000 µL 吸管頭盒，搭配 3D 列印板與黑色罩蓋以隔絕培養液的光。我們把它作為一個可供修改的原型提供出來，但要提醒它的穩定性不如試管架。

blocks.en: Both stress protocols come with a dose already found. The salt concentration is from Cortés-Jiménez et al. (2014), and after several pretests 100 mM NaCl is where plants are damaged and a protectant can still bring them back. For heat we followed the thermopriming designs of Lee et al. (2023) and Auverlot et al. (2025), the same two sources the agar assay uses, and exposed plants at 37 °C and 42 °C. Nothing at 42 °C survived the day; at 37 °C the CH peptide rescued them. Start at 37 °C and treat 42 °C as past recovery.
blocks.text: Both stress protocols come with a dose already found. The salt concentration is from Cortés-Jiménez et al. (2014), and after several pretests 100 mM NaCl is where plants are damaged and a protectant can still bring them back. For heat we followed the thermopriming designs of Lee et al. (2023) and Auverlot et al. (2025), the same two sources the agar assay uses, and exposed plants at 37 °C and 42 °C. Nothing at 42 °C survived the day; at 37 °C the CH peptide rescued them. Start at 37 °C and treat 42 °C as past recovery.
blocks.zh: 兩套逆境流程都附帶已經找到的劑量。鹽濃度取自 Cortés-Jiménez et al.（2014），而在幾次預試之後，100 mM NaCl 是植物受到傷害、而保護劑仍能把它們救回來的位置。熱逆境方面我們依循 Lee et al.（2023）與 Auverlot et al.（2025）的熱預適應設計，也就是瓊脂檢測所用的同兩份來源，並讓植物暴露於 37 °C 與 42 °C。42 °C 下當天沒有任何一株存活；在 37 °C 下，CH 胜肽把它們救了回來。從 37 °C 開始，並把 42 °C 視為無法恢復。

blocks.en: The dilution work gives a ceiling that transfers without qualification: the carrier medium, and not the protectant, sets the strongest dose a plant will take. We tested 1/40, 1/60, 1/80 and 1/100 of both protectants; the plants tolerate all four, and the team reads 1/40, 1/60 and 1/80 as the best rescue, ACCD under heat and BoPep4 under both heat and salinity.
blocks.text: The dilution work gives a ceiling that transfers without qualification: the carrier medium, and not the protectant, sets the strongest dose a plant will take. We tested 1/40, 1/60, 1/80 and 1/100 of both protectants; the plants tolerate all four, and the team reads 1/40, 1/60 and 1/80 as the best rescue, ACCD under heat and BoPep4 under both heat and salinity.
blocks.zh: 稀釋工作給出一個可以無保留移用的上限：決定植物能承受的最強劑量的是載體培養液，而不是保護劑。我們測試了兩種保護劑的 1/40、1/60、1/80 與 1/100；植物對四者都可以耐受，而團隊判讀 1/40、1/60 與 1/80 為救援效果最佳——ACCD 在熱逆境下，BoPep4 在熱逆境與鹽逆境下皆然。

blocks.en: One finding was not something we set out to measure. Plants in the tube rack were contaminated less often than plants in the tip box, and our explanation is the transfer step: tip box plants were moved off the rack at four days old and, although a group would usually last three or four days after that, most ended in severe contamination. Roots in the rack are never handled.
blocks.text: One finding was not something we set out to measure. Plants in the tube rack were contaminated less often than plants in the tip box, and our explanation is the transfer step: tip box plants were moved off the rack at four days old and, although a group would usually last three or four days after that, most ended in severe contamination. Roots in the rack are never handled.
blocks.zh: 有一項發現並不是我們原本打算量測的。試管架中的植物比吸管頭盒中的植物較少受到污染，而我們的解釋是移植這個步驟：吸管頭盒的植株在四日齡時從架上移走，雖然一組通常還能撐三到四天，但大多最後都嚴重污染。試管架裡的根從來不經手。

blocks.en: Use a hot plate to stir, with a magnetic stirring rod, until no sediments are left in the solution.
blocks.text: Use a hot plate to stir, with a magnetic stirring rod, until no sediments are left in the solution.

blocks.en: Measure the pH with a pH probe; the target is 5.7 to 5.8. If the pH is too low, add 0.1 M KOH slowly; if it is too high, add 0.1 M HCl slowly.
blocks.text: Measure the pH with a pH probe; the target is 5.7 to 5.8. If the pH is too low, add 0.1 M KOH slowly; if it is too high, add 0.1 M HCl slowly.
blocks.zh: 以 pH 探針量測 pH；目標為 5.7 到 5.8。若 pH 過低，緩慢加入 0.1 M KOH；若過高，緩慢加入 0.1 M HCl。

blocks.en: Wrap the neck of the flask with aluminum foil and stick a piece of indicator tape on top.
blocks.text: Wrap the neck of the flask with aluminum foil and stick a piece of indicator tape on top.
blocks.zh: 以鋁箔包住燒瓶瓶頸，並在上面貼一片指示膠帶。

blocks.en: Autoclave for 20 minutes at 127 °C. Wait for the pressure to reach 0 before retrieving the flask.
blocks.text: Autoclave for 20 minutes at 127 °C. Wait for the pressure to reach 0 before retrieving the flask.
blocks.zh: 在 127 °C 高壓滅菌 20 分鐘。等壓力降到 0 再取出燒瓶。

blocks.en: The lids, while the agar autoclaves
blocks.text: The lids, while the agar autoclaves
blocks.zh: 瓊脂滅菌期間處理蓋子

blocks.en: Prepare 48 Eppendorf microtube lids for each of the heat and salinity stress tests.
blocks.text: Prepare 48 Eppendorf microtube lids for each of the heat and salinity stress tests.
blocks.zh: 為熱逆境與鹽逆境試驗各準備 48 個 Eppendorf 微量管蓋。

blocks.en: Use scissors to cut the lid off the microtube.
blocks.text: Use scissors to cut the lid off the microtube.
blocks.zh: 用剪刀把微量管的蓋子剪下來。

blocks.en: Use a leather punch to punch a 3 mm hole in each lid.
blocks.text: Use a leather punch to punch a 3 mm hole in each lid.
blocks.zh: 用皮革打孔器在每個蓋子上打一個 3 mm 的孔。

blocks.en: Put the lids into a small beaker, wrap it with aluminum foil and stick a piece of indicator tape on top.
blocks.text: Put the lids into a small beaker, wrap it with aluminum foil and stick a piece of indicator tape on top.
blocks.zh: 把蓋子放進一個小燒杯，以鋁箔包好，並在上面貼一片指示膠帶。

blocks.en: Autoclave for 20 minutes at 127 °C. Wait for the pressure to reach 0 before opening the autoclave.
blocks.text: Autoclave for 20 minutes at 127 °C. Wait for the pressure to reach 0 before opening the autoclave.
blocks.zh: 在 127 °C 高壓滅菌 20 分鐘。等壓力降到 0 再打開滅菌鍋。

blocks.en: Add 250 µL of 0.6% agar into each lid and wait until it solidifies.
blocks.text: Add 250 µL of 0.6% agar into each lid and wait until it solidifies.
blocks.zh: 在每個蓋子中加入 250 µL 的 0.6% 瓊脂，等它凝固。

blocks.en: The rack
blocks.text: The rack

blocks.en: Soak a tube rack in bleach for 10 minutes and rinse it with ddH₂O until there is no smell of bleach on it.
blocks.text: Soak a tube rack in bleach for 10 minutes and rinse it with ddH₂O until there is no smell of bleach on it.
blocks.zh: 把試管架浸在漂白水中 10 分鐘，再以 ddH₂O 沖洗，直到聞不到漂白水味。

blocks.en: Add 2.1 mL of 0.1× MS medium into each of 48 wells.
blocks.text: Add 2.1 mL of 0.1× MS medium into each of 48 wells.
blocks.zh: 在 48 個孔的每一個中加入 2.1 mL 的 0.1× MS 培養液。

blocks.en: Put the Eppendorf lids onto the wells using tweezers.
blocks.text: Put the Eppendorf lids onto the wells using tweezers.

blocks.en: Sowing and stratification

blocks.text: Use an autoclaved toothpick to pick up one seed.

blocks.en: Place the seed onto the agar through the hole in the lid.
blocks.text: Place the seed onto the agar through the hole in the lid.

blocks.en: Wrap the rack with aluminum foil.
blocks.text: Wrap the rack with aluminum foil.
blocks.zh: 以鋁箔包住試管架。

blocks.en: Place the rack in the refrigerator at 4 °C for 4 days to stratify.
blocks.text: Place the rack in the refrigerator at 4 °C for 4 days to stratify.
blocks.zh: 把試管架放進 4 °C 的冰箱 4 天進行層積處理。

blocks.en: Move the rack to the growth chamber after the 4 days.
blocks.text: Move the rack to the growth chamber after the 4 days.

blocks.text: 3 M NaCl in 0.1× MS medium, batch of 400 mL
blocks.zh: 0.1× MS 培養液中的 3 M NaCl，一批 400 mL

blocks.text: Add ½ MS powder, MES buffer and ddH₂O into a 500 mL flask.
blocks.zh: 把 ½ MS 粉末、MES 緩衝液與 ddH₂O 加入 500 mL 燒瓶。

blocks.en: Use the hot plate to stir, with a stirring rod, until no sediments are left in the solution.
blocks.text: Use the hot plate to stir, with a stirring rod, until no sediments are left in the solution.
blocks.zh: 以加熱板搭配攪拌子攪拌，直到溶液中不再有沉澱。

blocks.en: Adjust the pH to 5.7 to 5.8 with 1 M KOH, using a pH probe.
blocks.text: Adjust the pH to 5.7 to 5.8 with 1 M KOH, using a pH probe.
blocks.zh: 以 pH 探針，用 1 M KOH 把 pH 調到 5.7 到 5.8。

blocks.text: Add 70.128 g of NaCl in batches, slowly, into the flask.

blocks.text: Use the stirring rod to dissolve all the NaCl into the medium.

blocks.en: Transfer from rack to tip box
blocks.text: Transfer from rack to tip box

blocks.text: After stratification, take the four-day-old plants off the rack onto the 3D printed board.
blocks.zh: 層積處理之後，把四日齡的植株從試管架移到 3D 列印板上。

blocks.text: Close the lid and put the box in the incubator.

blocks.text: The daily record, for both vessels

blocks.en: Observe for 10 days.
blocks.text: Observe for 10 days.
blocks.zh: 觀察 10 天。

blocks.en: Wrap the phone in plastic wrap and wear latex gloves.
blocks.text: Wrap the phone in plastic wrap and wear latex gloves.

blocks.text: Turn on the biosafety cabinet and lower the plastic board to the line.

blocks.text: Spray 75% alcohol on the gloves and on the wrapped phone.

blocks.text: Open the lids of the rack or the tip box inside the cabinet.

blocks.en: Take pictures that do not reflect.
