blocks.en: The CH peptide is a commercial product designed to protect plants against general abiotic stress, and it is better characterized than ACCD, BoPep4 or LEA14. Phase 1 therefore asks whether the platform can show a rescue at all, using a protectant that should produce one.

blocks.zh: CH 胜肽是一項市售產品，設計用來保護植物對抗一般的非生物逆境，而它的特性比 ACCD、BoPep4 或 LEA14 都清楚。因此第 1 階段問的是：這個平台究竟能不能呈現救援效果，所用的是一種本來就應該產生救援的保護劑。

blocks.en: ACCD only functions in the presence of pyridoxal 5′-phosphate (PLP), so the ACCD treatment is ACCD together with PLP and the matching control is PLP alone in the medium, labeled 0.1× MS medium in the photographs. BoPep4 needs no cofactor, so its control is the medium without BoPep4. Both runs include a second control, 1/40 WB800: B. subtilis in TB medium with no protectant, which separates an effect of the carrier from an effect of the protein.
blocks.text: ACCD only functions in the presence of pyridoxal 5′-phosphate (PLP), so the ACCD treatment is ACCD together with PLP and the matching control is PLP alone in the medium, labeled 0.1× MS medium in the photographs. BoPep4 needs no cofactor, so its control is the medium without BoPep4. Both runs include a second control, 1/40 WB800: B. subtilis in TB medium with no protectant, which separates an effect of the carrier from an effect of the protein.
blocks.zh: ACCD 只有在吡哆醛 5′-磷酸（PLP）存在時才有功能，因此 ACCD 處理是 ACCD 與 PLP 併用，相配的對照則是培養液中只有 PLP，在照片中標為 0.1× MS 培養液。BoPep4 不需要輔因子，所以它的對照是不含 BoPep4 的培養液。兩次運轉都包含第二個對照，1/40 WB800：在 TB 培養基中、不含保護劑的 B. subtilis，用來把載體的效果與蛋白質的效果分開。

blocks.en: Finding a dilution the plants survive
blocks.text: Finding a dilution the plants survive
blocks.zh: 找出植物能活下來的稀釋度

blocks.en: TB at full strength kills the plants, so the first run was a pretest on TB medium carrying B. subtilis and no protectant, to separate the carrier from anything the protectant might do. We tested 1, 1/2, 1/4, 1/8 and 1/16, with 0 as the control, at pH 5.7 and pH 7. The optimum for Arabidopsis is 5.7 and ACCD works best at about 7.5 (Liu et al., 2022), which Arabidopsis will not tolerate, so 7 is the compromise we tested against.
blocks.text: TB at full strength kills the plants, so the first run was a pretest on TB medium carrying B. subtilis and no protectant, to separate the carrier from anything the protectant might do. We tested 1, 1/2, 1/4, 1/8 and 1/16, with 0 as the control, at pH 5.7 and pH 7. The optimum for Arabidopsis is 5.7 and ACCD works best at about 7.5 (Liu et al., 2022), which Arabidopsis will not tolerate, so 7 is the compromise we tested against.
blocks.zh: 全濃度的 TB 會把植物殺死，所以第一次運轉是針對承載 B. subtilis、不含保護劑的 TB 培養基所做的預試，以把載體與保護劑可能做的事分開。我們測試了 1、1/2、1/4、1/8 與 1/16，以 0 作為對照，並分別在 pH 5.7 與 pH 7 下進行。Arabidopsis 的最適 pH 是 5.7，而 ACCD 在約 7.5 時作用最佳（Liu et al., 2022），但 Arabidopsis 無法耐受那個 pH，因此 7 是我們據以測試的折衷。

blocks.en: Pretest of TB medium carrying B. subtilis with no protectant, at pH 5.7 (top row) and pH 7 (bottom row).
blocks.text: Pretest of TB medium carrying B. subtilis with no protectant, at pH 5.7 (top row) and pH 7 (bottom row).
blocks.zh: 承載 B. subtilis、不含保護劑的 TB 培養基預試，pH 5.7（上排）與 pH 7（下排）。

blocks.en: Every TB concentration in the pretest was too strong for the plants to survive, including 1/16. That is a failed rescue window, and it is still the reading that set the next run: the damage falls off steadily with dilution, so the usable range had to be below 1/16. The pH arm came back clean, though. Plants at pH 7 were no worse than plants at 5.7, so every later ACCD run was made up at pH 7, which is as close to the enzyme's own optimum as the plants will go.
blocks.text: Every TB concentration in the pretest was too strong for the plants to survive, including 1/16. That is a failed rescue window, and it is still the reading that set the next run: the damage falls off steadily with dilution, so the usable range had to be below 1/16. The pH arm came back clean, though. Plants at pH 7 were no worse than plants at 5.7, so every later ACCD run was made up at pH 7, which is as close to the enzyme's own optimum as the plants will go.
blocks.zh: 預試中每一個 TB 濃度對植物都太強，連 1/16 也是。那是一個失敗的救援視窗，而它仍然是決定下一次運轉的那個判讀：傷害隨稀釋穩定遞減，因此可用範圍必須低於 1/16。不過 pH 這一分支的結果很乾淨。pH 7 的植物並不比 5.7 的差，因此後來每一次 ACCD 運轉都在 pH 7 配製，那已是在植物容許範圍內最接近酵素自身最適值的位置。

blocks.en: The salinity run that followed tested ACCD at 1/10, 1/20, 1/40 and 1/60 against 0 ACCD, each with and without 100 mM NaCl, and carried a separate group of 1/20 TB alone at both salt levels. The spacing was deliberate: the pretest had already ruled out everything down to 1/16, so most of the new series went below that, and 1/10 was kept as the single dose stronger than anything the pretest tolerated, to check that the damage really did continue to rise with concentration rather than plateau. We had expected 1/20 to be dilute enough for the plants to live and 1/40 and 1/60 to be almost without effect.
blocks.text: The salinity run that followed tested ACCD at 1/10, 1/20, 1/40 and 1/60 against 0 ACCD, each with and without 100 mM NaCl, and carried a separate group of 1/20 TB alone at both salt levels. The spacing was deliberate: the pretest had already ruled out everything down to 1/16, so most of the new series went below that, and 1/10 was kept as the single dose stronger than anything the pretest tolerated, to check that the damage really did continue to rise with concentration rather than plateau. We had expected 1/20 to be dilute enough for the plants to live and 1/40 and 1/60 to be almost without effect.
blocks.zh: 接下來的鹽度運轉以 1/10、1/20、1/40 與 1/60 的 ACCD 對照 0 ACCD，每一個都分有與無 100 mM NaCl，並另設一組只有 1/20 TB、同時在兩種鹽濃度下的組別。間距是刻意安排的：預試已經排除了 1/16 以上的一切，所以新系列大部分都落在那以下，而 1/10 保留下來，作為唯一比預試所能耐受者更強的劑量，以檢查傷害是否真的隨濃度持續上升，而不是趨於平緩。我們原本預期 1/20 已稀到足以讓植物活下來，而 1/40 與 1/60 幾乎沒有作用。

blocks.en: ACCD salinity test. ACCD at 1/60, 1/40, 1/20 and 1/10 and a 0 ACCD control, at 0 mM NaCl (top) and 100 mM NaCl (middle). The bottom row is 1/20 TB alone at both salt levels.
blocks.text: ACCD salinity test. ACCD at 1/60, 1/40, 1/20 and 1/10 and a 0 ACCD control, at 0 mM NaCl (top) and 100 mM NaCl (middle). The bottom row is 1/20 TB alone at both salt levels.
blocks.zh: ACCD 鹽度試驗。ACCD 於 1/60、1/40、1/20 與 1/10，以及 0 ACCD 對照，在 0 mM NaCl（上）與 100 mM NaCl（中）下。最下一排是只有 1/20 TB、在兩種鹽濃度下的組別。

blocks.en: The expectation was wrong in one place and right in the other. The 1/20 WB800 negative control itself showed a clear stress response, smaller plants and anthocyanin accumulation, so 1/20 of the carrier affects growth on its own. ACCD at 1/10 and 1/20 bleached leaves even at 0 mM NaCl, while 1/40 did not, and the 1/40 group carried the highest fresh weight and chlorophyll content of the unstressed groups. We therefore fixed 1/40 as the strongest dose in every later run, and these two runs together narrowed the working range from undiluted TB to 1/40 through 1/100.

The 1/20 WB800 negative control itself showed a clear stress response, smaller plants and anthocyanin accumulation, so 1/20 of the carrier affects growth on its own. ACCD at 1/10 and 1/20 bleached leaves even at 0 mM NaCl, while 1/40 did not, and the 1/40 group carried the highest fresh weight and chlorophyll content of the unstressed groups. We therefore fixed 1/40 as the strongest dose in every later run, and these two runs together narrowed the working range from undiluted TB to 1/40 through 1/100.
blocks.zh: 預期有一處錯了，另一處對了。1/20 WB800 陰性對照本身就顯示明顯的逆境反應——植株較小、花青素累積——因此 1/20 的載體單獨就會影響生長。ACCD 在 1/10 與 1/20 下即使在 0 mM NaCl 也會使葉片白化，而 1/40 不會；1/40 這一組在未受逆境的各組中鮮重與葉綠素含量都最高。因此我們把 1/40 定為後續每一次運轉中最強的劑量，而這兩次運轉合起來，把工作範圍從未稀釋的 TB 縮窄到 1/40 到 1/100。

blocks.en: Under 100 mM NaCl the result reverses. Most groups bleached and died; the exception is 1/40 BoPep4, where the plants mostly stayed green, and that group also has the highest fresh weight and the highest chlorophyll per plant of anything at 100 mM. The reading we take from the set is narrow: BoPep4 at 1/40 improves salinity tolerance, and the weaker dilutions do not separate from their controls.

blocks.en: Hydroponics was easier to control than a field and harder to control than we expected. Repeating the same trial does not reliably give the same result, even holding 37 °C and 100 mM NaCl after Cortés-Jiménez et al. (2014) and Lee et al. (2023). What the platform does establish is a working window: co-treatment is the timing under which both protectants rescued plants at 100 mM salinity, and dilutions of 1/80 and weaker are where the carrier stops interfering with the protectant's own effect. Those two findings set the arms of the Phase 2 runs.

blocks.en: Chlorophyll extraction
blocks.text: Chlorophyll extraction
blocks.zh: 葉綠素萃取

blocks.en: To assess the physiological response of Arabidopsis thaliana seedlings under stress, and evaluate protectant treatment rescue effectiveness in our project, chlorophyll extraction is introduced as a precise tool of measurement to strengthen the analysis of each experiment's results.
blocks.text: To assess the physiological response of Arabidopsis thaliana seedlings under stress, and evaluate protectant treatment rescue effectiveness in our project, chlorophyll extraction is introduced as a precise tool of measurement to strengthen the analysis of each experiment's results.
blocks.zh: 為了評估 Arabidopsis thaliana 幼苗在逆境下的生理反應，並評估本專題中保護劑處理的救援效果，我們引入葉綠素萃取作為精確的量測工具，以強化每一項實驗結果的分析。

blocks.en: Chlorophyll is the pigment that captures light energy for photosynthesis, so how much of it a leaf contains tracks how well the plant is growing (Roberts, 2023). The metabolic pathways that govern the chlorophyll biosynthesis are complex, which abiotic stress such as salinity stress, drought, extreme temperature variations can substantially perturb these processes (Li et al., 2024).
blocks.text: Chlorophyll is the pigment that captures light energy for photosynthesis, so how much of it a leaf contains tracks how well the plant is growing (Roberts, 2023). The metabolic pathways that govern the chlorophyll biosynthesis are complex, which abiotic stress such as salinity stress, drought, extreme temperature variations can substantially perturb these processes (Li et al., 2024).
blocks.zh: 葉綠素是為光合作用捕捉光能的色素，因此一片葉子含有多少葉綠素，就反映植物生長得多好（Roberts, 2023）。支配葉綠素生合成的代謝途徑相當複雜，而鹽逆境、乾旱、極端溫度變化等非生物逆境都可能大幅擾亂這些過程（Li et al., 2024）。

blocks.en: As connected to our project, we mainly focus on two abiotic stress types: salinity and heat. Given this category, these abiotic stressors trigger the overproduction of reactive oxygen species, leading to lipid peroxidation and chlorosis. Hence, extracting the chlorophyll as a form of data readout and measurement allows quantification on the degree of chlorosis, and permits accurate evaluation of plant physiological response in our experiments that cannot be visually and directly assessed through bare eyes.
blocks.text: As connected to our project, we mainly focus on two abiotic stress types: salinity and heat. Given this category, these abiotic stressors trigger the overproduction of reactive oxygen species, leading to lipid peroxidation and chlorosis. Hence, extracting the chlorophyll as a form of data readout and measurement allows quantification on the degree of chlorosis, and permits accurate evaluation of plant physiological response in our experiments that cannot be visually and directly assessed through bare eyes.
blocks.zh: 就與我們專題的關聯而言，我們主要聚焦於兩類非生物逆境：鹽度與熱。在這個分類下，這些非生物逆境因子會引發活性氧過量產生，導致脂質過氧化與黃化。因此以萃取葉綠素作為一種數據讀值與量測，可以把黃化的程度定量，並讓我們在實驗中準確評估那些無法以肉眼直接目視判斷的植物生理反應。

blocks.en: Trehalose treatment at 0.25, 0.5 and 1.0 mM has an upward trajectory of rescue effectiveness combatting 100 mM NaCl. In phase 1 of trehalose and NaCl agar testing, we integrated chlorophyll content since conducting experiment set #4; through chlorophyll extraction, we were able to visualize the chlorophyll content among different groups. The relationship of trehalose dose between control and 100 mM NaCl conditions shows a conversely contrasting pattern: under baseline conditions, higher trehalose doses slightly reduce baseline chlorophyll levels, whereas under 100 mM NaCl stress, they keep chlorophyll from being lost, more of it at each higher dose. Although 0.5 mM trehalose still rescues better than the other doses, the trend climbs steadily with dose, which is trehalose protecting against the salt.

blocks.en: Dividing by fresh weight is the standard way to report chlorophyll, and it is the wrong way round when stress has destroyed the biomass that sits in the denominator. The case that showed us this is the ACC deaminase heat stress assay described in the physical measurements chapter, and the numbers below come from that one experiment.
blocks.text: Dividing by fresh weight is the standard way to report chlorophyll, and it is the wrong way round when stress has destroyed the biomass that sits in the denominator. The case that showed us this is the ACC deaminase heat stress assay described in the physical measurements chapter, and the numbers below come from that one experiment.

blocks.en: Seedlings given no protectant and held at 37 °C for 5 days lost 92 to 97% of their fresh weight: the stressed groups weighed about 0.02 g against about 0.67 g unstressed, weighed per group on the analytical balance. Expressed per gram, those flattened seedlings then appeared to contain about three times more chlorophyll than the unstressed plants, 0.366 against 0.121 mg g<sup>−1</sup>, computed from the same absorbance readings as every other value in this chapter. Total chlorophyll in the extract, the same readings without the division, had fallen by about 91%. The two measures point in opposite directions, and only one of them agrees with the photographs.

blocks.en: Fresh weight also includes roots, which contain no chlorophyll, so a per-gram value moves with the shoot-to-root ratio as well as with pigment. We therefore report both measures and choose between them by the situation: chlorophyll per gram of fresh weight where biomass is comparable across groups, and total chlorophyll in the extract where it is not.

blocks.en: Fresh weight is most closely used to accompany chlorophyll extraction because the fresh weight of each experimental set is used to normalize the chlorophyll accordingly. On the other hand, primary length data was collected to observe the effect of salinity and respective protectant application on root behavior. The expected behavior of the primary roots was conducting halotropism, where roots pave their way through the agar as usual but specifically bending away from the salty patches to search for areas without osmotic stress (Zou et al., 2021). However, considering our entire agar plate was mixed with NaCl of different concentrations, the root length of respective agar plates was clearly affected, and root length differed between the salted plates and the unsalted ones.

blocks.en: Plates leaning back in the light box shortened the roots. A plate resting against the back of the box is photographed at an angle, which foreshortens everything on it. We 3D printed a rack that keeps a 12 to 13 cm square plate upright, so the plate is square to the camera and the ruler beside it calibrates ImageJ at the distance it claims to be.

blocks.en: Reflections obscured the measurement. Turning off the room lights and covering the opening of the light box with black cloth was not enough, because the box's own lights reflect off the plate. Moving the rack within the box and changing its distance from the camera left a reflection only at the extreme edges, clear of the roots.

blocks.en: Roots grew over each other in the denser groups. In the control groups especially, the primary root could not be told from its neighbors. For the last two or three sets we lifted the plants onto a thin sheet of black foam, laid parallel; pulled from the agar they clump, and the primary root is the longest, so it can be followed. Those photographs were taken from directly overhead with a 15 cm ruler beside the plants for calibration.

blocks.en: Audit the signal chain before calibrating the instrument. Our 434-hour run showed that integer sensor counts were creating artificial steps in OD600. blocks.en: Replay algorithms on identical raw data. Log the individual samples inside each burst and every estimator can be tested on exactly the same input, which takes burst-to-burst variation out of the comparison. Any flow-cell sensor that can print its raw bursts can be worked on this way.

blocks.en: Every chapter gives its own materials, its quantities per plate or per well, and its procedure in the order the steps are carried out, so each measurement can be rebuilt without reference to us. The runs that failed are reported beside the runs that worked, because a protocol that does not say how it stopped failing cannot be repeated: the 14 August pressure series does not reproduce from one run to the next, five of our eight pre-registered predictions about the photometer were overturned by our own data, and heat stress in hydroponic culture flattened the treated plants along with the controls. For the measurement that is wholly ours we publish the raw material instead of describing it. The arithmetic is described to the same depth as the bench work. The conversion from illuminance to optical density is given as equations, including the path-length factor of 5.0 that converts a 2 mm flow cuvette onto the 1 cm basis OD600 is quoted on, and the firmware that performs it is ported line for line into the analysis, so what is tested is what ships, not a description of it. Image analysis is calibrated from a 150 mm ruler standing in every photograph, so the scale comes from an object in the frame instead of an assumed camera distance. Eleven problems that shaped the agar sets are tabulated with the set each appeared in and what we changed in response. blocks.en: Is it useful to other projects?
blocks.text: Is it useful to other projects?

blocks.en: Each measurement block closes with what transfers out of ReLEAF. The central one is an in-line OD600 measurement that needs no instrument-specific transform fitted against a benchtop spectrophotometer: the raw output agrees with the benchtop reference to a median paired difference of 3.8%, and on the silica run its slope against that reference is 1.001, consistent with unit scale, so another team can rebuild the instrument and use the number it gives. Four further pieces are written for lifting out. The burst filter and the two acceptance gates took the worst bubble error from 2.44 to 0.016 OD and apply to any flow-cell sensor. The silica ladder calibrates a turbidity reading against a particle that does not grow, on a concentration axis set by pipetted volumes. The agar platform is a general screen for protectants and plant growth-promoting bacteria, with the usable stress window already found, 75 to 100 mM NaCl, so another team need not repeat the pretests. And chlorophyll is reported both per gram and in total, because per-gram normalization inflates the number when stress has suppressed biomass, by a factor of three in one of our own heat assays while total chlorophyll had fallen by about 91%.

blocks.en: Were controls used to validate the process and calibrate the units?
blocks.text: Were controls used to validate the process and calibrate the units?

blocks.en: Every optical reading here is referenced to a blank, and the blank is refused if either sensor is saturated, if too few readings survive the filter or if either channel reads zero, so the software returns no OD rather than an uncorrected one. The units are tied to physical quantities and not to another instrument: the path-length factor converts the flow cuvette to the conventional 1 cm basis, and the concentration axis of both calibration runs is set by weighed mass and pipetted volume. The instrument was then checked against two independent mass standards eight weeks apart, titanium dioxide on 23 August and 1 µm silica on 10 October, with a benchtop BioDrop reading in parallel at every step. Those comparisons are tested, not asserted: against the reference the slope is 1.001, p = 0.98 against a null of unit slope, while the intercept is −0.123 OD, p = 0.005 against a null of zero, which locates the one remaining discrepancy in the stored blank and not in the optics. The flow meter was validated against outflow caught by hand over the same dials, R² = 0.995. In the assays the controls are a plate control on every set, equal liquid volumes in the untreated arms, an unstressed-plus-protectant arm to separate rescue from toxicity, blank-subtracted ELISA readings quoted as %B/B₀ against a standard curve with the coefficient of variation between replicate wells, and DNPH values taken net of the untransformed WB800 host background and read only over the five standard levels at and below 2.049 mM. Where a control defeated the measurement we report that as the result: the untransformed WB800 control returned 5.452 and 4.562 µg/mL in the ELISA, the same range as four of the six constructs beside it, so no difference in that table can be attributed to expression.

attrs.en: Measurement. A white printed block of culture wells, some lit green and some orange, on a black base against a white brick wall.
Summary
Bioreactor measurements
Inline photometer

A render of both photometer builds on a plain ground. On the left the Pro, the beam-splitter build, stands on a wide tripod base, a tall printed column with the cuvette slot and lamp at the top. On the right the Slim, the fibre build, lies flat, a small printed block with a fibre collimator plugged into its top, the lit fibre running away to the right.
A student in a lab coat and gloves adds suspension from a syringe into a stirred bottle on a hotplate stirrer, with the photometer on its stand and an Arduino wired up beside a laptop on the bench.

A bench view of the two photometer builds joined in one circulating loop by clear tubing: the tall beam-splitter unit on its stand at the left and the small fibre block at the right, with the pump, a beaker and two laptops around them.

Optical density at 600 nm against milligrams of silica added, over nine points from 0 to 20 mg. An amber line for the BioDrop and a slate line for the Pro climb on almost the same slope, the Pro sitting about 0.12 OD below the reference throughout; a green line for the Slim climbs about a fifth as steeply and is equally straight.
Pressure and flow

A line chart of flow in millilitres per minute against pump dial from 0 to 100. The individual trial points sit on a line that climbs almost straight from about 100 at dial 10 to about 980 at dial 50, then bends over and reaches about 1,535 at dial 100.

A scatter plot of pressure in bar against flow in millilitres per minute for the first 14 August series. Fifteen readings are spread between about 0.096 bar at 140 millilitres per minute and 0.257 at 405, around a dashed fit line they sit loosely on.

A scatter plot of pressure in bar against flow in millilitres per minute for the second 14 August series. Twenty-one readings run from about 0.013 bar at 115 millilitres per minute to about 0.087 at 420, close to a shallow dashed fit line.

A scatter plot of pressure in bar against flow for the third 14 August series. Twenty-one readings climb from about 0.037 bar at 110 millilitres per minute to about 0.243 at 395, along a dashed fit line that is roughly three times steeper than the series 2 line.

A line chart of flow in millilitres per minute against pump dial from 10 to 24, with two almost coincident traces: background tubing only in grey and with the membrane in blue. Both rise steadily from about 115 to about 450.

A line chart of pressure drop in bar against flow in millilitres per minute. The grey background trace rises from about 0.02 to 0.24 bar; the blue trace with the membrane installed rises from about 0.06 to 0.45, separating further as flow increases.
Membrane breach

Above, a cutaway of the hollow fibre module: culture enters the fibre lumens at the feed port on the left and leaves at the retentate port on the right, drawn in amber; the shell space around the fibres is tinted blue and drains through a permeate port at the bottom. Green ovals, the cells, stay inside the fibres while small blue dots, secreted protein, cross the 0.2 micrometre wall into the shell. Dashed lines run down from the lumen side to plate a and from the shell side to plate b. Below, the two plates: a is streaked with colonies, b is clear.
Algorithm calibration
Observation and hypothesis

Histogram of reference-channel readings from 18 to 36 sensor counts. Tall dark green bars stand at every whole count, with a bar of 1,219 readings at 32 counts; the amber bars at half-count positions between them are almost flat.

Two stacked panels sharing a time axis from hour 77 to hour 101. The upper panel shows reported OD600 rising from about 0.78 to about 0.94 in steps; the lower panel shows the reference channel stepping between 32, 32.5 and 33 counts. Pale amber bands mark every stretch where the reference has left 32 counts, and the OD trace sits higher inside them.

Two team members at a bench on 10 October. One works at a laptop in front of two inline photometers wired to an Arduino and joined by tubing in a circulating loop; the other, in a lab coat and gloves, draws silica suspension with a micropipette. A second laptop logs the run beside them.
Design and coding
Calibration and analysis

Optical density against silica concentration for 41 additions. A steep slate line for photometer V1 rises to about 3.17 and bends below its dashed low-range line at the top. An amber line for the BioDrop runs close to V1 then flattens near 2.48. A shallow green line for photometer V2 reaches about 0.60 and stays straight.

Optical density against time over an 11-minute bubble challenge. An amber trace labelled as read swings between 0.74 and 3.19 against a dashed true level of 3.175, while a green trace through both gates stays flat on that level throughout.
Conclusion

Two horizontal bars on a time axis from 0 to 44 hours. Run 5 in October without the gate is solid for its first 10.6 hours and hatched for the remaining 27, with three dashed restart marks. Run 6 with the gate running is solid for 37 hours and hatched for the last 4.8, labelled beam lost and flagged.
The light plate apparatus inside an incubator: a white block of twelve culture tubes lit from below, some glowing green and some orange, on a dark 3D printed base beside an Arduino board.
A drawn cross-section of the light plate apparatus, showing the tube rack above six lit wells, each with an LED and a diffuser below the tube.
Protectant measurements
Western blot

Three Western blot panels. Panel A has a marker lane with bands at 63, 48 and 35 kilodaltons and an ACCD lane with one dark band between 35 and 48. Panel B has four imidazole lanes labelled 25, 10, 150 and 250 millimolar, with visible bands near 35 kilodaltons. Panel C is three strips of lanes labelled 14 to 44 hours, grouped as lumen cell lysate, lumen medium and shell medium; the cell lysate lanes show dark bands between 35 and 48 kilodaltons and the two medium groups are nearly blank.
ELISA

A falling curve of percent B over B zero against His-protein concentration from 0 to 3 micrograms per millilitre. Six points drop from about 95 percent at the lowest concentration to about 32 percent at 3, with a fitted logarithmic trend line.
DNPH assay

A bar chart headed DNPH assay, with ACCD activity in nanomoles of alpha-ketobutyrate per millilitre per hour on the vertical axis from 0 to 60. Four bars: csn at about 21, csn plus PLP at about 39, samyQ plus PLP at about 48, and WB800 at about 32.

A scatter plot of absorbance at 540 nanometres against alpha-ketobutyrate concentration from 0 to 4 millimolar. Two fitted lines run almost parallel: the upper one with supernatant and the lower one without, separated by a roughly constant gap at every concentration.

A bar chart of ACC deaminase activity in nanomoles of alpha-ketobutyrate per millilitre per hour against time in hours, from 0 to 80. The 1 hour bar is slightly below zero; 6 and 12 hours are near 2; 18 hours is the tallest at about 31; the bars then fall to about 19, 11 and 15 at 24, 30 and 36 hours, with two further bars of about 13 at 48 hours and 18 at 72 hours.

A bar chart headed DNPH assay, with concentration in micrograms per millilitre on the vertical axis from 0 to 25. A black bar labelled G3 reaches about 19.7 and a grey bar labelled G6 reaches about 5.

A bar chart of ACC deaminase activity in nanomoles of alpha-ketobutyrate per millilitre per hour, with four bars grouped as 13 hours and 16 hours for green light and for red light. Green at 13 hours is the tallest at about 10 with a long error bar; green at 16 hours is about 1; red at 13 hours is about 1 and red at 16 hours about 4.

A bar chart of concentration in micrograms per millilitre for seven groups. Baseline is lowest at about 2.8; then G3 about 8.2, R3 about 6.5, G6 about 11.8, R6 about 8.6, G8 about 18.2 and R8 about 16.1, each with an error bar.
Plant measurements
Agar plate stress test
A circle representing a round petri dish, with forty small open circles arranged in a grid of five columns and eight rows in the middle.

Eight square agar plates in a grid. Columns are control, pre-treatment, co-treatment and post-treatment; rows are control and heat stress thermo priming. Each plate holds a row of seedlings with roots hanging below a drawn baseline.
Hydroponic stress test

A blue tube rack of Arabidopsis seedlings in two rows, labelled pH 5.7 above and pH 7 below, with six bracketed groups across the top reading 1, one half, one quarter, one eighth, one sixteenth and 0. Seedlings are pale and small at the strongest concentrations and green and full at 0.

A white tube rack photographed from above in three labelled rows. The top row is 0 millimolar sodium chloride at one sixtieth, one fortieth, one twentieth and one tenth ACCD plus a 0 ACCD group; the middle row repeats those at 100 millimolar; the bottom row is one twentieth TB alone at both salt levels.

A teal tube rack photographed from above, bracketed into an upper block labelled 0 millimolar sodium chloride and a lower block labelled 100 millimolar. Each block runs one fortieth, one sixtieth, one eightieth and one hundredth BoPep4 along the top with one fortieth WB800 and 0.1 times MS medium below. Rosettes in the upper block are green with some reddening; in the lower block most are bleached and collapsed.

A bar chart of fresh weight in grams for twelve groups. The six unsalted groups run between about 0.056 and 0.106 grams; the six groups at 100 millimolar are all lower, with one fortieth BoPep4 the tallest of them at about 0.051 and 0.1 times MS medium the shortest at about 0.029.

A bar chart of chlorophyll content in micrograms per plant for the same twelve groups. The unsalted groups run between about 11 and 16.5; at 100 millimolar, one fortieth BoPep4 reads about 8.4 and the rest fall between about 2 and 4.6.

Two racks of Arabidopsis, a blue one above and a white one below, each labelled one fortieth, one sixtieth, one eightieth and one hundredth ACCD along the top and one fortieth WB800 and 0.1 times MS medium along the bottom. Plants in the blue rack are green; plants in the white rack are pale and small throughout.

Two racks of Arabidopsis, a blue one above and a white one below, labelled one fortieth to one hundredth BoPep4 along the top and one fortieth WB800 and 0.1 times MS medium along the bottom. Rosettes in the blue rack are large and green; those in the white rack are bleached and small in every group.
Chlorophyll extraction
A spreadsheet with columns for OD645 and OD663 in triplicate, and the three blank-subtracted columns beside them.
A spreadsheet showing the chlorophyll equation at the top and a table of treatments with three replicates, an average, a fresh weight column and the computed values.
The working chlorophyll workbook, showing the raw and blank-subtracted absorbance blocks above a table of trehalose and sodium chloride groups with their replicates and fresh weights.
Bar chart of relative chlorophyll content. Under control, the four trehalose doses read 1.000, 1.135, 0.788 and 0.573. Under 100 millimolar sodium chloride they read 0.570, 0.953, 1.283 and 1.244.
Bar chart of relative chlorophyll content under 37 degree heat stress with thermo priming. Control reads 1.0; pre-treatment about 2.25, co-treatment about 1.97 and post-treatment about 1.88.
Physical measurements
The ImageJ Set Scale dialog over a photograph of an agar plate, with a known distance typed in.
A segmented yellow line traced along one Arabidopsis primary root in ImageJ.
The ImageJ ROI Manager window holding a list of saved traces beside the plate photograph.
A whole agar plate in ImageJ with twelve numbered yellow traces, one along each seedling root below the drawn baseline.
An ImageJ results window listing the measured length of each traced root for one plate.
A BEL analytical balance with its glass draught shield closed, a labelled 15 millilitre centrifuge tube standing in a black holder on the pan, and the display reading zero after taring.
Five 15 millilitre centrifuge tubes standing in a blue printed rack, each holding green seedlings and marked in pen with its condition and its fresh weight.

A four by two grid of photographs. The columns are no ACCD control, pre-treatment, co-treatment and post-treatment; the top row is no heat stress and the bottom row is heat stress with thermo priming. Each frame shows a row of seedlings laid on black with a blue ruler beside them. The top row shows long white roots and green leaves; the bottom row roots are short and the leaves pale.
